VIII. Traits
Every Trait reads at his lead Mastery, Spirit III.
CHEONHA (천하 · 天下), All Under Heaven · Primary Trait
CHEONHA is basically Summoning Manipulation joined to Domain Manipulation: the power to claim ground and rule every summoned thing that stands on it. Hiromi drives his seal into the earth, and from that point out to the edge he names, Irath’s law holds: one will rules there, and every other will bends or breaks. Anything summoned inside that boundary, by him or by anyone else, stands on his soil and answers to him. He can call his own to his side, and he can turn, hold or send home another summoner’s creatures, as long as they stand on his ground. A summoning begun inside his claim has to pass through it, so he can block it or bend it. Another person’s Domain that meets his has to contest the claim, and the weaker claim gives way. The land also raises its own warden: guardians drawn up out of the soil that walk the boundary, carry his decree, and throw down anything that crosses without his leave, as Talos walked the shore of Crete. The price is that all of it hangs on the seal. While the seal stays in the ground the realm holds. If it is pulled or broken, the whole domain drains away at once, as Talos bled out when Medea drew the one bronze nail from his ankle, and every summon he took goes free. A summon that serves because it wants something, more than because it fears the crown, can refuse him.
THE VERMILION LINE · Jongmyo (종묘 · 宗廟) · Secondary Trait
THE VERMILION LINE is basically Ancestral Evocation: the power to call up the dead of his own blood. Hiromi carries his mother’s claim, and the dead of the Vermilion Dynasty answer to it. He can call up the kings and queens of his line, and they come in their own forms, wearing the color they died in. They can stand around him as a royal guard and fight. He can ask them for counsel, and they give it from long lives of war and rule. Or one of them can lend him their strength and their art for a while. On ground he holds under CHEONHA they come at full strength, because there a king stands on his own land, and they will stand watch over his seal. They answer the claim before they answer the boy, so a dead king who thinks him unworthy can test him or refuse him. The longer one of them lends him strength, the harder that king leans back, until the line between his will and theirs begins to blur.
Blessing
Paragon of Irath. The Archon of Will and Dominion has named him. It is the blessing that gave him his grip on Fate, and the reason Irath’s own working answers him. Offered as his window line:
[Blessing: The King's Heart]
[He who commands himself commands the world.]

IX. Domain
CHEONHA, All Under Heaven. It came to him at Transcendence and roots through Chthonica, so it rises out of the ground it is raised on and grows harder to break the longer he holds that ground. Its full shape is ILWOL-OBONG below.
X. Techniques
HAETAE (해태 · 獬豸), the Wardens of the Law · Signature Construct
Beasts of stone and bronze that Hiromi raises out of his claimed ground. The haetae is the Korean beast of justice, said to know right from wrong and to butt the guilty, and its statues still guard the palace gate. His wardens walk the boundary of CHEONHA, guard the seal, and gore anything that crosses without his leave. They carry Judicium, so a lie told on his ground shows under their reading. Each warden runs on one vermilion vein sealed with one nail. Pull the nail and the warden crumbles back into the earth.
EOGA HAENGNYEOL (어가행렬 · 御駕行列), the Royal Procession · Signature Summon
The whole Vermilion court comes up out of the ground in ranks, as the Joseon royal processions were painted rank by rank: banner-bearers, an honor guard, generals on horseback, and a dead king borne in a palanquin at the center. It is THE VERMILION LINE at full scale, his army, called only when the fight deserves it. The procession serves the crown first. If the king in the palanquin turns against Hiromi, the whole line turns with him.
ILWOL-OBONG (일월오봉 · 日月五峰), the Sun, Moon and Five Peaks · Domain Construct
The painted screen that stood behind every Joseon king’s throne. Hiromi raises it at his back, and its five peaks, its sun and its moon become real around his ground: mountain walls, a sky of his own, and a throne at the center. It is CHEONHA made visible. When he sits, his domain is fixed. The seal is set in the throne, so if he is driven off it the walls begin to fall.
DONGIN (동인 · 銅人), the Bronze Man · Ultimate
A colossal guardian of bronze raised from his ground, with one of his ancestor kings riding inside it as its heart, as Talos’s life ran through his one vein. It is both of his Traits in one body and the clearest form of the Talos he was built on. It has the Talos flaw as well: one nail at the ankle. Pull it and the dead king inside drains out.
THE UNBOWED CROWN · Irath’s Root Invocation
Irath’s own working, [IrW] Will and [Krn] Crown on Judicium and Ignivale, held at Invocation and above. Hiromi states a conviction aloud and means it, and within a bounded field his will is sovereign: Essence reorganizes to obey the conviction, lesser wills fall in line or take feedback in proportion to how hard they resist, and he is shielded from outside domination. The field audits itself. If his own later actions contradict what he declared, it collapses onto him with everything it has gathered, and a doubt planted in him breaks it from the source outward.
XI. Spirit Axes

Saeju Mahuo (mother) The claim in his blood is hers.
Cozbi Mahuo (uncle) Came up the valley road for him after the war with the dead walking behind like an honor guard, and kept him three years. Hiromi wears an olive coat like his because he asked to. He loves his uncle and has shouted at him to stop.
Naiser Yukari The Lord of the Cedars, who raised him in the Enclave and taught him in the yard and on the road.
Senna Yukari Raised beside him. She sets his collar straight and he bears it like weather.
Dari His uncle’s nine-tailed fox, founded with a charter to follow and protect him, serve him, and report every great change.

XII. Resistances

Dominion 1,960, Sovereignty 380, Command 360, Ward 200: domination, command and Domain-erasure aimed at him run into a will that was built to rule.
The Unbowed Crown: shields him from outside domination while the field stands.
Water and filth: Chthonica holds only what it touches. Put water, grease or filth between him and his ground and the grip lets go all at once, and on open water or a moving deck CHEONHA has nothing to root in.
The seal: the whole realm hangs on it. Break it and everything goes.
Doubt: a real doubt in his own conviction collapses the Crown from inside.
Body: Dexterity 446, Vitality 550. Up close, without his court, he is a young man in a coat.
The gate: a soul that has stopped fearing the Black Gate drifts toward it, cooling a little at a time.

XIII. Physical Description
Hair: Brown, thick and loose, falling shaggy over the brow and to the collar at the back.
Eyes: Brown, heavy-lidded and downcast, quick to glare.
Face: Fine-boned and quiet, the mouth often a little open as if about to speak.
Dress: A dark mantle over a cream shirt gathered at the throat, its lining pale at the collar and a fringe at the shoulder. In company, the olive coat of the Sum-gol Post, cut like his uncle’s.
Carries: A green stone on a fine gold chain at his throat.
XIV. Psychology
How he moves: He stands at the center and lets the field come to him. He sits like a man who expects the chair to be his.
Voice: Plain and direct. As a boy he was loud and eager, and the eagerness never quite left; it shows when a fight is offered.
Underneath: Not spiteful. The war took his mother under a roof, and in him what grew in the hole it left was something stubborn and green and patient, like a seed under snow that has decided to come up.
The bind: Irath refuses alliance with Auren, the Archon of Death, because to end is to surrender. Hiromi is Irath’s Paragon and the son of the house that keeps the dead, and he calls his own dead to his side.
XV. Equipment

XVI. Temperance Record

Stages I to VII: crossed as a boy in Sum-gol and in the Cedar Enclave, under Naiser Yukari. Details not known.
Stage VIII, Transcendence: CHEONHA came to him as his Domain. Details not known.
Stage IX, Invocation: Irath’s Root Invocation answered him. Details not known.
Next gate: Stage X, Realization, which his Level 250 already holds (230): only the Catalyst is wanting, and past Level 300 without it he would come into Residual Strain.

XVII. Fracture Log

Lost his mother, Saeju, when a roof came down on her in the war.
Taken up the valley road by his uncle Cozbi, with the dead walking behind them like an honor guard, and kept by him for three years.
Sent down the Kessen road to the Cedar Enclave to train under Naiser Yukari, with Dari to guard him; met a Sin of Sloth on the road and asked whether he got to fight it.
Raised by the Lord of the Cedars in his own valley.
Named Paragon by Irath, the Archon of Dominion.
At the Moto table, seated on the Zettari bench with the Yukari household, he looked down the hall at the princess’s maid, Gwi, and glared, as a man glares at a stranger sitting in his father’s chair.

Kimizu Moto
Prince of the North · The Mirror
I. Identity
Full Name: Kimizu Moto
Name: Ki (what stands) and Mizu (water): the thing that stands in the water. It ties him to his sister Mizuyi.
Age: 10, the youngest
Race / Lineage: Human · Moto, the Kōkan, the red line; Greymane through his mother
Faction: House Moto at Kharven-Seat. Son of King Muken Moto and Queen Amelia Greymane.
Epithet: Not known.
Status: Alive
Family: Father Muken Moto; mother Amelia Greymane; elder brothers Sodoku (13, the crown prince) and Sonzai (13); sister Mizuyi, taken by Cozbi Mahuo on the night of her betrothal; brother Tenma (12).
Current Location: Kharven-Seat
Catalyst Event: Not known.
II. Soul Architecture

III. Wellspring Harmonizations

Aura: arc-blue, with thin lines of color at its edges where things come apart into their true parts. It shows mostly in his eyes.
IV–V. Stats

Room to grow: every Primary but Gnosis sits well under the Stage’s roof, and his Gnosis already stands at the top of what Stage V allows.

VI. Force of Hand
No measured strike on file. Ardency 168: he hits like a ten-year-old. KAGAMI’s copies run at his own strength, which is why he copies the clever moves and not the heavy ones.
VII. Aether Flow

































Reserve105,124 EU, held as Essence, by the law of reserves at Level 125Flux Density600 EU/gYield (η)0.62, what a hall expects of an Expert; below Glory no Mastery is read and the Stage’s own figure is the yieldAU/s372.0 at full outputFrom fullabout 4.7 minutes of full output, far longer at the pace of a lesson or a quarrelA Fate pullat Fate I, 0.60 to 0.70 of what he spends arrives; the price is the knot
VIII. Traits
Full accounts: Kimizu Moto — Abilities
Below Glory his Mastery is unread, and every Trait works at its base.
YOMI (読み), the Reading · Primary Trait
YOMI is basically Information Analysis: the power to read anything completely, find its weakness, and copy what it does. “Read” is the Moto house’s own verb for a person, and in Go and shogi yomi is a master seeing the board many moves ahead. Kimizu does both. He looks at a person, a sword, a wall, a technique or a Wellspring, and it opens to him like a book: what it is made of, what job it was made for, how strong it is, and the one loose stitch where it will come apart. He can read other people’s windows, which nobody is supposed to be able to do. He can copy a technique after seeing it once. He learns anything faster than anyone, and he has been correcting his tutors since he could talk. At its height it is the Moto’s Work of Knowledge at full strength: he reads a thing’s true name aloud, and it can no longer pretend. Disguises fall, illusions break, and a lie stops working in front of him. Yomi is also the old name for the land of the dead, and the house has noticed. The price is that he cannot stop reading. Every face, wall and wound tells itself to him all day, and after a big read his eyes bleed and he goes flat and empty the way the Moto do after a verdict. His copies work at his own strength, not the original’s, and copying a bloodline art or a Fate art fails or hurts him badly. He knows what a thing is, not what a person will choose.
ISSHUN (一瞬), the Instant · Secondary Trait
ISSHUN is basically Accelerated Thought: the power to think so fast that the world goes still around him. Isshun means an instant, the blink of an eye. When Kimizu is in danger, his mind leaves the world behind. A falling sword hangs in the air, an arrow sits frozen in flight, and a man’s face is caught halfway through deciding what to do. Everything slows to a crawl except him. In that stillness YOMI has all the time it needs: he reads every person in the room, finds every loose stitch, weighs every choice and picks the best one, all between one heartbeat and the next. To everyone watching, he simply answers instantly and perfectly, as if he knew what was coming. His body does not speed up with his mind; he has time to choose, not more time to act. The price is that it burns him. His mind runs far hotter than it was built for, and when the instant ends he comes out of it shaking, with a pounding head and a bleeding nose. If he holds it too long or calls it too often, it takes a full day before he can read anything again.
IX. Domain
None.
X. Techniques
KAGAMI (鏡), the Mirror · Signature Art
KAGAMI is basically Attack Replication: the power to read anything completely and give it back. Kagami means mirror, and in the old stories a mirror shows what a thing truly is. Kimizu is that mirror. Through YOMI he reads a person, a sword or a technique down to the last stitch; through ISSHUN he has all the time he needs to do it, between one heartbeat and the next. Then he answers with exactly what they showed him: their own technique, their own weakness, their own whole art. Fighting Kimizu is fighting a reflection of yourself, held by a child who has already seen how it ends.

KANTEI (鑑定), the Appraisal · A full read of anything: what it is made of, what it was made for, how strong it is, and the window nobody else can see.
UTSUSHI (写し), the Copy · He copies a technique after seeing it once and uses it himself.
HOKOROBI (綻び), the Loose Stitch · He strikes the one weak seam in anything: armor, an art, a person, an argument.
MASUKAGAMI (真澄鏡), the Clear Mirror · The finisher. A masukagami is a perfectly clear mirror. He reads the enemy’s whole art at once and plays all of it back at them, the way they would have used it, flaw included.

The price: his copies work at his own strength, not the original’s. Copying a bloodline art or a Fate art fails or hurts him badly. Every big read leaves his eyes bleeding and his head pounding, and MASUKAGAMI burns so hot that he cannot read anything for a day afterward.
Beside his father: Muken sees where a thing will break; Kimizu sees why it was built that way, and how to build it again. Muken breaks things. Kimizu copies them.
XI. Spirit Axes
Muken Moto (father) · Both read where a thing gives; the father breaks it, the son copies it.
Tenma (brother) · Two years older, and the one who stands in front of him. Kimizu reads; Tenma carries.
Mizuyi (sister) · His name carries her water. Taken by Cozbi Mahuo on the night of her betrothal.
XII. Resistances

Lies, glamour and disguise: they do not hold in front of him. Judicium and YOMI read the mark a lie cannot help leaving.
Everything else: Vitality 203, Resilience 260, Dominion 177. A child’s body and a child’s ward, and a hard blow or a strong working goes straight through him.

XIII. Physical Description
Hair: Fair gold, shaggy and light, falling loose over the brow and the back of the neck, a shade warmer than Sodoku’s.
Eyes: Pale blue, sidelong, always reading.
Face: Fine-boned, with a slight smile at the corner of the mouth, as if he already knows how the conversation ends.
Dress: Red and black: a dark collar and a red that sits on him like a splash of paint.
Marks: A small black stud at the ear.
XIV. Psychology
Voice: quick, precise and cheerful, with a slight smile, as if he already knows how the conversation ends. He corrects adults without meaning to be rude, and sometimes meaning to.
Underneath: a genius of ten who is never bored, never wrong for long, and a little lonely because of it. He reads his brothers better than they read themselves, and has not yet learned when not to say so.
How he moves: sidelong, half turned away, always looking at something just past the person he is talking to.
XV. Equipment

































ItemWhat it isGradeRarityNoteThe black studa small black stud at the earplainUncommon—A traveling go boardfolding wood, stones in two bagsplainCommonhe plays both sides against himselfHis rapiera long, light thrusting blade, cut down to a ten-year-old’s reachnot knownnot knownhe can use any blade; the rapier is the one that keeps him alive
XVI. Temperance Record

Stage I, Murmuring: woke at five, which the house thought early even for the Kōkan.
Stage II, Welling: YOMI woke with it, the morning he told his tutor which page of the tutor’s own book was wrong.
Stages III and IV, Ascension and Flourishing: crossed at eight and nine, reading.
Stage V, Splintering: crossed at ten, the youngest the house remembers.
Next gate: Stage VI, Glory; it holds at Level 115, which his 125 already passes, so only the Catalyst is wanting.

XVII. Fracture Log

Named Kimizu, the thing that stands in the water.

The warmth goes out of everything within a few paces of him and down through his heels into the ground, and it runs harder the angrier he gets.It moves heat, and cannot make it: on frozen ground or in deep winter it has little to take, a man already as cold as the snow gives it nothing, and against a great heat it is a bucket against a fire. And the heat has to have somewhere to go: when the ground under his heels is itself inside the fire, he is only carrying heat from the air round the king into the earth under the king, and it comes straight back. Its named failure is the full sink: nowhere left to put the warmth, and the frost stops where it stands.His breath stops steaming and his beard whitens.Nothing he notices; he has never been warm in his life and does not miss it.Heat, and calm: a hot room, a furnace, a fire-worker; or keeping him steady, since a Stark who is not angry is only a cold man. A far stronger presence does the same work as a fire, driving his frost back toward his own boots before a blow is struck.—A LINE IN THE SNOWPrimary—Path Fate, Walked: a border claimed, with the Body’s cold laid along it · Lens the Stark cold (no Wellspring) · Form Claimnone on the cardThe sword’s point dragged through the ground, and a low white wall of cold stands up along the scratch. Cross it toward what he guards and your fingers stiffen, your breath catches and your feet go out from under you. a low white wall of cold stands up along a scratch, and whoever crosses it toward what he guards crosses into the full coldHe must stand on his side of it; the line is his, and if he steps over it himself it is only a scratch in the snow, because the claim is that this ground is his and that ground is not, and a man who steps over his own border has unsaid it. Its length is one stroke of the arm and a step, a few yards, never a wall round a city. It needs a whole breath to set, half to draw and the rest to plant his feet and bring the point down, and against a fighter who can cross eighty paces inside that breath it is never drawn at all.The point of the sword dragging through the ground.About 2% of his reserve to draw, near 14,000 EU, and a little to hold.Go round the ends, or come at him from the side the line does not face.—BY THE SKY THAT COVERS USSecondary—Path Fate, Walked: a vow, which is small Fate and spends his own share · no lens · Form Bindnone on the card; Oath 230 prices itRight fist to the breastbone, once, hard. It breaks by its own terms the moment he breaks it.Right fist pressed once, hard, to the breastbone.Nothing to swear; everything to keep. characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/ma.content:
The Namecutter · Eldest son of the Sovereign of Kushara · Bearer of Sujimon
I. Identity
Full Name: Ma’Kovu Neno Zettari (Neno, Swahili “word,” given by his mother)
Called: the Namecutter (Class) · loose cannon (Rashani) · jack of all trades (Rengai)
Age: 15
Race / Lineage: Human · Zettari and Yukari, a perfect blend of both houses
Faction: House Zettari, Kushara. Eldest child of Sovereign Dougou Ozumu Zettari and Naevra Yukari. Declined the heirship (now Zuberi’s).
Status: Alive
Family: Brothers Rashani (14), Rengai (12), Zuberi (10, heir); sister Ayaka (8). Uncle Naiser Yukari.
Current Location: Kharven-Seat, Inner World, with his family’s embassy to the Moto
Catalyst Event: Declining the heirship of Kushara, the decision that carried him across to Stage VI, Glory, lived.
II. Soul Architecture
Stat line: Stage VI Glory · Expert (Faceted) · Level 160 · Refined · Namecutter · Body Mastered, I · Fate Walked, unread · Lenses: home + 3
Level: 160; it holds Glory (115), and no Residual Strain builds in him short of 200
Temperance Stage: VI · Glory · Expert · stat ceiling 400
Soul Crystal: Faceted
Path: Body, leading; Fate, second (its gates open a Stage late)
Mastery: Body I, Muridic · Fate unread, Walked a rung behind a lead of I; a grip by blood (his power over Names)
Class: Namecutter; it evolves as his Body Mastery rises
Reserve: about 295,000 EU at full (log₁₀ EU = 3.4202 + 0.012812 × 160)
Releases: none found yet
III. Wellspring Harmonizations
Fixatio (Medium) · names he carves set and stay set.
Anamnesis (Medium) · reads and calls up a thing’s older names.
Judicium (Wild) · truth; reads weakness like text.
Oblivara (Fate) · his Fate lens and the reach of his erasures.
IV–V. Stats
Pool: Levels 1 to 100 1,200 + Levels 101 to 160 900 + Thresholds I–VI 2,100 = 4,200 points on Sub-Stats.



























































PrimaryTotalMeanSignature Sub-StatsDexterity1,200150Finesse 300 · Celerity 230 · Reflex 210 · Economy 160 · Evasion 140Ardency960120Penetration 300 · Flux 200 · Depth 160 · Alacrity 120 · Compression 90Gnosis60075Fluency 220 · Analysis 140 · Perception 110 · Acuity 70Vitality44055Threshold 110 · Constitution 90 · Fortitude 80 · Regeneration 60Dominion35050Sovereignty 140 · Sense 70 · Gravity 50 (divided by seven; Throne outside)Resilience32040Integrity 120 · Ward 80 · Persistence 60Tempering17021Clarity 70 · Yield 50 · Maturity 30Harmonics16020Axis 70 · Synergy 50 · Stability 25
Skills: Swordsmanship (single blade, two hands) Expert · Name-reading Adept · Barbs Adept · Riding Journeyman · Etiquette Apprentice.
VI. Physical Force
Read off the numbers: Finesse and Penetration at 300, the rest of his output two steps or more below them on the hidden scale. A sword master at fifteen; neither he nor Rashani has ever landed a blow on their father.
VII. Aether Flow
Body-led: raw Aether packed in the Shell, Body I. His name-work is Fate: pulled through the Attraction Layer and paid from his own share. Gives off nothing a reader can feel when he chooses, the first thing his father taught all his sons.
VIII. Traits
Every trait feeds one of his Name Arts, Sujimon, the Origin Eye or the sword, and every Trait reads at his lead Mastery, Body I.

Jina la Kweli · The True Name Feeds Kusoma Majina, Pigo la Mwisho and every name-cut. Reads the true name of what he looks at, at a glance. A name he has read whole counts as the precise knowledge his deeper arts demand, so Name-Cutting, Erasure and the Last Blow go in without a guess. Line of sight; hidden, warded and Archon-scale names blur; the nameless show nothing.
Upanga Ni Mimi · The Blade Is Me Feeds every art of Sujimon and the Unseen Wave. A name-cut made through the blade costs him less than the same cut made bare; the Unseen Wave holds its edge further out; the blade cannot be named away from him. If Sujimon’s name is ever cut, he feels it as a wound.
Jicho la Jina la Kwanza · The Eye of the First Name Feeds the Origin Eye, Echo and Renaming. Reads the first name a thing was given in one breath, the name Echo calls up and Renaming has to write over; a short look no longer costs him blood. A long or deep look still does.
Ulimi Mkali · The Sharp Tongue Feeds Kutaja and Kufunga kwa Jina. Names he speaks aloud carry Command Weight: the Calling holds for a second breath, Binding by Name lasts longer, and a barb aimed at a man’s name lands where he means it. Backfires on the proud, and does not know when to stop.
Jina Lisilovunjika · The Unbroken Name Feeds Jina la Kuazima and Upanga Ni Mimi. He knows his own name to the bottom: he can wear a Borrowed Name far longer before he starts losing his own, and name-workings, glamours and possessions turned on him slide off more often than not. Guards his name, not his body.
Origin Eye (Iso Lomsuka) Born with it. Shows him the first name a thing was given, the name still holding it under every later one.

IX. Domain
None. A first flicker is possible at Stage VII, a Domain from Stage VIII. Sujimon’s Name Domain is its ceiling.
X. Techniques
The Name Arts (without the sword).

Kusoma Majina · Reading Names · a name’s full shape at rest: what it holds, what holds it, its first name.
Kutaja · The Calling · speaks a thing by its true name so it must answer for one breath (two with Ulimi Mkali).
Kufunga kwa Jina · Binding by Name · a name with a command holds a thing fast for a few heartbeats; less against the stronger.
Kuachilia · The Release · speaks a person’s true name to loosen what binds them; loosens, does not cut.
Jina la Kuazima · The Borrowed Name · wears a name (Swift, Iron, Unseen) for a while; held too long, he forgets his own.
Limits: he must know the name; the nameless are beyond him; every art is paid from his own share; turning it on himself is how a name-worker forgets the real one.

Swordsmanship and Sujimon’s arts: see XV.
XI. Spirit Axes

Dougou (father, teacher) He favors him; has never touched him in the yard.
Naevra (mother) The one he fears most; gave him his middle name.
Rashani Always at his side; promised to marry the Moto girl for him, then meant it.
Rengai Calls him a jack of all trades.
Zuberi Picked up the heirship he set down.
Ayaka Stole his lemon tart from the air.
Naiser Yukari Uncle; Ma’Kovu means to go where Rashani’s training goes.
Sonzai Moto Rival. Future Commander? · blood boy. Ma’Kovu wants to fight him.
Sodoku Moto The heir who did not bite at the gate.
Mizuyi Moto Promised to Rashani; taken south by Cozbi Mahuo.
Cozbi Mahuo Said he thought about Ma’Kovu first.

XII. Resistances
Identity and glamour effects: good (Jina Lisilovunjika). Name-workings against him: resisted by his own name’s depth. Pain: fair (Threshold). Thin where a boy who has never been badly beaten is thin: Tempering, Harmonics and Resilience. Known tell: he looks where he is going to cut. Known flaw: he does not know when to stop.
XIII. Physical Description
Six foot five, long in the arm and leg, lean and quick. Light brown skin, silver eyes, neck-length black hair streaked white that the wind keeps undoing. His father’s face on a longer frame, and a mouth half a step from a grin. Left hand always resting on Sujimon’s guard. Abroad he wears the royal dress of Kushara: a long black coat worked in gold thread, gold at collar and wrist, and a Cord of Becoming with few knots yet.
XIV. Psychology
Proud, loud, quick and funny; a slick mouth and a slick way with words. Tests people with small baits and calls it testing the waters. Wants the Iron Bison, one blow on his father, and a fight with Sonzai Moto. Fiercely loyal: first back up the stair when the harbor went up, first into a doorway for his brother. When he means it, his father’s flat low voice comes up under the slick one. “The blade is me. Wherever I go, it goes.”
XV. Equipment
Sujimon · the Absolute Edge, the Blade of Names
A Yukari-forged katana of plain gray steel with a pale temper line, bound to his power over Names.
Governing rule: Sujimon answers only to its wielder; its edge has no limit of its own, but reaches exactly as far as his Stage and his numbers. Every name-cut is a working paid from his reserve.
Properties: The Absolute Edge (cuts materials, constructs, wards; can cut a defense’s name; his Penetration at 300) · The Unending Edge (never dulls, chips or wears).
Name arts of the blade: Name-Cutting · Name Carving · Erasure · Name Fusion (most likely to backlash) · Resonance · Echo · Severing Destiny (among his costliest) · Renaming (not resurrection) · Endless Flow (with the Origin Eye; temporary; permanent Wellspring shut-off follows the Spring Arts, Stage VIII) · The Unseen Wave (range his Stage’s).
The four strikes: Kupasua Pazia, Tearing the Veil (a crack, not a door, at his Stage) · Kata Kisichoonekana, Cut the Unseen (bonds cut can be retied) · Pigo la Mwisho, The Last Blow (needs the true name; at or below his Stage and his numbers; fails on hidden names and the nameless) · Pigo Lisilo na Mipaka, The Blow Without Borders (empties him).
Name Domain: every name visible and rewritable without a stroke; from Stage VIII, not yet his.
Limits: answers to its wielder; needs the name; every cut paid; protected and nameless resist; it does not choose its target; backlash on wrong names or bad fusions; paradox leaves it nothing to grip.
XVI. Temperance Record
I–V: lived, not itemized. VI · Glory: lived, on the decision to decline the heirship of Kushara.
XVII. Fracture Log

Born with the Origin Eye; named Neno.
Declines the heirship; crosses to Glory.
Trains with Rashani against his father under the baobab.
Sails north on the first ship across the seas of the Division.
At the gate of Kharven-Seat, reads Sonzai’s slipped hitch and mocks him to his back.
Back up the stair as the harbor burns; meets Sonzai at the great doors.
Declares he will go south; ordered silent by his father. Owed a talk with his mother.

characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/ma.title: Malex Valorin
characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/ma.content:
The Redactor · Professor of Refusal · the Last Lecturer
“If a phenomenon cannot explain why it is still occurring, I see no academic reason to permit it.”
I. Identity
Full Name: Malex Valorin
Age: 36
Race / Lineage: Human · pureblood Valorin, the Scripted Soul Lattice bloodline
Faction: House Valorin · Professor at the Vaeloris Alchemical Scriptorium, under his brother Dhaerin as headmaster and alongside his nephew Xhem (Scriptia diagnostics, reconstruction theory, foreign-system analysis, magical failure architecture, phenomena jurisprudence)
Current Location: Vaeloris Village, Inner World
Family: Eldest brother of Dhaerin Valorin, headmaster of the Scriptorium and leader of Vaeloris · brother of the late Rheana Valorin · uncle and colleague of Xhem Valorin, Rheana’s son · married to Helaena Valorin, born Garyen · no children
Status: Active, teaching
Catalyst Event: His lattice wrote its first glyph on its own when he was five and has never stopped writing since.
II. Soul Architecture
Stat line: Stage XIII Principality · Archmaster (Starred, by a Crystal’s reckoning) · Level 460 · Refined · Redactor · Spirit Mastered, V · Fate Walked, II · Lenses: home + 4
Level: 460; it holds Principality (401) and would hold Zenith (420), and no Residual Strain builds in him short of 500
Temperance Stage: XIII · Principality · Archmaster · stat ceiling 1,200
Soul: No Soul Crystal. A Living Ink Soul, a self-editing palimpsest, grown to the depth a Crystal would call Starred. Partly self-writing: once a problem is framed, the lattice keeps testing and revising while his attention is elsewhere.
Path: Spirit, leading (meaning and make-up: deconstruction); Fate, second (standing and admission: refusal)
Mastery: Spirit V, Ferryman · Fate II, Walked, with no grip by blood or blessing to lift it past II · Body none: he walks no Body road, and works matter through his foci
Class: Redactor; it evolves as his Spirit Mastery rises
Reserve: about 2.06 billion EU at full (log₁₀ EU = 3.4202 + 0.012812 × 460). The Cistern of Unspoken Lines makes each unit work harder than a Crystal-bearer’s.
III. Wellspring Harmonizations

Judicium (Wild) · validity, recognition, consequence, standing.
Fixatio (Medium) · anchoring; makes refusals hold and reconstructions stay rebuilt.
Coagula (Wild) · gathering the broken without melting; the engine of reconstruction.
Transference (Fate) · moves burden, property, Essence, inscription and function between holders.
Anamnesis (Medium) · reads the structural memory of a thing’s earlier shape.
Forms: Scriptia · Harmonia.

IV–V. Stats
Pool: Levels 1 to 100 1,200 + 101 to 200 1,500 + 201 to 300 1,800 + 301 to 400 2,100 + 401 to 460 1,440 + Thresholds I–XIII 9,100 = 17,140 points on Sub-Stats.



























































PrimaryTotalMeanSignature Sub-StatsGnosis4,400550Analysis 1,150 · Fluency 1,100 · Perception 760 · Retention 700Dominion2,450350Sovereignty 950 · Radius 600 · Sense 500 (divided by seven; Throne outside)Tempering2,600325Clarity 900 · Maturity 700 · Coherence 600Resilience2,600325Ward 1,050 · Integrity 650 · Continuity 450Harmonics2,000250Attunement 700 · Synergy 550 · Axis 400Dexterity1,400175Economy 600 · Finesse 450Ardency1,040130Compression 500 · Penetration 300Vitality65081Threshold 200 · Regeneration 150 · Constitution 150
Skills: Spell diagnosis Archmaster · Reconstruction Archmaster · Vaeloric script Archmaster · Lecturing Expert · Punctuality Initiate.
VI. Physical Force
Vitality 650 and Ardency 1,040 by the numbers: he can fight physically if he must, and seldom should. He would rather find out why an attack works and remove the reason.
VII. Aether Flow
Essence routed through a self-writing lattice; the Cistern pays out first; the Domain costs about 1.3 million EU a second to hold.
VIII. Traits
Lineage (Valorin Family page): Scripted Soul Lattice · Primordial Scriptia · Harmonic Translation Engine · Living Spell Memory · Arcane Vessel Sovereignty · the Cistern of Unspoken Lines · Scribed Flesh · the Inner Grimoire · Errata · the Distributed Soul.
His own (each feeds his arts, and each reads at his lead Mastery, Spirit V):

The Redactor Feeds Scholia Anatomica and Palimpsest Restitutio. Sees a working as separate clauses: Wellspring mechanism, Essence input, material form, Soul authorship, Fate recognition, Formation, environment, resonance, consequence. Removes one and leaves the rest. Undefined, paradoxical or fast-changing systems resist.
Nihil Admittitur Feeds the technique of that name and Margin Exclusion. After full diagnosis, a Three-Plane refusal: this phenomenon is not admitted here. The source, the caster and the Wellspring survive; the manifestation stops. He cannot cleanly refuse what he cannot define, and only where he has jurisdiction.
Professor’s Margin Feeds Scholia Anatomica and the Last Margin. Repetition teaches him: record, compare, invariants, then hidden dependencies and failure points. Learns nothing from what never repeats.
Living Footnotes Feeds every technique. Autonomous annotations investigate unfamiliar magic while his attention is elsewhere. They read, they do not act; a flood of unrelated workings swamps them.

Beside his nephew: Nihil Admittitur refuses a manifestation inside his jurisdiction after full diagnosis; Xhem’s Nullgrammar withdraws the Continuum’s recognition of one working anywhere, at once. Malex calls Nullgrammar “the student’s version, and the better one.”
IX. Domain
The Last Margin (Aula Negata) · complete Principality Domain. About 9.5 km natural, 40 km prepared. Upkeep about 1.3 million EU/s; collapses at about 14% reserve or catastrophic Formula Saturation, a little over twenty minutes from full. Doctrine: “What enters the lesson submits to examination. What cannot justify its continuation may be refused.” Everything inside acquires annotations describing how it functions; the Domain exposes grammar. Behaviors: Automatic Annotation · Structural Separation · Palimpsest Restoration · Margin Exclusion · Contradiction Exposure · Living Footnotes. It does not make him all-knowing.
X. Techniques
Scholia Anatomica, the Dissection of the Written Thing · separates a phenomenon into its working parts; about 80,000 to over 20 million EU; backlash Formula Saturation.
Palimpsest Restitutio, Reconstruction of the Lost Page · rebuilds damaged physical or magical structures from what survives; cannot invent a history that never existed; does not reverse time; wrong assumptions get rebuilt in.
Nihil Admittitur, Phenomenon Rejected · a single violet line crosses the phenomenon and it stops; about 2 million EU minimum; needs a defined phenomenon, full diagnosis and Three-Plane standing; backlash contradiction pressure across the lattice. Students called it being expelled from class.
XI. Spirit Axes

Helaena Valorin (born Garyen) his wife; alive; the strongest bond he has.
Dhaerin Valorin younger brother, headmaster of the Scriptorium and leader of Vaeloris. A healthy brotherhood: they disagree constantly, drink together on the bad nights, and stand behind each other in every room that matters. Dhaerin’s scholarship is cost and recognition; Malex’s is mechanism. Malex remembers a thing Dhaerin paid away for the Last Line: Dhaerin’s own childhood before nine. He tells it whenever asked.
Rheana Valorin their younger sister, Xhem’s mother; died of a soul sickness. Both brothers still mourn her, and neither says her name lightly.
Xhem Valorin nephew, Rheana’s son; once his student, now his colleague. “Yes. Try not to ruin him with the observation.”
His students frightened of him and devoted; the room is always full.

XII. Resistances
Structured magic he has read: very high (Ward 1,050). Possession and Crystal manipulation: very high, usually irrelevant. Severance and continuity attacks: high (distributed lattice). Weak to memory attacks, dream logic, Void and anti-continuity, probability instability. Known counters: speed before diagnosis finishes, ever-changing mechanisms, floods of unrelated workings, Formula Saturation, losing his foci, the genuinely nameless, and threats to his family, which lower his patience rather than his power.
XIII. Physical Description
Six foot; lean and deceptively strong. Thick white Valorin hair, straight, swept back from his brow and tucked behind his ears, a few strands always falling loose; a full white beard trimmed close at the cheeks; heavy white brows. Pale royal violet eyes, usually half-lidded; when something has earned his attention they narrow into a hard, unblinking glare that every student he has taught learns to dread. Warm Kushian brown skin; mature luminous lattice markings that sometimes annotate unfamiliar magic on their own. A long black high-collared coat with a burgundy mantle over one shoulder, the family’s color, which Xhem wears too; worn looser than the Scriptorium allows. Smells of wine, parchment, cedar and ink. Usually looks like a professor dragged out of a comfortable chair, wineglass in hand, until the glare arrives.
XIV. Psychology
Core wound: the lattice has never given him a quiet mind since five, and the grief for Rheana has not made it quieter. Flaw: wine and avoidance; he knows exactly what it is and has not stopped. Desire: to teach the next generation to ask on what grounds before they cast, and to keep Xhem from being ruined by being called a prodigy. Loop: noise, wine, quiet, avoidance, more wine. Under threat the laziness goes first and the wine second; then he starts removing things from the problem. He sees the same habit starting in his nephew with a different leaf, and has not decided how to say so without sounding like a hypocrite.
XV. Equipment
The Final Margin · scriptwood staff, dark silver rings, violet focus stone; widens his diagnostic jurisdiction and steadies refusals (Judicium · Fixatio). Errata · his living grimoire of failures (Anamnesis · Coagula). Wine · ordinary; the quantity is not.
XVI. Temperance Record
I Murmuring: first self-writing glyph at five. II Welling: lattice corrects formulae before he notices. III Ascension: first spontaneous deconstruction. IV Flourishing: rebuilt a Scriptorium ward without schematics. V Splintering: family, scholarship and his first wine collide. VI Glory: chose to teach, young. VII Refraction: understanding grants no moral permission. VIII Transcendence: the Last Margin first opens. IX Invocation: Judicium recognizes him as an adjudicating intelligence. X Realization: true Three-Plane deconstruction. XI Dissonance: some things should not be rebuilt, even when they can be. XII Emanation: autonomous annotations appear. XIII Principality: the Living Ink Soul stabilizes; the Domain matures. XIV Zenith: not reached; he currently has students.
XVII. Fracture Log

The wine (Material · Soul · Lattice) · ongoing.
The first refusal (Fate · Lattice) · the day Nihil Admittitur first held.
Rheana’s death to a soul sickness (Soul · Fate) · mourned, shared with Dhaerin.
Current arc: teaching at the Scriptorium in Vaeloris.

Twenty years of peace have put weight on him: he has grown heavy through the middle, thick as an old bear in autumn, with the muscle all still there under it like a boulder under snow, and the front of his coat sits tighter than its tailor planned. He is plainly no longer young. There is iron all through his beard, the lines beside his eyes are cut deep by weather and deeper by laughing, and across his face run two old pale seams where his sister sewed him shut when they were children, which stand out white in the cold. His hair is tied back. He wears the field coat, heavy and dark with iron thread in its seams and a wide fur collar, on mornings he was asked to wear the brocade.BuildAs the four worlds parted he was tall and long in the arm, built lean and hard rather than broad, with the narrow waist and the heavy forearms of someone who swung a pick before he swung a blade.HairHis hair is black, thick and wavy, cut ragged to the jaw and the nape and falling forward over his brow and into his eyes, and he does not comb it; he ties it back with a strip of leather when he works and leaves it loose when he does not.SkinHis skin is fair, gone pale from the salt galleries and never browned since, roughened at the knuckles and cracked white in the creases the way every hand raised in the Cuttings goes; in the six months since the war it has gone gray under the pallor, and his hands shake when he has not slept.FaceAs the four worlds parted his face was fine-boned and younger than anything he had done, with a straight nose and a level mouth that rarely moves.EyesHis eyes are a plain dark brown, a cutter’s eyes, set under straight black brows, and through the left one runs a single hairline of gold like the mend in a broken bowl, which never quite fades and draws open into a fan of gold when the Eye opens; characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/ra.title: Rashani Zettari
characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/ra.content:
The Rootreader · Second son of the Sovereign of Kushara
I. Identity
Full Name: Rashani Asili Zettari (Asili, Swahili “origin,” chosen by his father)
Called: the Rootreader (Class) · nephew (Naiser)
Age: 14
Race / Lineage: Human · Zettari and Yukari, a perfect blend of both houses
Faction: House Zettari, Kushara. Second child of Sovereign Dougou Ozumu Zettari and Naevra Yukari. Declined the heirship (now Zuberi’s).
Status: Alive
Family: Brothers Ma’Kovu (15), Rengai (12), Zuberi (10, heir); sister Ayaka (8). Uncle and teacher Naiser Yukari.
Promised to: Mizuyi Moto, taken south by Cozbi Mahuo.
Current Location: In training under Naiser Yukari’s household, with Hiromi Mahuo as his yard teacher alongside Sodoku Moto
Catalyst Event: At sea, three weeks out of Kushara, he said I’ll marry her about the Moto girl and meant it. That decision carried him across to Stage VI, Glory, lived.
II. Soul Architecture
Stat line: Stage VI Glory · Expert (Faceted) · Level 155 · Refined · Rootreader · Spirit Mastered, I · Body Walked, unread · Lenses: home + 2
Level: 155; it holds Glory (115), and no Residual Strain builds in him short of 200
Temperance Stage: VI · Glory · Expert · stat ceiling 400
Soul Crystal: Faceted
Path: Spirit, leading; Body, second (its gates open a Stage late)
Mastery: Spirit I, Listener · Body unread, Walked a rung behind a lead of I · Fate none: he walks no Fate road; he sees threads, does not pull them
Class: Rootreader; it evolves as his Spirit Mastery rises
Reserve: about 255,000 EU at full (log₁₀ EU = 3.4202 + 0.012812 × 155)
Releases: none found yet
III. Wellspring Harmonizations
Materia Primordia (Wild) · the First Substance, whose idea is origin; the root of his power.
Anamnesis (Medium) · everything keeps the record of its own making, and he reads it.
Rebirthine (Wild) · destruction turned into rebuilding; a new beginning out of an old ending.
IV–V. Stats
Pool: Levels 1 to 100 1,200 + Levels 101 to 155 825 + Thresholds I–VI 2,100 = 4,125 points on Sub-Stats.



























































PrimaryTotalMeanSignature Sub-StatsDexterity1,040130Finesse 240 · Reflex 220 · Celerity 200 · Evasion 160 · Feint 120Gnosis920115Perception 280 · Analysis 200 · Cognition 150 · Acuity 120 · Forecast 80Ardency72090Depth 200 · Penetration 150 · Flux 140 · Alacrity 100Harmonics56070Empathy 180 · Attunement 150 · Axis 110 · Synergy 70Vitality36045Threshold 90 · Constitution 80 · Fortitude 60 · Regeneration 60Resilience28035Integrity 90 · Ward 80 · Continuity 60Tempering14518Clarity 60 · Maturity 45 · Yield 40Dominion10014Sense 60 · Sovereignty 40 (divided by seven; Throne outside)
Skills: Two swords (paired katana) Expert · Thread-reading Adept · Courtesy Adept · Riding Journeyman.
VI. Physical Force
Read off the numbers: Perception at 280, his blade Sub-Stats at 200 to 240, most of his output two steps or more below Perception on the hidden scale. A master of two swords at fourteen; neither he nor Ma’Kovu has ever landed a blow on their father.
VII. Aether Flow
Spirit-led: Aether refined in the Crystal into Essence and spent through the Core. Gives off nothing a reader can feel, and neither do his arts (Mtupu).
VIII. Traits
Every trait feeds one of his arts, his eyes or his blades, and every Trait reads at his lead Mastery, Spirit I.

Kuona Nyuzi · Seeing the Threads Feeds Kuona Asili and Kukata Mzizi. Sees every bond as his mother’s people do, the Yukari half of his blood showing early. He can follow any thread he has seen to its far end, and aim his Origin Arts along it: find where a working began with its caster out of sight, or cut a hold at its root from across a hall. Sees, does not pull; aiming along a thread costs more the longer it is.
Jicho la Mwanzo · The Eye of the First Moment Feeds the Origin Eye and Mwanzo wa Pigo. Reads where a strike begins in the space of one breath; a short look no longer costs him blood. A long or deep look still does; a blow with no single beginning gives it nothing.
Mizizi Miwili · Two Roots Feeds the two blades and Mkasi. Each katana can carry a different Origin Art in the same exchange: the left cuts a working from its root while the right sets a grip back to its beginning. Two arts at once cost both at once; held past a few exchanges it empties him fast.
Kumbukumbu ya Mwanzo · Memory of the Beginning Feeds Mkono wa Mwanzo and Kubadili Mwanzo. What he sets back stays set longer; the holder must work to take hold again. An origin he has read fully once, he keeps, and touching it again costs less Essence. Keeps only what he has read whole.
Mtupu · The Empty One Feeds every Origin Art and the two blades. Gives off no heat, pressure or Aether, and neither do his arts: a working he touches does not flare, so its maker does not feel it until it is done, and his sword tells never show in his aura. Under real strain the emptiness slips and everything shows at once.
Origin Eye (Iso Lomsuka) Born with it. Reads the first moment of a thing: the stair where a choice was made, the hand that tied a knot.

IX. Domain
None. A first flicker is possible at Stage VII, a Domain from Stage VIII.
X. Techniques
The Origin Arts (Spirit, through the Core, paid in Essence; every one needs precise knowledge of the beginning touched):

Kuona Asili · Seeing the Source · traces anything to where it began: a working to its caster, a thread to its far end, a made thing to the mind that made it.
Mkono wa Mwanzo · The Hand of the Beginning · sets a thing back where it began; a grip becomes the resting hand it started as. Does not tear: the holder can take hold again. Done on the possessed maid’s hand at Kharven-Seat.
Kukata Mzizi · Cutting the Root · severs a working from its source for a moment; the root grows back, faster the stronger the source.
Kubadili Mwanzo · Turning the Beginning · changes where a small, recent thing he knows exactly began, and so what it is. A cut, not a life, at his Stage; costs far more than the thing changed.
Asili Yangu · My Own Source · returns himself to his own beginning to shrug off a curse, possession or borrowed hand. Too far back and he loses what he has grown into, his vow included.
Limits: precise knowledge; what never began, or has stepped outside its own making, cannot be touched; reach is his Stage’s; it loosens, it does not break.

The two blades:

Mkasi · The Shears · two blades closing from opposite heights, ribs and back of the knee.
Ukingo · The Rim · running the ring’s edge to come in behind the off hand.
Mwanzo wa Pigo · The Root of the Blow · with the Origin Eye, cuts at the moment an opponent’s strike begins. Fails against a fighter with no single commitment, or chaos with every beginning at once.

XI. Spirit Axes

Ma’Kovu Always beside him; Rashani is the hand on his shoulder.
Dougou (father) Turned a look of pride on him the night of the vow.
Naevra (mother) He has her sight without her eye.
Rengai Held by the collar when he wants into fights.
Zuberi Caught Rashani’s tell from the veranda.
Ayaka Gets his warmest smile.
Naiser Yukari Uncle and now teacher.
Mizuyi Moto Promised on paper; he held her hand while the dark took her. He means to ask her a third time.
Sodoku Moto Seen and told so, kindly; apologized for his brother and thanked him for her hand. Now his yard partner.
Sonzai Moto Not wrong, only early. Rashani has promised to tell him every morning that Mizuyi’s thread still holds.
Hiromi Mahuo His yard teacher. Rashani fixed his collar in the carriage, and teases him about Senna.
Cozbi Mahuo Predicted him: a good man always goes to the girl.

XII. Resistances
Identity attacks: fair (Integrity, Ward). Being read: hard; he and his arts give off nothing. Pain: fair. Thin in Tempering and Dominion. Known tell: a breath drawn before the left sword moves. Known flaw: he trusts his first good reading of a thing.
XIII. Physical Description
Six foot three, a hand shorter than Ma’Kovu, lean and light on his feet. Light brown skin, jet-black eyes that go deeper when he reads an origin, black hair streaked white reaching his back, tied back to fight. His father’s face and jaw. A smile that arrives before he has decided to let it. Abroad he wears the royal dress of Kushara: a long black coat worked in gold thread, gold at collar and wrist, and a Cord of Becoming with few knots yet.
XIV. Psychology
Sly and kind at once. Watches; takes the long way round a house before he sits down in it. Picky, by his father’s word; Mizuyi was to his taste. Goes to the person in distress, quietly, without being asked. His voice goes level and quiet when it matters, and carries further than shouting.
Vow (entered in Naiser Yukari’s truth-smoke, binding): “I am going to bring Mizuyi home.”
Answer (entered in the smoke on the road to the Enclave): what he means to pick up in place of Kushara is freedom from his own beginning: to choose where he starts, and to begin again when he must, and the same for others.
XV. Equipment
Two Yukari katana of plain gray steel, named the morning he first drew them against Hiromi Mahuo:

Enishi (縁) · the left blade. Japanese, the bond that ties two lives together whether either chose it. For his mother, who sees every thread in a room before she sits down.
Mbuyu · the right blade. Swahili, the baobab tree. For his father, and the old tree in the yard at home where Dougou trained his sons every morning.
At a host’s table he leaves them in his room.

XVI. Temperance Record
I–V: lived, not itemized. VI · Glory: lived, at sea, on the decision to marry the Moto girl.
XVII. Fracture Log

Born with the Origin Eye and the thread-sight; named Asili.
Declines the heirship.
At sea: I’ll marry her. Crosses to Glory.
At the gate of Kharven-Seat, sees Sodoku’s maneuver and tells him so.
Follows a distressed thread into the great hall; frees Mizuyi’s arm from the possessed maid’s grip.
The ribbon takes her anyway; he gives her cut hair to the queen and tells the king she is alive.
Vows in the smoke to bring her home; accepts Naiser’s teaching.
On the road south, answers Naiser in the smoke: freedom from his own beginning.
Names his blades Enishi and Mbuyu and draws them against Hiromi Mahuo.

characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/re.title: Rengai Zettari
characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/re.content:
Third son of the Sovereign of Kushara
I. Identity
Full Name: Rengai Zettari
Age: 12
Race / Lineage: Human · Zettari and Yukari; he takes after his mother’s house
Faction: House Zettari, Kushara. Third child of Sovereign Dougou Zettari and Naevra Yukari. Declined the heirship.
Status: Alive
Family: Father Dougou; mother Naevra; brothers Ma’Kovu (15), Rashani (14) and Zuberi (10, the heir); sister Ayaka (8). Uncle Naiser Yukari.
Current Location: The Sovereign House, Kushara Crownlands
Catalyst Event: Born with the Ketsumyōgan, the Yukari eye.
II. Soul Architecture
Stage, Level, Path and Crystal not known.
III. Wellspring Harmonizations
Not known.
IV–V. Stats
Not known.
VI. Physical Force
Not known.
VII. Aether Flow
Not known.
VIII. Traits
The Ketsumyōgan (the Binding Fate Eye) · Unlike his elder brothers he was born with the Yukari eye, which sees what everything is tied to, and with his mother’s house’s abilities, Null-Light among them. Which of them he has trained is not known.
His Father’s Wrath · In a fight he has Dougou’s anger.
IX. Domain
None.
X. Techniques
The Zettari arts · He grew up a martial artist and is mastering every one of the Zettari fighting arts, the Way of Weight first among them, and works hard at the Iron Bison. Named techniques not known.
XI. Spirit Axes

Dougou (father) Has told him he may join his elder brothers’ training when he turns thirteen. Rengai thinks this is unfair.
Naevra (mother) He favors her in looks. She pulls his ear when he hits his brother.
Ma’Kovu (brother) Rengai calls him a jack of all trades. They can argue for a full minute on two words.
Zuberi (brother) Teases him about having to wait. Rengai punches him for it.
Ayaka (sister) Teases him worse.

Rashani (brother).
XII. Resistances
Not known.
XIII. Physical Description
Height: Five foot ten. Eyes: Silver. Hair: Dirty blond, falling to his shoulders. He favors his mother.
XIV. Psychology
Impatient to fight and quick with his fists. Sulks when he is kept out. Proud of how hard he trains. The rest is not known.
XV. Equipment
Fighting wraps of the Way of Weight.
XVI. Temperance Record
Not known.
XVII. Fracture Log

Born with the Ketsumyōgan.
Declined the heirship of Kushara.
Told he may join the elder brothers’ training at thirteen.
Sails north with his family on the first ship to cross the seas of the Division.

characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/se.title: Senna Yukari
characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/se.content:
Daughter of the Lord of the Cedars · House Yukari
I. Identity
Full Name: Senna Yukari
Age: 17. A child on the Kessen road in the last days before the continents split; how old she was then is not known.
Race / Lineage: Human · Yukari, daughter of Naiser Yukari and granddaughter of Senri Yukari; the Lambert count of Sallowgate runs in her through her father’s mother. Her mother is not known.
Faction: House Yukari, the Cedar Enclave
Epithet: unnamed
Status: Alive
Family: Father Naiser Yukari, Lord of the Cedars; her father’s wife, Yan Qianli of the Jade Plains; her aunt Naevra, whose kunai she carries. Hiromi Mahuo was raised beside her in the Enclave.
Current Location: Kharven-Seat, the Zettari bench in the great hall
Catalyst Event: not known
The eye: the Ketsumyōgan’s type, if she carries it, is not known. Her eyes read gray.
Null-Light: Regard not known · Spirit III
II. Soul Architecture

















































Stat lineStage VIII Transcendence · Master (Fire)Level 220 · Refined · Class not knownSpirit VIII Mastered, III · Body VII Walked 35%, II · Lenses: home + 2Level220; it holds Transcendence (201), and no Residual Strain builds in her short of 300StageVIII, Transcendence · Master; the Stage roofs every Sub-Stat at 550PathSpirit VIII Mastered · Body VII Walked 35%MasterySpirit III, Confessor: the lead, read from Level under Transcendence’s ceiling; TSUKUMO, the null-light and the house’s Regards all work at it · Body II, Harmonic: the Walked road, a rung behind her lead; it reads on the kunai and the throwYield (η)about 0.92 through the Core, at Spirit IIILensesthree held, Luminalis, Nyxial and Anamnesis, the Master’s countClassnot knownSoul CrystalFire · RefinedPoints6,648
III. Wellspring Harmonizations













































WellspringFolk nameKindTitanOperationHueDepthWhat it does in herLuminalisthe LampMediumNyseraseparationnear-white with ultraviolet edgesdeepThe hidden light: seeing what hides and hiding what shows, one act run two ways. TSUKUMO’s seeing runs on it, and so does ISHI-KAZOE’s going dark. Strengthens Perception and Feint. Its failure is a split: kept running both ways at once, her workings start to arrive out of step with themselves.Nyxialthe Nocturne FlameSpiritIlgrimmdistillationdeep violet with a small cold flamedeepThe even flame, a self that holds its level whatever the room does. It is the Yukari composure, and the floor the count stands on. Strengthens Stability, Gravity and Constitution. Its failure is windup: everything she refused to feel while she held level comes out at once when the load lifts, which is why the count breaks all in one beat.Anamnesisthe RememberingMediumChronaeusseparationfaded violetheldHer father’s Wellspring, the house current. Everything keeps its past, and what she decompiles she can read back through. Strengthens Retention, Analysis and Anchoring.
Aura: wisteria violet over stone gray, with near-white at the edges when she is reading. Its sound is a river going round a rock.
IV–V. Stats
A normal look shows the Eight Primaries; a Primary is the total of its eight Sub-Stats, read by their mean (Dominion’s over seven, Throne outside it). Room to grow: every Primary sits under the Stage’s cap.


















































PrimaryTotalSub-StatsVitality441Fortitude 50 · Absorption 60 · Constitution 60 · Hemostasis 50 · Regeneration 50 · Filtration 55 · Tolerance 66 · Threshold 50Ardency643Flux 88 · Alacrity 77 · Depth 82 · Penetration 121 · Compression 88 · Cascade 55 · Overchannel 50 · Density 82Gnosis1,584Perception 286 · Acuity 231 · Forecast 198 · Fluency 121 · Retention 209 · Analysis 231 · Cognition 143 · Vigilance 165Dexterity946Celerity 99 · Reflex 143 · Finesse 165 · Economy 132 · Evasion 121 · Grapple 44 · Feint 121 · Sequence 121Harmonics940Attunement 181 · Projection 143 · Breadth 99 · Stability 132 · Empathy 77 · Synergy 88 · Axis 77 · Suppression 143Resilience759Integrity 121 · Ward 187 · Persistence 88 · Anchoring 99 · Fortification 50 · Hardening 44 · Oath 82 · Continuity 88Tempering841Clarity 165 · Overflow 66 · Maturity 88 · Coherence 143 · Tempering Yield 110 · Ceiling 82 · Capacity 121 · Longevity 66Dominion494Radius 60 · Sovereignty 66 · Sense 143 · Gravity 77 · Pressure 49 · Command 44 · Fate 55 · Throne 0
VI. Force of Hand
No measured strike on file. She fights with thrown steel and a reading, and the kunai land where she has already looked.
VII. Aether Flow





























Reserve1,733,165 EU (about 1.7 × 10⁶), held as Essence, by the law of reserves at Level 220Flux Density1,700 EU/gYield (η)about 0.92, Spirit III, Confessor: the loss is small. Through the Shell, at Body II, about 0.80.AU/s1,564 at full output; recomputed at the Spirit III yield of about 0.92 (it read 1,632 at 0.96)From fullabout 18 and a half minutes of full output, far longer counted down
VIII. Traits
Every Trait reads at her lead Mastery, Spirit III.
TSUKUMO (付喪 · 九十九), the Spirit in Things · Primary Trait
TSUKUMO is basically Spiritual Infusion: the power to wake the light in things and to take it apart. In the old tales a tool that serves a hundred years wakes up with a spirit of its own. Senna does not wait the hundred years. She sees the innate light in everything, made or living, the way her father hears its hum, and she can read in it what a thing is made of, how strong it is, and where it is flawed. She can pour her own spirit into an object and wake its light, so a kunai cuts a working or strikes a soul, and a rope or a door holds against things it never could before. She can draw a working’s light into her Core and decompile it, taking it apart into its pieces until she knows how it was built. Once it is apart she can borrow one piece and set it into her own things for a little while, or play the whole light back reversed, as her null-light, so it lies down against the original and cancels it. She can only cancel what she has fully read, and on plain matter a kunai is a kunai. The null-light takes light from everything near her, her own fingers first, and every working she decompiles leaves its light sitting in her Core. Take in too much and her own color starts to go.
ISHI-KAZOE (石数え), the Stone Count · Secondary Trait
ISHI-KAZOE is basically Presence Concealment held by a count. The Yukari count is an old family art, a way of measuring a breath and a heartbeat to the beat. Senna’s is her own version, built for one blood, and she counts down. Breath by breath and beat by beat she slows herself, and as she slows, her own light dims, until a reader looking straight at her sees a stone where a girl should be. While she is counted down no one can read her, track her by her light, or feel her coming, and anything that answers to motion or pressure, like the Sin’s glass that stiffens against whatever strikes it fast, lets her walk through because she is too slow to wake it. She reads every light in the room and gives back none of her own. The price is all her speed. Counted down she moves like someone wading, her lips go pale and cold, and gray creeps in at the edges of her sight. Make her hurry and the count breaks all at once, every bit of her light coming back in a single beat, where anyone watching can see it.
The house instrument
Null-Light, Ashura’s own, climbs on her Spirit Mastery. Its price is the Long Look: what she has held she keeps knowing for life, and when she looks away everything held slips at once. Which Regard she holds is not known. The canceling light she threw on the Kessen road is TSUKUMO’s.
IX. Domain
None found yet. Anyone at Stage VIII may have one, and a Yukari’s tends to form round her uncalled.
X. Techniques
KARASU (烏), the Crow · Signature Technique
Her aunt Naevra’s kunai are plain folded steel with cedar handles, a ring at the pommel and a crow punched into each blade, and they carry no working at all. Senna wakes one. She pours TSUKUMO into the steel until the crow stamped on it opens its eyes, and it comes off the metal as a living spirit of black light, a crow the size of a hawk with her violet in the sheen of its wings. It flies at her word and sees what she would see. It carries her reading and her null-light anywhere she sends it, so the Yukari, called the crows of the threshold, fight again with the family’s own bird, woken out of a blade from the family’s own forge. When she calls it home it folds back into the steel, and the kunai drops into her hand still warm. The crow is her light, so whatever it suffers she feels, and a wing broken in the field is an arm gone numb at her side. It cannot fly while ISHI-KAZOE has her counted down; she chooses, every time, between hiding and the bird.

MIHARI (見張り), the Lookout · The crow scouts ahead and reads for her at a distance. Whatever it sees, she can read with TSUKUMO as if she stood there.
TSUIBAMU (啄む), the Peck · The crow strikes a working and tears out a beakful of its light, then carries it home to her Core to be decompiled.
KAZAKIRI (風切り), the Wind-Cutter · The crow folds its wings and dives as a streak of null-light, canceling a working she has already read along its whole path.
KAERI (帰り), the Return · Any kunai of hers in the crow’s reach comes home: the crow catches it in flight and turns it back to her hand.

The null-light
Her canceling light, played back reversed down a spinning kunai. First landed on the Kessen road after a year of failing at it every evening.
XI. Spirit Axes

Naiser Yukari (father) Let her and Hiromi take the Sin on the Kessen road, and watched her land the light she had failed at for a year.
Hiromi Mahuo Raised beside her in the Enclave. She sets his collar straight with two quick tugs, and on the Kessen road he hollowed the glass around her first, so she could breathe.
Naevra Yukari (aunt) Her kunai.
Vaashuuk Snorr-Khal, the Sin of Sloth She cut him twice and kept his gold ring. He owes the Yukari payback and has not finished collecting it.

XII. Resistances

Gnosis 1,584, Perception 286, Ward 187: she reads before she is read, and reads are hard to land on her.
Counted down: while ISHI-KAZOE holds she cannot be read or tracked by her light.
Hurry: make her rush and both traits break, since TSUKUMO needs the time to read and the count needs her slow.
Unmatched workings: a working she cannot read whole has nothing for her null-light to match.
The crow: what hurts it hurts her.
Body: Vitality 441. The house is lean and breakable, and she is of the house.

XIII. Physical Description
Hair: Violet, worn long in a braid and tied back hard at the nape with a gray cord.
Eyes: Gray.
Bearing: Sits straight with her hands folded. The Yukari composure was a coat cut too big for her as a child, and she meant to grow into it.
Carries: Two kunai on rings, and the habit of catching one on her finger and letting it spin twice before it stops.
XIV. Psychology
How she moves: Slow when she is reading and very fast when she has finished. Counting under her breath is the tell.
Voice: Quiet and exact, her father’s habit of putting a sentence away where she can find it again.
Underneath: She refuses a yawn in company and swallows it whole. She practiced a thing every evening for a year and failed every evening, and when it finally came on the Kessen road the composure fell off her for one instant, and what was under it was a girl who knew what she had done.
XV. Equipment

































ItemWhat it isGradeRarityNoteNaevra’s kunaiplain folded steel, hollow-ground, cedar handles, pommel rings, the crow punched inplainRareno working of their own; KARASU wakes the crowThe Sin’s gold ringa gold ring torn from the ear of Vaashuuk Snorr-Khalnot knownnot knownkeptThe gray cordties her hair at the napeplainCommon—
XVI. Temperance Record

Stages I to VII: crossed in the Cedar Enclave and on the road. Details not known.
Stage VIII, Transcendence: crossed into the Master’s rank. Details not known.
Next gate: Stage IX, Invocation; it holds at Level 215, which her 220 already passes, so only the Catalyst is wanting; past Level 300 without it she would come into Residual Strain.

XVII. Fracture Log

On the Kessen road, with Hiromi, faced Vaashuuk Snorr-Khal, the Sin of Sloth. Walked under his glass on her Stone Count, cut the tendons of two of his fingers and tore his ear with its ring, and had her right shoulder dislocated when his held glass caught her at full speed.
Landed the null-light for the first time on that road, canceling the Sin’s glass down the spinning kunai, and read him aloud to her father: he looks at whatever is taking something from him, and he cannot finish.
At Kharven-Seat, came into the great hall behind her father and set Hiromi’s collar straight before she sat on the Zettari bench.

characters/volume-i-—-character-cards/sh.content:
Shōki Kurenai MotoThe Sin of Wrath · Moto, Kurenai line · as of the present reckoning, three centuries after the HallEpithetThe Sin of Wrath. VIII. Traits
Full accounts: Sodoku Moto — Abilities
Every Trait reads at his lead Mastery, Fate I.
EN-MUSUBI (縁結び), the Tying of Fates · Primary Trait
EN-MUSUBI is basically Node Manipulation: the power to see where things are going to meet, and to tie, tighten or untie those meetings. Sodoku sees the world as threads of fate crossing each other, and wherever two of them cross there is a knot, a node: a sword and a throat, a cart and a bridge, two people who are going to meet at a gate. He sees those knots before anyone else does, and he can work them. He can pull two fates together so they meet, tie a knot so tight the meeting cannot be avoided, or slip one loose so two things miss each other by a hair. He never forces anything. He only ties what already has a road between it, so the world never feels pushed; it simply seems to have been going that way all along. That is why they call him the Author of Fate: things around him come together as if he had written them. The price is that he is always one end of the knot. Everything he ties runs a thread through him, anyone who can read fate can read every bond he holds, and when a bond he tied breaks, he feels it go.
INOCHIZUNA (命綱), the Lifeline · Secondary Trait
INOCHIZUNA is basically Bond Empowerment: the power to grow stronger whenever someone he is tied to is in danger. It was born the night Mizuyi was taken, when her thread went south, pulled tight, and Sodoku felt every inch of it go. Since then every bond he holds is a lifeline. When someone tied to him is threatened he can feel their thread no matter how far away they are: which way it runs, whether it is fraying, whether they are hurt or afraid. While they are in danger his body and his power rise to meet it. He is faster, harder to stop, and his knots pull tighter. The more people he is standing for, the stronger he gets, so he is at his most dangerous with his whole family behind him. The price is that the line runs both ways. He feels a little of what they feel, so their fear and pain come to him through the knot. If someone on the other end of a lifeline dies, he feels that too.
Blessing
The limitless potential of Attraction Force. The Moto blood opens Fate early and, without a Work, stops it at II; the blessing is a grip, and for Sodoku the cap lifts to his Stage’s ceiling.
IX. Domain
None.
X. Techniques
AKAI ITO (赤い糸), the Red Thread · Signature Art
AKAI ITO is basically Threads of Fate Manipulation: the power to make fate’s threads visible as red string, and to tie them together or cut them apart. When Sodoku calls it, the threads come out of hiding, fine red strings running between everything in the room: the sword and the throat, the arrow and its mark, a soldier and his friends, a fighter and their own power. He works them like a weaver. Whatever he ties together has to meet, and whatever he cuts is left completely alone. His tying side makes him the Author, arranging meetings so neatly that people think they chose them. His cutting side is where the doku in his name comes from, “alone, the severed one,” and it is the side people learn to fear. Under all of it is Attraction Force, the thing that holds bonds, Domains and a soul’s tie to its Wellspring together, so when Sodoku cuts deep enough, a fighter’s allies cannot reach them, their Domain falls apart, and their own power stops answering.
The tying

DEAI (出会い), the Meeting · He ties his blade to a target’s thread, and the cut has to arrive. Dodging only changes where it lands.
SURECHIGAI (すれ違い), Passing By · He loosens the knot between an attack and its target, and the blow misses by a hair.
TSUJI (辻), the Crossroads · He pulls every thread on the field to one point. Enemies collide, and arrows meet arrows in the air.
MUSUBIME (結び目), the Final Knot · He ties an enemy’s whole fate to one ending, so every move they make leads back to it.

The cutting

HANARE (離れ), Apart · He cuts one bond, and an ally cannot reach them.
HITORI (一人), Alone · He cuts every ally in reach, and help always arrives too late.
KODOKU (孤独), Solitude · The finisher. He cuts them off from everything, their own power included. Their Domain collapses, their Wellspring goes silent, and they stand in the world as if nothing has ever known them.

The price: he is always one end of every thread he touches, so he feels every bond he cuts. Cutting someone he is tied to cuts him too. KODOKU is the one he cannot take back.
Combo with Sonzai (unnamed; they argue about it): Sodoku ties a target’s thread to one spot with MUSUBIME, and Sonzai brings TATARIGAMI down on the knot. The calamity cannot miss, because the meeting was already written.
XI. Spirit Axes

Muken Moto (father) The beads he carries are his father’s, jade and iron, worn smooth by Muken’s thumb for twenty years before his own. On the night Mizuyi was taken Muken laid a hand on his head and said nothing, and that was enough.
Amelia Greymane (mother) He has her Greymane stance, and the wry thinning of the mouth that his Greymane uncle makes a moment before he speaks.
Sonzai (brother) The one he catches. Sonzai is the bond his brother’s obsession cannot eat, and Sodoku is the only thing between him and the bottom.
Mizuyi (sister) Her thread runs south, pulled tight and not fraying. He can feel it.
Rashani Zettari Thanked for her hand, and told House Moto accepts the help of House Zettari.

XII. Resistances

Ward 66, Oath 123, Anchoring 100: what he has sworn and who he is hold steady under pressure better than his Resilience suggests.
Fate: his bonds are legible. Anyone who reads fate well can read every thread he holds, and a strong enough hand can pull on him through them.
Body: Vitality 378. He is not built to take a hit, and knows it.

XIII. Physical Description
Hair: Fair gold, straight, falling past the jaw and parted loose at the brow; tied back for the crown at court.
Eyes: Pale blue, with the three ring-lines of the Moto eye visible in the iris even at rest, the outer ring flaring a faint cold gold when his attention moves.
Face: Long and composed, too still for thirteen, the mouth given to a slight wry thinning.
Dress: A heavy brocade coat of blue-gray worked in a darker floral pattern, a great collar of pale gray fur over both shoulders, and under it a high-collared tunic of dark green-black closed with braided frogs, banded at the chest in white with a chain of pale embossed rosettes.
Carries: His father’s beads, jade and iron, at his belt, reached for when no one is watching.
XIV. Psychology
How he moves: Slow iron cadence, silences that count, and a body that moves before he decides to. He walks the Greymane way, every step set down as if the floor had been warned of it.
Voice: Low and level, never raised. In the court register every word goes down in its full form, with no shortening anywhere. He jokes only by accident.
Underneath: He was raised to read two rooms at once, the people and the politics. When the house breaks, he stands up and is the king for an hour so the king does not have to. He does not cry where anyone can see it.
