materials,-alchemy--and--trade/materials.content:
The sixty-one attested formulas · second edition, the Measurewrights’ physical reading
Corrin Sloe, called Featherback, told the whole Lantern Fair at Marl Harbor that he would step off the gilded bell tower nine times before supper and walk away from all nine, and he did it, in a goose-yellow coat, with half the harbor on the roofs and the children screaming his name. One dose of Grace Fall Draught, properly made by a properly sworn apothecary. Each time he hit the cobbles, rolled, stood and bowed, with a bruise and nothing worse, and each jump came from a higher window than the last, until he went off the very finial with a torch in each hand and the crowd threw so many flowers that the square smelled like a wedding. They carried him to the Guildhall supper on a door. Halfway through the goose, with a cup in one hand and a leg in the other, the dose’s window closed, and all nine falls arrived together. The bench went, and the floor under the bench, and the surgeon who set what could be set counted forty-four breaks and reported to the harbor-reeve that the man had plainly fallen from a great height, at dinner.
Sloe took six days to die and spent them dictating a complaint against the apothecary, who produced his batch notes and was acquitted, because the batch was excellent. It did everything its row below says it does, down to the last line of the row. That is why I love this index above every other book in the Guild’s keeping. Every failure in it comes out of the same place as the success, and whoever reads both columns may be sorry, but will never be surprised.

Every entry carries the Measurewrights’ account, an analogue and a mechanism stated in the analogue’s own terms, and a failure that falls out of the same place as the success. A formula works by its Wellspring’s idea, which the Sixty give with its Operation; the account beside it is the guild’s, often right about how much and never about why, and the names it gives the failures are theirs.
Nothing in an ingredient list is symbolic filler. Each component supplies a catalytic surface, a nucleation site, a stabilizing lattice, or a Wellspring-resonant trace, by the guild’s reading, and each material brings its virtue to the vessel. Where a step specifies darkness, silence or a season, it is specifying a condition the working needs and not a mood, and this edition says which.
Provenance Grade (the mark of where a stock came from, from Grade I, taken off a Wellspring site and carrying nothing, up to Class VI, found and unlocatable) is now stated on every row, because the Standing Index prices on it and this index has been silent on it since compilation. Twelve entries below are Class IV or above, and eight of them were carried for years without the column that would have said so. Four more reach Grade IV when their source bore a Crystal, and a source that bore a Crystal is lawful when it was a monster’s core and a hanging when it was a person’s.
The Essence Drafts rendered from monster cores for tempering, which pay for most of the benches in this book, are not among the sixty-one, since a lot follows its beast and has no fixed formula to enter. They are on The Common Drafts.
A word on the analogues. The Guild’s scholars reason from the law underneath a thing, which they read through the Aether, and they will cheerfully compare a salve to a device no living smith could build. Kindly do not write to me asking where to buy one.

The bench copy of every formula here, with its ingredients, method, effect, risk and its working by its Wellspring’s idea, is the Alchemical Formulary.
T2 · Apprentice Work





























FormulaWellspring · Kind · ClassThe Measurewrights’ account: analogue and mechanismFailureEquilibrium Draught Liquid tonic · Ur, MeJudicium · Wild Grade IIAnalogue · negative feedback control. A regulated system holding setpoint against disturbance. Mechanism · Raises the Shell’s damping coefficient so emotional transients are attenuated on the way out instead of amplified. Output stops tracking mood. The balanced salt-pair is the working part; the mirrored glass keeps the batch from coupling to the room while it settlesOver-damping. A system damped past critical no longer answers a genuine signal either. Long reliance flattens affect, and peak Resonance becomes unreachable because the peak is suppressed by the same mechanism that suppresses the panicVeilthread Salve Topical · Vl, KaOneirion · Spirit Grade IIAnalogue · index matching. A boundary reflects in proportion to how different the two media are. Match them and it stops returning anything. Mechanism · Lays a layer whose Essence permittivity matches local ambient, so the wearer’s edge produces no return for a scrying sense to find. Nothing is hiding them. The boundary simply has nothing to reflectIndex matching works both ways. A boundary that returns nothing outward is one the wearer’s own Core cannot locate from inside. Prolonged use produces genuine dissociation and the specific complaint that the wearer cannot tell where they stopEcho-Bloom Incense Incense · Ae, YnOneirion / Verdantia · Spirit Grade IIIAnalogue · thermoluminescence. Fired material accumulates trapped states and releases them as light when heated. Mechanism · The smoke supplies the excitation that empties a site’s trapped Residue into visible emission. The hair of the focus is a tuning element, narrowing the release to one record among manyReading is destructive. Each burning empties what it reads and a site burned repeatedly has less to give. The loop users describe is the same shallow remnant returning, because the deep record went on the first pass, and sentiment has no part in it
T3 · Trade Standard

























































































FormulaWellspring · Kind · ClassThe Measurewrights’ account: analogue and mechanismFailureVeilstone Tincture Liquid reagent · Vl, ElOneirion · Spirit Grade IIAnalogue · the noise floor. A signal is undetectable when it falls below the background of whatever is looking. Mechanism · Attenuates the Signature’s amplitude rather than masking it. Six hours, because the dreamstone’s absorption saturates and stops taking up outputThreshold effects. A quieter background raises the risk rather than lowering it: against a strong reader in a silent room the attenuated signal is above the floor again. Overdose trains the Shell to under-emit permanently and the wearer loses their own reference levelNull-Salt Anti-reagent · Nul, VnNihiloth · Wild Grade IAnalogue · destructive interference. Two fields in antiphase sum to zero and the region between carries nothing. Mechanism · Releases a counter-phase field matched to an array’s boundary condition. One vial cancels one array because the release is a fixed quantity and the sum has to balance. Ground in silence because vibration during grinding seeds phase noise into the batchCancellation is symmetric and consults nobody. Contact with living Essence nulls the bearer’s own boundary in the same measure, and it is cumulative because each contact removes the structure that would have resisted the nextTide-Silt Compress Battlefield · Let, DrnAbyntheus / Phreatis · Spirit Grade IIIAnalogue · dialysis. A semipermeable barrier and a concentration gradient move solute out of a body without moving the body. Mechanism · The silt establishes a gradient against overcharged tissue and Essence crosses toward the lower concentration until the two equalize. It stabilizes Splintering overcharge for the same reason a dialysate stabilizes a poisoned manA gradient does not distinguish solutes. Past equilibrium it goes on drawing, and what it draws after the excess is Vitality. The clock is not printed on the packet and the dressing stations know it by feelCinder-Salt Glyph Wash Cleansing · Cin, XrPyraeon / Catharsis · Wild Grade IAnalogue · pickling. A controlled acid lifts oxide and scale without attacking sound metal, because the two present different surfaces. Mechanism · Oxidizes law-fragments preferentially, because a fragment is an unsealed working and therefore chemically available in a way a closed inscription is not. The framework survives because the framework is finishedOver-pickling. Left on past the fragment’s removal it starts on the base, and a sound inscription with a marginal Sealing role is close enough to a fragment that the wash cannot tell. Accord kits carry a sandglass and the sandglass is ignoredLantern Resin Solid resin · Ma, AeAnamnesis / Oneirion · Medium Grade IIAnalogue · remanent magnetization. A material cooling through its transition records the field it cooled in and holds it indefinitely. Mechanism · The resin cures through its own transition around whatever field state is present, fixing one scene as structure. Slow-cured in darkness because light during cure adds a second field to the recordSuperposition. Resin exposed to more than one strong field during cure records their sum, and a summed field holds one incoherent scene where two were meant, and nothing separates them afterwardVeyric Sparkwine Alchemical wine · Ve, RaIgnivale / Exuroth · Wild Grade IIIAnalogue · activation energy. The spark that lights a fuel-air mixture carries a fraction of a millijoule and everything after is the reaction paying for itself. Mechanism · Lowers the barrier to Essence formation. Expression initiates faster and cheaper, felt as decisiveness and read on a coil as reduced latencyThe barrier does not come back up on schedule. Preignition follows: workings initiating on ambient emotional charge with no decision behind them. And a lowered barrier is self-reinforcing, because reduced cost is experienced as capability, which is the whole architecture of the dependencyStillgate Ash Powder · Au, SilMortalis · Medium Grade IIIAnalogue · grounding. A high-conductivity path to earth lets a residual charge complete instead of persisting at potential. Mechanism · The ring is a conductor. A body’s residual field after death sits at potential relative to the ground beneath it, and the ash gives it somewhere to go. A haunting is a charge with no pathA conductor grounds whatever touches it. Living Essence at the ring bleeds toward the same earth, which is the numbness and the broken sleep. The circle is drawn around the dead and the living stand outside it, for a reason that long predates anyone explaining the reasonChoirglass Phials Alchemical glass · Se, ChwThaloré · Spirit Grade IIAnalogue · sympathetic resonance. Two oscillators at the same natural frequency exchange energy with no conductor between them. Mechanism · Sung through the whole melt so the glass sets with one natural frequency throughout. Contents entrain to it, and stacked phials couple so the array sumsResonant catastrophe. A structure with a sharp natural frequency and low internal loss has no defense against being driven at that frequency. A discordant voice supplying the right pitch feeds the phial until the glass cannot carry the amplitudeVerdant Overgrowth Seeds Seed-reagent · El, YnVerdantia · Wild Grade IIIAnalogue · indeterminate meristematic growth. Tissue that stays embryonic for the organism’s whole life and converts ambient input into structure continuously. Mechanism · Removes the growth-limiting signal, so the thicket has no final size and no scheduled stop. Sun-baked a full cycle because the sigil must hold through germination and a green casing fails on soil contactThere is no termination condition in the mechanism. Malice has no part in it. It overruns allies because nothing in it was told to finish, and pruning fails for the same reason. A blight is required, and a blight is a second problem arriving to solve the firstNull-Resonance Buffer Suspension · Nl, ArNihiloth / Thaloré · Wild Grade IIAnalogue · a notch filter. Attenuation across one narrow band with the rest of the spectrum passed intact. Mechanism · The choirstone sets the notch and the null-salt trace supplies the attenuation. The drinker’s own output passes; a null field at the filtered frequency does not. Agitated constantly because the suspension separates and a separated buffer filters nothingThe notch is a resonance and a resonance can be driven. A strong Choir supplying energy at exactly the filtered frequency drives the buffer inside the drinker, and what stuns them is their own countermeasure ringingVector Piercing Draught Alchemical oil · Vt, WyIgnivale / Cataclysm · Wild Grade IIAnalogue · anisotropic friction. A climbing skin’s hairs lie one way, so the ski glides forward and grips backward. Mechanism · Worked into fletching and shaft in the direction of flight, the oil lays a grain that passes air and fiber one way. A crosswind moves a shaft by an amount set by the drag it carries, so lower drag is less wind drift, and lower friction in the wound channel is momentum carried through padding and mail. Worked against the grain it lays the grain backward and the batch is ruinedA grain that passes one way grips the other. A shaft loosed against its treated grain carries its drag at the point. With the center of pressure ahead of the center of mass it turns end for end at release, the way a shuttlecock always turns cork-first, and the point comes back into the draw handAperture Wound Ichor Battlefield · Ap, ElPhreatis / Verdantia · Medium Grade IIIAnalogue · anticoagulated drainage. A medicinal leech’s saliva keeps a bite bleeding long after the leech is gone, and an open wet wound drains what is in it. Mechanism · The elderwood sap holds clotting off at the edges and the tide-ichor keeps the bed wet, so the wound stays at the width the compress sets. Poison, infection and foreign Essence leave by the same road as the blood, and the blood is the price. Applied inside the first minute because a clot that has already formed seals the poison in with it. Cut wrong, initiation happens in the alchemist’s hand and propagation is over before the mistake is noticedPyric Refinement Ash · Ra, Asa · PrometheusExuroth · Wild Grade IIIAnalogue · refining at a fixed oxidation potential. Everything bound below the threshold is removed and everything above survives, and the threshold does not negotiate. Mechanism · Burns whatever is not bonded strongly enough to persist. The fragment of genuine regret sets the threshold, which is why a false one produces ash that will not form: the potential has nothing to calibrate againstA threshold is a number and sentiment is not exempt from it. It cannot distinguish a false conviction from a true attachment that happens to be bound more weakly. It burns cleanly and it does not burn kindlyFossil Ring Dust · Cro, Len · ChronaeusLethegraal · Spirit Class VIAnalogue · shortening a relaxation constant. Drive a stalled system toward its equilibrium faster than it would have arrived alone. Mechanism · Shortens the constant on a stagnant conflict or era so it reaches the resolution it was already heading toward. It removes the delay and chooses nothing about the resolution. Twin ampoules never opened together, because two shortened constants in one system have no common equilibrium. Fossilized dead seconds are found rather than rendered, which makes this the only Class VI in the indexShortened constants under-damp. The system overshoots its resolution and oscillates around it, and repeated dosing on one Domain produces oscillation deep enough to read as a loop. The suspiciously short centuries in the record are the overshoot rather than the correctionPressure Burst Capsule Combat alchemical · Prc, ClpSublimare / Fractura · Wild Grade IIAnalogue · cavitation collapse. A bubble collapsing beside a hard surface rebounds and fires a jet into it, and those jets will pit bronze. Mechanism · The sealed vacuum is the bubble. Impact starts the collapse, the surrounding air drives it inward, and the rebound delivers one pulse at the point of contact. The energy is the ambient pressure times the void’s volume, fixed and small, which is why the dent goes through plate and ceramic and the blast goes nowhere. Blown thin enough to hum under a tapped fingernail because a thin shell’s pitch reports its wall. Sealed before the glass cools past clarity because clouding glass has begun to crystallize, and a crystallized wall does not behave as a shellA thin sphere under outside pressure has a buckling load, and it falls fast as the wall thins. Too thick and impact cracks the glass before the shell can buckle, and it shatters as plain glass. Too thin and the air alone exceeds the buckling load, and it collapses in the maker’s hand
T7 · Grandmaster























FormulaWellspring · Kind · ClassThe Measurewrights’ account: analogue and mechanismFailureNull-Essence Draught · Thru, Au · Zar’thuunNihiloth · Wild Class VIAnalogue · destructive interference into a true null. Two fields in antiphase sum to zero and the region between carries no energy at all. Mechanism · Sums an overaccumulation to nothing rather than moving it elsewhere, which is why it cleanses without violence and why nothing remains afterward to account for. A name willingly forgotten is the antiphase reference, and the surrender is the working rather than a price attached to it. Never named while brewing, because naming supplies the phase the draft is built to cancelCancellation is symmetric and has no radius of intent. It takes small records from everyone in the room along with the excess. The mercy and the erasure are one act performed once, and no version has ever separated themStillwater Draught · Vor, Cro · VohrinVohrin · Titan-touched Grade IIAnalogue · metastable supercooling. A liquid held below its transition with no nucleation site available will not change state, in either direction, indefinitely. Mechanism · Removes every nucleation site from the subject’s condition. A wound cannot worsen and cannot close, because both require somewhere to begin. Drawn without a ripple and never allowed to move again, because agitation is nucleation and one ripple ends the workingA system with no available sites eventually loses the capacity to form them. Held too long the subject loses more than the change: they stop having a direction to change toward, which is Vohrin’s law, and what the trade means by calling long use a mercy killing under another name

materials,-alchemy--and--trade/materials.content:
Consolidated substrate register · T0 through T9 · all four quarters
Nessa Hegg was ringer at the Ormsby winding house for fourteen years, and the whole of her duty was to stand under a bell and pull a rope if the Weight Ablation glyph (the inscription that halves a load so a winding rope can bear it) ever failed. It failed at the change of shift. A cage of ore that had weighed twenty tons came to forty between one breath and the next, and everything else the glyph had been holding up came to its true weight with it: the drum tore out of its bed, the great timber headframe began to lean, and the bell tower stood on the same footings as the headframe. Nessa Hegg could see exactly how it would end, because she was looking at it through the louvers. She rang. She rang while the rope of the cage went through the roof and the floor under her took on a slope a mule could not have climbed, and six hundred and twelve men and women down in the dark heard her and went up the ladderways and out by the old adit, and when the tower finally lay down across the yard they dug her out with the palms gone from her hands and the rope still in them.
Ormsby Deep buried her on a blazing blue morning with nine mining lodges behind her and their banners up, scarlet and gold and lodge-green, along the Aerne, which runs the color of a ripe apricot because the old workings have been bleeding vitriol into it for longer than the town has had a name. Six hewers carried the coffin. Four more carried the bell rope, forty fathoms of it, coiled on a litter like a bishop. The Accord’s entry for that day is in the second table below, in the same words as its entry for every other such day.
This is the dullest book the Guild of Measurewrights (the assayers and scholars who survey, measure and argue over everything) has ever produced, and I would carry it out of a fire ahead of my own bed. It says what the world is made of, tier by tier and quarter by quarter, what each thing costs the hands that dig it up, and which of its sources nobody can find, all of it in tables, in the voice of a clerk who has never once been surprised. Nessa Hegg is in here as half a sentence. Read it as a miner reads a roof.

Compiled from the Guild of Measurewrights’ survey, the standing Accord material list, the coin volume, the Four Ceilings technology history, and the Master Codex alchemical tab.

The Tier Scale


















































































TierAccord nameWhat it means for materialBeast Grade and title overlapExampleT0FragileFails at ordinary handling. Symbolic, disposable, or single-night workBelow commission gradeMireclay; Coalglass ShardT1SoftWorkable by an apprentice. Real properties, no durabilityE · Green Sigil, InitiateVellun Copper; Palebed NitreT2Common DurableThe material the world is actually built out of. Bulk supplyD · Green Sigil, ApprenticeForge-Iron; Greystone; ChainsaltT3HardenedSurvives sustained use and takes a working that lastsC · Green Sigil, JourneymanBlacktooth Wolfram; OnceglassT4Reinforced MagicalPurpose-made or purpose-found for Essence work. Instrument gradeB · Blue Sigil, AdeptClearbeam Beryl; Cloudmetal; StormfulgurT5Rare / Spirit-ForgedRequires a forge-array, a rite, or a corpse. Not bought casuallyA · Blue Sigil, ExpertAethersteel; Bloodsilver; GloomhideT6Arcane-ResistantRefuses a category of working outright rather than resisting itS · Gold Sigil, MasterGrimbarite; Soulquartz; FrostwoolT7Titan-ForgedEra-one product or Titan remnant. Found, not madeSS · Gold Sigil, GrandmasterTitanstone; Drakehide SteelT8Mythic / CelestialFormed by cosmological event. No terrestrial process reaches it. Operates on Name, Fate, timeX · Obsidian Seal, ArchmasterChronoglass; Eclipsium; Abythros ThreadT9Transcendent / ForbiddenActs on the law rather than within it. Proscribed. Nullifies or rewritesEX · Obsidian Seal, ParagonCrevice Shale; Nullglass; Ash of Names

Every T8 and T9 entry in the register is Holding-grade. There is no transcendent building material, and the absence is structural rather than accidental: at T8 and above the material stops being something you build with and becomes something that acts.
A material’s tier is what it can hold, and a finished piece carries two more marks of its own: a Grade for power, on the same letters the Commission posts beasts by, and a Rarity for scarcity, Common through Unique. The smith’s title caps the Grade she may make and the merchant’s title caps the Rarity he may sell. See Grade and Rarity.

The Hazard Register
How the trade kills the people who work it.
An array is a working laid out in glyph and substrate to run in place, kept by hired tenders, and a deep mine’s pumps and air both hang on one. A Core, in common speech, is a worked Wellspring site, and its keepers can close it.

















































































































HazardOnsetEffectRecorded positionArray failure, pumping western deep workings70 to 110 hours depending on shaftFlooding. Mass drowningThe most likely mass-casualty event in the four quarters and the one the Accord is least prepared for. Mitigation: contracts with more than one array house and more than one Core keeper, since either can close; nothing else worksArray failure, ventilation all deep workingsWithin the hourFiredamp in coal, blackdamp in metalKills faster than water and is more easily concealed afterward. Mitigation: a wet hood and a candle on a pole, which is what it was beforeWeight Ablation glyph failure all winding housesInstantaneousTotal restoration of true loadMitigation is a bell, rung by hand. No contraption built to give the warning has ever been fast enoughSulfide roast fume Kaetran RingChronicVegetation loss to six leagues and risingNone attempted. Shows no sign of stoppingVitriol drainage western old workingsChronic, cumulativeOrange rivers; nothing lives above the tidal reachNone at current practice. IrreversibleRock dust, silicate western slate beltsTwenty yearsGrinder’s coughSimply what happens to men who breathe rock dust for twenty yearsRock dust, fibrous serpentine southern coastal quarriesTwenty years after leaving the tradeLung scarring, invariably fatalEnforcement has posted no writ and the quarries have raised no objection to the absenceLahar eastern volcanic plainsMinutesA river of wet ash moving at the speed of a horseMitigation: distance. Does not leave bodies to buryFumarole gas pooling eastern sulfur fieldsImmediateSilent asphyxiation in hollowsDo not descend after a casualty. Kills rescue parties secondWellspring drift eastern quarterSeasons to yearsThe source site thins or shifts; the working is strandedEconomic rather than physical. Has bankrupted more eastern ventures than every eruption in recorded history combinedTender’s shake all array houses, all quarters~8 years of serviceFine persistent palsy of the hands. PermanentMitigation: hire young and hire in numbers. No compensation scheme exists in any quarterCrevice proximity southern marginUndescribedUndescribedFour-league exclusion line, revised outward five times in the last sixty yearsLead smelting western limestone beltYearsUndocumented in the ledger; the trade says the men do not lastRecorded in one clause and not elaboratedBloodsilver rejection anywhere it is heldOver timeBurns or corrodes an unworthy holderMitigation: be the right bloodline. The only item in the Arbitration schedules that can attack the bailiffCore-lip residue every city with a worked CoreTwenty years of serviceIn practitioners, clouding of the Shell (the Crystal’s outer layer, the skin power passes through on the way out) and Trait flicker without corresponding Essence Starvation. In the unawakened, nothing an instrument is calibrated to reportCore-tenders work the lip of a worked pool at densities that would be logged as an Active Concentration (a density that alters bodies over time) if a surveyor found the reading in open country. The trade has a word for the late stage and no company document contains it. No baseline is taken, because no baseline exists for men without CrystalsUnsealed field any ground worked by engine or wheelCumulative, undatedCoherence falls with no change in conduct. The Crystal is conditioned by boundaries nobody set and cannot findA hazard of the ground the material came out of, rather than of any material, and it does not clear when the working stops because the working never closed. An engine here is Mechanica’s kind, built apparatus that takes power with no practitioner present, and a shop’s Essence Wheel run hard and long leaves the same field. Renderers can identify a long-service wheel-man on the table by the Shell alone, and several of them will not say so on a recordBench exposure all alchemical houses~20 yearsDocumented in Alchemetrica and nowhere in this register until nowThe trade’s private estimate is that a pure alchemist has twenty good years. The trade’s public position is that the estimate is unproven. Both statements are made by the same people, frequently in the same week
Unresolved Provenance
Materials in continuous trade whose source the Accord cannot locate.

Senoth Vellun Copper’s source hills. Placed in the western quarter on trade-route evidence only. Four surveys have failed to confirm it.
Rovann Glassroot Fibers and Steelsilk Cord. Two separate Accord records place it in two separate quarters. Both cannot be right and neither has been withdrawn.
Tirres Willowblood Sap. Does not appear on any current Accord survey.
Ilcindor Moonblight Ore. Does not appear on any current Accord survey.
Ghoststeel attributed to the northern shield on ruin-siting evidence alone. No crucible reproduction has ever succeeded.
Seerstone Resin attributed provisionally to eastern cloud forest canopy species. Unconfirmed by Archives.

Two further entries the Measurewrights record as open. Whether the Crevice is geology at all: the Guild declines to certify it as a fault in any sense. And whether the Kaetran Ring’s passages are caused by the impact structure or merely coincident with it: the correlation is too exact to be accident and too unexamined to be asserted.
One inference is recorded and marked as such. Silver’s Resonance is given as person-addressed binding, drawn from Bloodsilver and Dawnsilver behavior, and the substrate tables name basalt, quartz, iron, gold and obsidian and are silent on silver.
The Grade IV Shortfall
The register’s oldest arithmetic problem, stated plainly for once.
Grade IV, Crystal Draw, is material rendered from something that carried a Soul Crystal. The lawful article is a monster’s core, which is in a way its Soul Crystal and is worth more the stronger the monster, and the Bench keeps three old warrants for the Trait tissue of the human dead. The volume in circulation has never matched what those sources can account for, and the discrepancy has been carried in the Bench’s own returns for as long as the returns have existed.
The Measurewrights’ position is that the gap is a recording failure. It is a supply.

A Crystal cut from a dead practitioner renders into the strongest Draft of all. It is the worst crime in every realm and the most profitable, and most of the gap is this, sold on as monster core. Below it, extraction produces Grade IV material as a by-product and engine work produces it at volume. An operator pulling Essence off a donor renders nothing on purpose; the residue simply accumulates, and it is indistinguishable on the coil from lawfully rendered stock because the process that made it was the same process, performed without a warrant.
This is why the arithmetic will not balance and cannot be made to. The missing tonnage has no lawful source because it had no lawful origin, and every factor between the operator and the bench is buying in good faith from somebody who is also buying in good faith.

The three tells, which the better houses check and the rest do not.
Residue that does not disperse on the finished stock. Lawful rendering leaves a trace that thins on schedule. Grade IV taken out of a cut Crystal or an unsealed operation carries a residue that holds, because the operation it came from never closed.
Instrument disagreement. The coil reads a Holding figure, the assay fork reads a density, and on unlawful stock the two do not reconcile. The discrepancy is the size of what was taken. Two instruments and somebody willing to compare them is the whole of the test and most benches own one instrument.
A provenance that runs out. Lawful Grade IV has a rendering house, a date and a beast or a body. Unlawful Grade IV has a factor, a price, and a supplier who is three towns away and reliably difficult to visit.

The connection between this section and the six entries above it stands unasserted and available to anybody who reads them in order, and the Measurewrights have declined to draw it in print four times.



The Material Index · T0–T4
The Material Index · T5–T9
The Alchemical Index

T0 through T4 · the ground, the bulk supply, and the first instrument grades.
The longest suit ever heard in the Dorrosfenn basins was fought over a barge. The wheat-growers of the Upper Fenn had spread Marrowchalk on their fields for sixty years, at a price they considered their birthright, until the sect of the Chalk Hall set up on the far bank in robes the green of old copper and began outbidding them by the load for the same rock, for purposes of their own. The growers sued. Mother Yevane of the Chalk Hall came to the first hearing with her witnesses walking two by two behind her: thirty-seven dead wheat-growers in their good coats, who had between them spread more Marrowchalk than any man living, and who stood in the well of the court with their hats in their hands while she asked the magistrate which of them had a complaint. The gallery started bringing lunch. Four of the widows started bringing cases of their own. It ran twenty-three years and ended on the ruling that a barge has two sides, which is how the chalk has been loaded ever since: grain on the left, grave on the right, same bench, same rock, same price, and a barge-master who has bought three vineyards.
I start this half of the index with a barge because this is the half people go to law over. Nobody has ever sued for a T9 material. Everything below is what a person actually touches between waking and supper, the wall and the roof lead and the stew salt and the iron on the man who came to collect the rent, set out in the Accord’s tier order (T0 for what fails at ordinary handling, up through T4, the first instrument grade) with the quarter it comes from and the way it lets you down. Bearing is what a material does under load. Holding is what it does under Essence, the refined power a practitioner spends. Resonance, Kind and Domain name the Wellspring it sympathizes with, its kind, and the branch of natural philosophy the Measurewrights file it under, which tells you how much and never why.
T0 · Fragile















































MaterialSourceBearing / HoldingWhat it isMireclay Bearing · Clay · SouthMarsh basins of DorrosfennNegligible / very low, short durationShort-lived summoning totems; folk vessels. The Codex’s standard example of Holding and Bearing running independently. Fails to heat, strong Essence currents, spiritual proximityGlassroot Fibers Holding · Plant Fiber · unconfirmedSwampy caves beneath RovannNegligible / trace, symbolic onlyWoven veils that amplify a voice slightly when sung through. Used by nomadic dryad-kin and traveling poets. Shatters on contact with structured spellwork: the fiber is hollow and resonates freely, which is what amplifies the voice, and a working imposes a boundary condition the free resonance cannot satisfy. It fails at the moment it is asked to hold a shapeDustquartz Holding · Crystal · NorthShattered veins in the collapsed mines of AnguzPoor / faint, vibrationally unstableCheap decorative charms. Dangerous in bulk: shards resonate to discordant Aether under compression. Sold by the sack and treated with less caution than that warrantsTithing Parchment Holding · Alchemized Bark · WestHoly Sea of AlabasterNil / single glyph, one usePeasant offerings to lowborn spirits. The Church’s cheapest sacrament. Structurally an Onceglass logic centuries before Onceglass. Burns on spiritual contactCharred Bone Holding · Organic RemnantBurned remains of failed resurrection ritesNil / curses cling to fragmentsCurse-work and grave charms, for hedge-necromancers. Illegal in Alabaster-aligned polities. Its only reliable property is that it holds what nobody wants held. A failed resurrection is a working that could not Seal, and an unsealed working has only ever been interrupted. What clings to the fragments is a law-fragment: a piece of a Mortalis process, invoked and abandoned, still attempting to complete itself in whatever it contacts. No fragment has ever been observed to decay, and the assay houses have been watching for sixty-one yearsCoalglass Shard Holding · Stone / GlassPressure-formed in shallow minesPoor / weak, reflectiveThe poor man’s divination mirror. The bottom of the scrying trade
T1 · Soft

































































MaterialSourceResonance / Kind / DomainWhat it isVellun Copper Holding · Metal · West, unconfirmedHills of SenothConduction (inferred)Apprentice smithwork; spiritual conduction; array wire feedstock. Good conduction, low retention, melts far too easily. Price tracks the copper famines. Senoth is asserted on trade-route evidence onlyWillowblood Sap Holding · Essence LiquidTrees along the Vale of Tirres—Inscribing beginner rituals. Weakens in sunlight. Tirres does not appear on any current Accord surveySunreed Paper Holding · Fabric / PulpMarshes near the Epprenean Kingdom—The standard teaching substrate. Every Engraver in the four quarters learned on it. Fails to damp, and to any working above apprentice gradeDriftbone Holding · Organic · SouthVeil-tide shores—Ritual carving; dream-shaman work. Carries whispers when hollowed. What the tides are bleaching, and where it comes from, is not recorded. The shamans decline to speculate in front of Accord surveyorsCoalthread Cloth Holding · Fabric · SouthSouthern weave, distribution uncontrolled—Concealment garments. Dulls aura flicker and burns readily. The Accord notes without further comment that its principal known users are smugglersStar-Tallow Wax Holding · Essence CompoundHarvested from Aether-glow insects—Light-inscription candles for scribes and vigil-keepers. Melts near an emotionally charged Core: the wax holds its set through a narrow band and a Shell under load radiates enough into the immediate air to carry it past the transition. A working hazard rather than a poetic one, and the reason vigils over the dying fail routinely: the room is full of exactly the condition the wax cannot survivePalebed Nitre Holding · Mineral · SouthNitrate caliche, interior pansExuroth · Wild · ThermodynamicsOxidizer for alchemical charge work; meat preservative; corpse preservative; fertilizer. Harvested by scraping. The pans have been worked for eight hundred years and are not measurably diminishedPumice Float Bearing · Stone · EastCaldera ignimbrite sheets—Abrasive, filtration medium, lightweight fill. Effectively free at source. Floats: rafts come down the rivers after an eruption thick enough to walk on for a week, which has killed a number of people who triedYellowbreath Sulfur Holding · Mineral · EastFumarole fields throughout the arcPyraeon · Wild · ThermodynamicsFeedstock for every acid in the eastern alchemical trade. Collected by hand off the vent rims by men who work in wet cloth and do not work long
T2 · Common Durable
The material the world is actually built out of.





























































































































MaterialSourceResonance / Kind / DomainWhat it isGreystone Bearing · Stone · NorthQuarrylands near Kaetra—Standard fortification stone of four kingdoms. Minimally resistive to magic, entirely adequate against everything else. Why the north builds gray where the west builds paleShieldgneiss Bearing · Stone · NorthBasement outcrop across the whole quarterPetralon (weakly) · Wild · MechanicsBearing exceptional, Holding negligible. Inert to nine Wellsprings in ten. An array laid on the northern shield stays exactly where it was put for a century, which is why the Accord sites its great arrays hereStillband Ore Bearing · Metal Ore · NorthBedded across the western shield—Banded iron, magnetite alternating with gray chert in finger-width layers. The backbone of every bridge in the quarter. The chert bands scatter Essence, so inscriptions bleed off over a seasonChainsalt Holding · Mineral · NorthThe salt country of Nalūn, bedded haliteFixatio · Medium · Material ScienceThe most important dull material in the four quarters. Holding deliberately nil, an Essence dielectric. Gaskets, isolation collars, separator plates in every serious array; food preservation; currency bars. A salt bar is worth a silver mark and can be eaten. Fails in standing waterForge-Iron Bearing · Metal · NorthHuman Kingdom of Altherion—Bears magnificently and holds almost nothing, which is exactly why it arms the line infantry of six kingdoms and appears in no ward-work anywhere. Specification unchanged in three hundred yearsSlagbloom Bearing · Metal · WestAncient spoil, western foreland and tin districtsAnamnesis (unwelcome) · Medium · Abstract/EntropicInscriptions laid on it read doubled, because the metal was worked and marked once already and something of the earlier marking survives the second melt. The same behavior a Crystal shows at a Threshold, in a substrate. A melt cools into order around whatever survived the heat, and in reworked spoil that is the prior marking, which the new inscription then has to grow around rather than replace. Engravers charge extra for a rough seat in metal for the same reason the halls cap a rough-seated practitioner at Tier Four. Superstitious foremen will not have it undergroundPalegrit Limestone Bearing · Stone · WestPlatform carbonate across the central west—Ashlar, lime for mortar, and flux for every iron furnace in the quarter. Three uses, one quarry. The same rock gives the west its sinkholes and its habit of losing rivers undergroundKirkyard Lead Bearing · Metal · WestGalena in the limestone belt, worked with the silver—Roofing, coffin lining, pipe and sling bullets, and Essence shielding for every assay house and isolation room in the west. Attenuates Essence more effectively per unit thickness than anything else in common supply. The men who smelt it do not lastGreaves Tin Holding · Metal · WestCassiterite, lode and stream-workCoagulatio · Wild · Material ScienceBronze, solder, and the tinning of array contacts. A tinned contact does not corrode, and contact corrosion in a working array is a slow, invisible, cumulative failure. Unglamorous, essential, and running outAttercrop Vitriol Holding · Liquid Reagent · WestDrainage of abandoned workingsDissolution · Wild · Abstract/EntropicThe same fluid that killed the Aerne valley writes the Accord’s own codices. Mordant fixing ritual ink to organic substrate. Blinds on contact with the eye and does so without warning, since it does not burn the skin at working dilutionVeinwood Plank Holding · Wood · WestMountain trees of Varun—Semi-hardened grain, briefly enchantable. Standard stock for ritual shields across three kingdomsAlchemelt Brick Bearing · Synthetic Stone · EastArtisan guilds of the arcMaterial ScienceVolcanic ash ground with burned lime and water. Sets hard, sets fast, and sets underwater, which is why the east builds deep-water harbors while western harbors silt shut. Will not spanRedcrust Laterite Bearing · Mineral · EastWeathered flanks, wet eastern seaboard—The red caprock. Useless as stone, useless as soil, and the feedstock for Cloudmetal. Everyone knew the metal was in it; only Caedor was willing to commit the array capacityRoughgold Holding · Metal · EastPlacer bars, black-sand riversBenediction, SublimatioWon by hand, by anyone, with no permission from anyone, which produced the eastern quarter’s characteristic political condition and the Great Inflation of the Voyager Era. Ecclesiastical and oath work; bullionEmber Flint Holding · Stone · EastForaye—Survival fire-starting. The single most widely distributed Essence-active object in the eastern quarter by simple countTrapstone Bearing · Stone · SouthFlood-basalt terraces, western interiorCoagula, Fixatio · Wild · Material ScienceColumnar basalt splitting naturally into six-sided posts that need almost no dressing. The Braqthian standing-stone tradition exploits its resonance; the west has never bothered to study itGreenskin Serpentine Bearing · Stone · SouthOphiolite belt, eastern coastal ranges—Carving stock. In certain pods the stone is fibrous, and the fibers separate into a dust so fine it does not settle. Twenty-year onset lung scarring, invariably fatal. Enforcement has posted no writ and the quarries have raised no objection to the absenceMarrowchalk Holding · Phosphorite · SouthBone-beds, Dorrosfenn and EppreneaMortalis, Rebirthine · Medium · BiochemistryDoubles a wheat yield as fertilizer and is the primary reagent of every necromantic practice in the quarter. The same bench, the same rock, the same barge. Fertilizer and necromancy cannot be distinguished at the point of sale because they cannot be distinguished at the point of extractionCoilhide Leather Bearing · Beastkin Hide · SouthIroncoils, native to Braqth—Training armor and duel-school gloves. Common enough at home to be worthless and expensive enough abroad to be worth shipping
T3 · Hardened



















































































MaterialSourceResonance / Kind / DomainWhat it isSunkwood Bearing · Wood · NorthBeds of the chain-lakes—Oak and black spruce drowned when the ice dammed the northern drainage, buried in anoxic mud, lifted out after two thousand years black to the heart and dense enough to sink. Essence-quiet, which is the point: bench stock in precision workshopsBlackcap Sulfide Holding · Metal Ore · NorthMelt sheet beneath the Kaetran RingManganthra · Wild · ThermodynamicsBlackcap alloy keeps its temper inside a forge-array’s working field, where ordinary steel goes soft and stupid. Crucible tongs, array clamps, furnace door hinges. Roasting fume kills vegetation for six leagues downwindGhoststeel Holding · Metal · North, provisionalSalvaged from Spirit War ruins—Salvaged, never mined. Reflects spiritlight; partial phasing. Anti-spirit weaponry. Nobody has yet reproduced it in a crucible, and the provenance rests on ruin-siting evidence aloneBlacktooth Wolfram Holding · Metal Ore · WestSheeted veins in the granite cupolasIgnivale, Exuroth · Wild · ThermodynamicsThe answer to the vessel problem. Highest melting point in the ledger. Nozzles, hearth crowns, array-furnace linings for all T4+ crucible work. No glamour, no legend, and no substitute, and the Accord tracks every tonIronwood Bearing · Wood · EastDeep forest of Eresse—Hardened to the equivalent of tempered steel. Ceremonial bows, shamanic staves, Yukari staves. Cut under Eressian restrictions that keep it out of the trade entirelyRunebronze Holding · Metal · WestMelt-forged with minor glyphs—The first material in history designed to hold an inscription. Bronze is old law. Oath-plates, boundary markers, guild charters. Archaic, and increasingly the only kind there isSteelsilk Cord Bearing · Fabric / Thread · unconfirmedSpiderweavers of the Rovannian caverns—Suspends armor-weight loads; resists minor spells. Grappling harness, rigging, climbing line. Rovann’s quarter is unresolved in the Accord recordFangglass Holding · Crystallized StoneUnspecified—Shards that pierce magical wards. A hunter’s consumable. An early, cruder answer to the same market Onceglass now dominatesKnellhide Bearing · LeatherFallen Fellstag beasts—Burial-rite armor; anti-possession garments. Resists possession when inscribed. Uninscribed it is ordinary heavy leatherOnceglass Holding · Crystallized Stone · EastObsidian quenched within an active Wellspring fieldFractura, Tenebra · Wild · Abstract/EntropicHigh and terminal: one casting. Brittle by design. Cannot be repaired, recharged, or traced back to its Engraver. Militia ordnance and cheap wards for anyone who cannot afford a permanent working. An extinction event for the western middle-market Holding trade, proceeding at the speed of shipping. Arbitration undecided whether weapon or commoditySkarnrose Ore Holding · Metal Ore · EastIntrusive contacts with limestone—Silver, lead, zinc and garnet in banded contact bodies. Silver here is a byproduct of a zinc operation, an inversion western silver houses have found financially unpleasantAshfast Chrome Holding · Metal Ore · SouthChromite pods in the serpentine beltFixatio · Medium · Material ScienceGround to sand and rammed into a hearth it will not react with slag, will not fuse, and will not fail. The Logistics Division has flagged the two-ore dependency in every annual report for nineteen years
T4 · Reinforced Magical
Instrument grade.













































































MaterialSourceResonance / Kind / DomainWhat it isClearbeam Beryl Holding · Crystal · NorthPegmatite dikes on the northern marginLuminalis, Mirithane · Medium · ElectromagnetismOptically flawless beryl in crystals occasionally longer than a man. Passes Essence-light without the scatter quartz introduces, which makes it the only acceptable stock for a coil. Lenses, assay glasses, long-range instruments, and the Skyglass Archive’s glazingPsionite Holding · Mineral · WestVarun deep workings—Mental fortification; psionic amplification. Requires attunement to work at all. Worked only under the Psionic Mastery Code. Varun’s entire defensive posture rests on itRuneglass Holding · Alchemical CrystalAlchemically grown—Holds Parun glyphs with exceptional clarity. The permanent-object counterpart to Onceglass and the stock the western guilds are trying to defend. Fails under Wellspring inversionVerdant Alloy Holding · Metal Blend · unattestedBlended with druidic essenceVerdantia (inferred)Ceremonial weapons; the makers are unattested. A druidic blend rather than a smelt. Its makers do not sell itInkveil Silk Holding · Fabric · VirelionMoonweavers of Virelion—Phases slightly at night and cloaks the aura. Every serious infiltrator in the four quarters wants it and almost none can afford it. Fails in daylight: the phasing is nocturnalSeerstone Resin Holding · Liquid Essence · East, provisionalCanopy trees, eastern cloud forest—Stores visions. Dangerously volatile. Provenance recorded on the strength of the resin’s physical character and the tree species involved, not confirmed by the Archives DivisionBloodscript Bone Holding · OrganicCrystallized remains of martyr-sorcerers—Etching unbreakable fate-oaths. The oath written on it does not come off. Neither does the question of where it came from. Requires a martyr; supply is what it isShardlace Holding · Fabric / ThreadWoven from essence glass—Cuts spells on contact. Anti-caster garments and netting. Cuts the wearer as readily as the caster. Handling it is a skill in itselfCloudmetal Holding · Metal · EastReduced from Redcrust laterite, Caedor worksJudicium alignment · Wild · ElectromagnetismStructural metal at a third the weight of iron. Requires a sustained Judicium reduction array that exists in four places. The clearest case in the ledger of a whole trade’s capability following from geological accident rather than genius, and Caedor’s guild would prefer it were not written down in those termsStormfulgur Holding · Natural Glass · SouthFulgurite fields, nitre pansMirithane, Aurevane · Spirit · ElectromagnetismWhere lightning strikes the pans it fuses a branching tube of glass down through the crust, naturally hollow, naturally continuous, naturally aligned along the discharge path. Ready-formed Essence conduit for the long runs of an array. The Braqthians gather them after storms the way coastal people gather driftwood. Gathered free, resold at forty timesAgano Sand Holding · Sand · Kushara, the SandsThe Sands, the Zettari ascension plane, through a lineage-acknowledged Zettari only—Condensed lineage memory, folded into the quench at the Witnessed Temper before a Stone Witness. The finished piece learns the strain it survives, for whoever it was sworn to, and recognizes no one else. Access-gated, not time-gated. See The Zettari — Agano Sand and the Witnessed Temper

materials,-alchemy--and--trade/materials.title: The Material Index · T5–T9
materials,-alchemy--and--trade/materials.content:
T5 through T9 · what requires a forge-array, a rite, or a corpse, and what lies past that.
Margrave Corvane spent a third of a year’s revenue on the chandelier, because he wanted the Feast of the Long Truce remembered. Four houses who had been burning each other’s orchards for thirty years were to sit down at one table under his roof, in their colors, and over that table he hung a ring of Whiteshard as wide as a mill wheel, which his agent had recommended for its cold luster and its resistance to holy corruption. It hung dark through the soup. Then the Margrave rose with his cup and said that he had always counted these men his brothers, and the chandelier lit the hall like noon on a snowfield.
Lord Aumbrey, who was quick, turned to his neighbor and told him the wine was excellent, and it blazed again, and the whole table understood what it was eating under. For a quarter of an hour it was the finest entertainment anyone present had ever attended, four houses paying each other elaborate compliments and howling with laughter at the glare, and then somebody’s eldest son asked somebody’s uncle a plain question about the orchards at Tern Hollow. Sixty-three people died in that hall, and there was ample light to do it by. The truce had lasted until the fish. The chandelier still hangs there, and the Corvanes have been trying for ninety years to sell it to a buyer who means what he says.
The row for Whiteshard, in the table below, says all of this in one clause, and it said so then. Past T4 these materials have behaviors, they have sources, and several of them have been somebody. The Ledger sets all of that down with perfect candor for anyone who reads to the end of the line before paying.

These tiers carry no Provenance Grade column (the mark of where a stock came from) and several rows are rendered stock. The Bearing and Holding indices grade what a material does. They have never graded what it was.
Grade IV or above by their own source lines: Bloodsilver, from the heartveins of Ascended humans; Drakehide Steel, smelted from slain elder drakes; Veilbone and Sunsinew, whose sources are described and not classed; and Red Ecliptite, which is Archon death.
The Standing Index prices on provenance. This index describes behavior. A buyer reading only this one is being told exactly what the thing does and nothing whatsoever about who it used to be.

T5 · Rare / Spirit-Forged





















































MaterialSourceResonance / Kind / DomainWhat it isAethersteel Holding · Metal · Wellspring ForgesTempered from condensed Aether—Channels Aetheric pulses and hums under divine pressure. Weapon edges shimmer faintly. Exists at all because forge-arrays broke the heat ceiling. Priced on the coil, not the scale. Dangerous if forged without proper HarmonicsBloodsilver Holding · Essence-Infused MetalHeartveins of divine beasts or Ascended humansPerson-addressed binding (inferred)Bloodpact forging; oath-bound enforcement instruments. Rejects unworthy wielders; burns or corrodes them over time. Grade IV where the heartvein was human, Grade V where it was a divine beast. The rejection passes no judgment. The metal carries the donor’s law as a seed, and a wielder whose own architecture contradicts that law is holding a contradiction against their skin for as long as they hold it at all. The only item in the Arbitration Division’s schedules that can attack the bailiffTwilite Glass Holding · Spirit CrystalCooled during the twilight phase between sun and moons in sacred groves—Glows in response to grief or memory. Grief-work, memory vessels, grave-watching. Cracks if lies are spoken in its presence, used as an informal lie-detector by people who cannot afford a proper oneDawnsilver Thread Holding · Thread · UtopiaSilkworms of the upper canopy in HighspirePerson-addressed binding (inferred)Reflects radiant spells and can bind a broken Name back into the soul if used in ceremonial stitching. One of the two attestations the Measurewrights use to infer silver’s resonanceGloomhide Bearing · Leather · SouthBeasts born in forgotten spirit zones—Hyper-resilient; spiritually inert. Repels light-based castings and weak divine strikes. The one material in the ledger that is simultaneously an ideal armor backing and completely useless as a substrateVeilbone Holding · Organic / Essence StoneWorld fractures near the thinning Veil—Hollow-sounding core, spirit-touched. Every spirit bell in the four quarters is Veilbone or is pretending to be. Harvest sites are dangerousGlacium Holding · Frost-Infused Mineral · EastIampu, grown in the ice-caves under Winter Court licenseVohrin · Titan-touched · ThermodynamicsGrown rather than quarried in any ordinary sense, slowly, in caverns held below freezing for the purpose, in a process the Winter Court does not document. Frost-bound weaponry; mercenary payment stock. No inspection permitted. The Logistics Division’s standing note: holding a cavern below freezing for years requires a sustained pull from somewhere, and no Core is registered under the ice-caves. The Court’s position is that the caves are naturally cold. The Division has asked twice how cold and been answered neither time
T6 · Arcane-Resistant
Refuses a category of working outright rather than resisting it.















































MaterialSourceResonanceWhat it isSoulquartz Holding · Crystal · Wellspring sitesForms in soul wells during Wellspring awakenings—Storage of emotional resonance and raw spiritual force. The nearest thing the ledger has to genuine Essence storage, which is why the coin volume’s whole argument turns on the word until. Shatters only under Archon interferenceFrostwool Holding · Fabric · EastSheared from the frostborn fauna of IampuVohrin (inferred)Nullifies fire-based drafts and wards against fear glyphs. Holds temperature balance even near Crevice rifts, which is the property that matters and the one nobody can explainGrimbarite Holding · Stone · SouthBuried beneath the Crevice fault system—Repels Fate and Name manipulation. Heavy, silent in all forms, absorbs prayer. Anti-scrying construction and sealed vaults. Extraction requires working inside the Crevice margin, and the mortality figures for Grimbarite crews are not publishedWhiteshard Holding · MineralForged in radiant Wellspring eruptionsLuminalis (inferred)Reflects spiritlight and resists holy corruption. Glows when a lie is spoken nearby, which has ended more negotiations than it has assistedGlyphed Myrrhstone Holding · Alchemical Compound · WestCompounded in sacred vaults beneath AlabasterFixatio (inferred)Semi-liquid under moonlight, hardens under oath. Glyphs written on it are immune to time or weather. The physical basis of permanent law in the western quarter. Requires an oath to set at allEcho-Chain Alloy Holding · MetalCrafted in silence, attuned to harmonic fluctuations—Echoes enemy spells and deflects Aether pulses. Each chain length carries a spirit resonance from its creator, which makes second-hand purchase a genuine risk
T7 · Titan-Forged
Era-one product or Titan remnant. Found, not made.








































MaterialSourceWhat it isTitanstone Bearing · StoneThe shattered remains of slumbering World SpiritsNear-immortal density; pulses with tectonic will. Divine seal-work and the foundation of the greatest structures. Each block carries a metaphysical weight sufficient that a crack is a civic catastrophe: a cracked block takes a city down with it. One of two materials in current use that no known process can makeDrakehide Steel Bearing · MetalSmelted in dragonfire from slain elder drakesExtreme Bearing; Holding fate-bound. Grade V. Resistant to divine flame and Tempest-type Essence. Once wielded, it bonds with the wielder’s Fate Thread permanently. There is no second owner. A Grade V carry is law-shaped, and what it does is enforce. The blade chooses nothing. A law with no termination condition has found a party to apply toCrestveil Tapestry Holding · Fabric · UtopiaSewn from divine fog in the Sovereign’s CrownImmune to time passage. Binds prophetic images and does not age. The physical archive of prophecy in the four quarters. Cannot be cut except by Archon bladeForgelight Barbs Holding · Essence SpikeFormed inside collapsing temples during Wellspring implosionJudicium (inferred). Charges against corrupted souls and burns when justice is invoked. Sancta Lux inquisitorial weapons. Grows hotter near heretics or oathbreakers, including friendly ones. Carrying one is a statement about who you expect to meetSilvertremor Plates Bearing · MetalHarvested from the Skybones of Omnis, Titan of SkyDisrupts flight magic and reacts to wind and pressure. Screams when struck, used in warning constructs precisely because of the screamAuric Blackroot Holding · Essence WoodRoots of a Titan-born tree beneath EdenisNullifies illusions and dream effects. Its rings shift when a prophecy is fulfilled, which makes a cross-section a historical document. Harvest is a rite
T8 · Mythic / Celestial
Formed by cosmological event. Operates on Name, Fate (the Plane that controls Attraction Force and Obsession Force, and with them what the odds are allowed to do), and time.













































MaterialSourceWhat it isEclipsium Holding · CrystalTotal solar eclipses in Realms near Divine collapseEclipseron (inferred). Bending light and fate; destabilizing false gods. Reflected forms inside it speak in inverse Parun, which is the property that gets its holders burned. Heretical to holdSunsinew Holding · Essence FiberRadiant veins of solar beastsLuminalis, Benediction (inferred). Burns away corruption; strengthens a divine link. The Moto seer tradition is built on it. Threads cannot be unraveled without invoking truthMoonblight Ore Holding · Metal · unresolvedImpact craters in IlcindorNyxial (inferred). Destabilizes divine wards. Induces madness if misused. Proscribed, and Ilcindor does not appear on any current Accord surveyStarcall Pearl Holding · Alchemical GemFormed when fallen stars crash into sacred springsSummoning ancient Echoes. Fails if handled by the impure: the purity requirement is functional rather than moral and has killed people who assumed otherwiseChronoglass Holding · Temporal CrystalCrystallized timefold remnantsAnamnesis (inferred) · Medium · Abstract/Entropic. Traps a moment permanently. Impossible to lie within. The Paradox Wardens’ entire jurisprudence rests on this one property. Shatters only when a temporal contradiction is introducedAbythros Thread Holding · Spirit FabricSewn in the Abythron Temple-CradlesAbython (inferred). Shields against Realmwide spiritual collapse. Required to survive in collapsed Divine Realms, which is a short list of people and a shorter list of returnsVoidfall Stone Holding · StoneThe completed Void. Made, not emplaced; fell across four worldsMatte. Takes the light and gives nothing back, where Crevice Shale glows black. None larger than a loaf. Cracked the night-stone beside where it landed; sealed instruments near it sit at readings no watchman can account for. Reads as Crevice Shale to a Measurewright’s instruments at a distance, and no instrument yet tells the two apart. Not found. Made, when the Void was completed, and what is completed has weight. Whether it acts on Realm law as Shale does is not recorded. Article III names Crevice Shale and does not name this. Enforcement cannot currently tell them apart, and Enforcement has hanged eleven men under Article III without once being asked to explain the sentence. An analogue of Crevice Shale, not Crevice Shale. Article III’s wording is now tested
T9 · Transcendent / Forbidden

Acts on the law rather than within it. Every entry is proscribed, and every entry nullifies or rewrites.









































MaterialSourceWhat it isNullglassTheorized to predate RealityNullifies Aether, Name, Fate and Soul. Cannot be touched without ceasing to exist. The handling problem is the material. There is no recorded safe procedureAsh of NamesProduced only when a True Name is erased from fateOblivara (inferred). Rewrites memory of existence. Presence alone causes written glyphs to vanish. Resists record, which means the Accord’s own ledger of it is necessarily incomplete and known to beCrevice Shale SouthThe Crevice itselfGlows black. Fractures nearby Realm law, including protective law. Forbidden to move, hold, or trade under Article III. Recorded in the ledger at all because a ledger that omits it is a ledger somebody will trust. The only Accord law written about a rock See Voidfall Stone, T8: an analogue that reads as Shale at a distance and is not named in Article III. Enforcement cannot yet tell the two apartFatesunder CordHarvested from collapsed prophecy threadsSevers a person from their destined end. When tied around someone, fate reboots. What it reboots to is not part of the workingRed EcliptiteFailed divine births or Archon deathsImmortality work. Drives users mad unless tempered by a Wellspring. The tempering requirement is the whole of its practical history. Everyone who skipped it is a cautionary entryThe Hollow CrownAppears only to those who abandon the VeilRenders Name irrelevant. Wearing it erases you from all soul-registry across Realms. Turns the user into a walking paradox. Listed as a material because it behaves like one and as a relic because it chooses
