the-magic-system/fracture-of-worlds-—-th.content:
The Cooper’s Row Reds of Altherion (a fighting school with a song, a color and a grudge, like all of them) had been refused the Ember Stair three years running. The Ember Stair is a Pyreveil site high on the inner wall of the Ring, a Core in common speech, where Aether of that one type pools so thick that the rock sweats orange and snowmelt leaves it as steam. Its Marrowkin keepers close it to anyone in arrears, and the Reds were in arrears. In the spring of a bracket year their captain, Jennet Marl, walked up anyway, singing, with four hundred supporters in red scarves on the road behind her and a keeper on every landing reading her the sum. On the top step she planted her feet, opened her Soul Crystal to the ground and pulled.
Every scarf on the road lifted. Her aura, a respectable brick red for sixteen years, went to the gold-white of a crucible pour, and for the length of one long breath she stood with her hair gone and her face shining and the whole cliff behind her the color of a peach. She came down with Pyreveil harmonized in her Crystal for good and the keepers’ invoice in her belt. A Measurewright who had climbed the hill for exactly this set his fork to her at the bottom and read every number the same, to the point, then told the crowd nothing had happened. She put a fist into a boulder beside him and it ran like tallow. The Reds still lost the bracket. She never felt cold again, and she could no longer hold a hand near a fire and know when to take it out, which cost her two fingers by the following winter and made her a great many songs, most of them wrong about the fingers.
Part Thirteen — The Sixty Wellsprings and Stat Interaction
“To pass through a Wellspring is to be unmade just enough to keep going.”

Updated to the sixty-four Sub-Stat architecture. Every Sub-Stat cited below is a current entry. Where an older reading named an old Sub-Stat, the effect now sits on the entry that absorbed it, and the effect itself is unchanged. The merge ledger is on IV. The Eight Primaries and the Sixty-Four Sub-Stats.

What a Wellspring Is
A Wellspring represents an alchemical and a spiritual transformation and concept. It can be seen as a source of power to pull from, and it is more the governing idea that transforms how a soul uses Aether: a lens on magic already potent. Captain Marl came down the Ember Stair with every number the same and a boulder running like tallow, and that is what a lens does. A soul bases its tempering on one, it shapes what each Path spends (a Path being the layer of the Crystal a soul leans on, in Part Eighteen), and at its home Path it can even double its effect, starting small and reaching double only with years of mastery. There are sixty, fixed. Every few years some Measurewright announces a sixty-first, and he has generally retracted it by the next fair. The Titans are the Wellsprings themselves, and the Sixty are their manifestations, each one way a Titan’s law shows up, carried by Aether. The Sixty Wellsprings names the Titan on each entry.
A person gets one at a Core in a dungeon, from a school, from a Draft or a blessing, or by birth.
Aether (mana, to a foreigner) is the raw power in the world around us, what remains of Omnara undivided, and it comes in different types that affect the Soul Crystal differently, one to a Wellspring. A practitioner pulls Aether from the environment, and nobody works it without pulling it in first. What becomes of it inside depends on the road. A Body Path fighter packs it raw in the Shell as the Charge, shapes it there under the lens and drives it out through the Shell. A Spirit Path worker refines it in the Soul Crystal into Essence and spends that through the Core. A Fate Path worker stores nothing and pulls a thread down through the Attraction Layer when the day comes. Older copies of this Part gave the second road’s refining and the first road’s door as one road for everybody. Either way where you stand matters: rich ground fills you faster and thin ground starves you, and the scholar’s term for that richness is Aetheric Density. A Wellspring also has sites where its Aether pools, which common speech calls Cores (nothing to do with the Essence Core named below, a layer of the Crystal, as the Guild has been told). Cores are mostly found in dungeons, which grow down in floors around them, and they are said to lie in vast territories too. A worked Core is a dungeon someone cleared and now holds: it recharges and has keepers, and its keepers can close it, as Captain Marl could tell you. The Ember Stair was cleared so long ago that its floors have turned into landings.
Every number below stays. Where these pages reach for natural philosophy, read it as the Measurewrights’ account of a Wellspring, often right about how much and never about why: a working is explained by its idea. Scholars have an account of everything and it may be wrong, and any Measurewright at the fair will be glad to tell you which of the others got it wrong.
What Wellsprings Do to Stats
The Sixty Wellsprings are not power-ups. They are principles of becoming, metabolic dialects that alter how the Soul Crystal processes Essence, routes Aether and anchors reality. When a character harmonizes with a Wellspring, it permanently alters the behavior of specific Sub-Stats, not by adding flat numerical bonuses, but by changing the qualitative character of how those Sub-Stats express their value.
A character with Fortitude at 200 who harmonizes with Monolithion does not gain Fortitude points. Their Fortitude begins behaving like stone rather than like flesh. The number stays the same. What the number means changes.
Every Wellspring touches all three layers of the Crystal, rarely evenly. The Essence Core determines how the soul burns, heals or empties under that law. The Aether Shell determines how the law moves through and around the body. The Attraction Layer determines how reality, memory and people bind to the soul once the law has taken hold.
A soul holds one home lens, the one it tempers on, until Adept, and from Expert up it can safely harmonize one more at each rank: two for an Expert, three for a Master, four for a Grandmaster, five for an Archmaster, six for a Paragon. A Clouded Crystal can harmonize early at a risk of tearing, and the base hue of an aura is always the lens tempered on longest. Most practitioners touch three to five Wellsprings in a lifetime and hold fewer. Those rare beings said to embody all Sixty are called Principals of Temperance, and the scholars who count lenses doubt them.
The Kinds of Wellspring
A Wellspring’s kind names its home plane. A kind is a qualifier and never a lock: any Path can use any Wellspring.






























KindHomeThe WellspringsWild (33)The Physical WorldPyreveil, Exuroth, Ignivale, Cinerion, Solfatara, Manganthra, Cataclysm, Pyraeon, Judicium, Cymorath, Orrenthal, Dissolution, Tenebra, Eidolyn, Nihiloth, Vantabriel, Coagula, Coagulatio, Materia Primordia, Basilithe, Monolithion, Terranova, Chthonica, Transmutatio, Fractura, Petralon, Ascensio, Sublimatio, Sublimare, Abython, Anima Spirare, Verdantia, RebirthineSpirit (15)The Soul PlaneCatharsis, Penanceflare, Thaloré, Abyntheus, Letheveil, Lethegraal, Hypnather, Mirithane, Oneirion, Nyxial, Eclipseron, Absolution, Penance, Redemption, ContritionFate (6)The Plane of FateSomnalis, Oblation, Benediction, Oblivara, Transference, TarturonMedium (6)All threePhreatis, Aurevane, Luminalis, Anamnesis, Fixatio, Mortalis
Wild Wellsprings are transformations of matter, things you can point at, and a practitioner shapes what they spend around them. Spirit Wellsprings are purely spiritual: their ground looks ordinary, they usually do little or nothing to the physical world, and they give a fighter no fire to throw, showing instead in what a person can bear, know, keep or let go. A spiritual entry below is the scholars’ account of what happens in the soul. Wellsprings of Fate work on bonds, debts, names and odds, and on their ground luck goes strange, oaths bite, and strangers keep meeting. Medium Wellsprings are at home on all three.
The Lens
A Wellspring is the lens a soul bases its tempering on, and it works in the terms of whichever layer the soul leans on. On the Body Path, by way of the Aether Shell, it changes what the body does and bears. On the Spirit Path, by way of the Essence Core, it changes what the working is and what it carries across a distance to a soul. On the Fate Path, by way of the Attraction Layer, it changes what the soul’s bonds, oaths and claims will hold, and the color of whatever thread the soul manages to pull. A Spirit Wellspring on the Body Path still gives no fire: it changes what the body can bear. So the lens shapes what the lead layer works, raw Aether in the Shell, Essence in the Core or the claim on the Layer, and the idea stays while the target changes: matter on the Body, what a thing means and holds on the Spirit, what a thing could have been on Fate.
At home a Wellspring harmonizes cleanly and can reach double its effect with years of mastery. Away from home it works at lower-quality resonance and higher cost, and reaches half again at most. Part Eighteen sets out the Paths.
The Sixty, by Kind
Each Wellspring below is listed with the Sub-Stats its law moves, and that is all this Part needs of it. Its Titan, its hue, the ground it favors and hates, and the Wellsprings contrary to it are on its entry in The Sixty Wellsprings. A person’s base hue comes from the lens they have tempered on longest, and the rest add texture.
Wild Wellsprings (33)
At home in the Physical World: transformations of matter, things you can point at, which a practitioner shapes what they spend around.
Frost is not one of these. Vohrin, the cold the frost arts keep reaching for, is a Titan’s power worked at Wellspring level and stands outside the Sixty; The Sixty Wellsprings carries the note on it.
Pyreveil, the Fire of Renewal. Temperance through burning; destruction reborn as creation. Strengthens Ardency Flux, Ardency Depth, Vitality Tolerance. Output burns hotter. The body stops minding heat.
Exuroth, the Trial Flame. Temperance through ordeal. Strengthens Ardency Overchannel, Tempering Overflow, Vitality Threshold. The Crystal learns to tolerate what would shatter lesser vessels.
Ignivale, the Wellspring of the Spark. Temperance through ignition. Strengthens Ardency Overchannel, Dexterity Celerity. First strikes arrive faster and cost less to start.
Cinerion, the Ash Veil. Temperance through aftermath. Strengthens Tempering Yield, Harmonics Stability. The residue of destruction becomes recovery material.
Solfatara, the Fuming Earth. Temperance through pressure. Strengthens Tempering Clarity, Vitality Constitution, Dominion Pressure. Sustained pressure output becomes the character’s natural state.
Manganthra, the Catalyst of Change. Temperance through transformation. Strengthens Ardency Depth, Gnosis Acuity. Contradictory Wellspring energies integrate without resonance conflict.
Cataclysm, the Shattered Law. Temperance through upheaval. Strengthens Ardency Cascade, Ardency Overchannel, Dominion Radius. Area expressions become wider and more coherent.
Pyraeon, the Ember Crown. Temperance through endurance. Strengthens Vitality Constitution, Tempering Longevity, and Ardency Flux held over time rather than Flux at peak. Output does not fade over time.
Judicium, the Wellspring of Truth. Temperance through discernment. Strengthens Gnosis Acuity and Gnosis Analysis. The mind becomes a scalpel. Judicium practitioners read weakness the way literate people read text.
Cymorath, the Air of Ascent. Temperance through freedom. Strengthens Dexterity Celerity and Gnosis Perception. The body reads space as a language of vectors.
Orrenthal, the Metallic Heart. Temperance through integrity. Strengthens Vitality Constitution, Resilience Integrity, Tempering Maturity. Moral density the Crystal recognizes as structural reinforcement.
Dissolution, the Unbinding Stream. Temperance through release. Strengthens Resilience Ward, Tempering Maturity. Dissolves what no longer serves the Crystal’s architecture.
Tenebra, the Hidden Shadow. Temperance through secrecy. Strengthens Dexterity Feint, Harmonics Suppression, Dominion Sense. Difficult to detect, read or track by conventional or Aetheric means.
Eidolyn, the Shaping Mind. Temperance through creation. Strengthens Ardency Density, Gnosis Retention. Mental constructs gain material solidity and more of them can be held loaded.
Nihiloth, the Hollow Law. Temperance through void. Strengthens Dominion Sovereignty, Resilience Persistence, Gnosis Cognition. Imposes law through negation. The Domain does not add rules. It removes them.
Vantabriel, the Wellspring of Night. Temperance through absence. Strengthens Resilience Continuity, Harmonics Attunement, Tempering Longevity. Endures by carrying the memory of what was lost rather than replacing it.
Coagula, the Unifying Pulse. Temperance through merging. The personal unifying force; a soul’s scattered pieces gathered back into one body. Strengthens Resilience Integrity, Tempering Coherence. The Crystal becomes harder to split.
Coagulatio, the Returning Stone. Temperance through re-forming. The material twin of Coagula, the alchemical operation that gathers substrate. Strengthens Ardency Compression, Tempering Clarity. Essence becomes denser, harder to waste.
Materia Primordia, the First Substance. Temperance through origin. Strengthens Vitality Fortitude, Dominion Gravity. Body and Domain gain mineral-weight authority.
Basilithe, the Stone Will. Temperance through permanence. Strengthens Resilience Hardening, Harmonics Stability. The soul’s frequency locks and refuses retuning.
Monolithion, the Enduring Monument. Temperance through memory. Strengthens Vitality Tolerance, Resilience Persistence, Dominion Gravity. Presence becomes geological.
Terranova, the Living Earth. Temperance through birth. Strengthens Vitality Regeneration, Harmonics Synergy. The body heals by growing rather than repairing.
Chthonica, the Root Deep. Temperance through grounding. Strengthens Vitality Absorption, Dexterity Economy, Dominion Gravity. Roots to whatever surface it stands on.
Transmutatio, the Law of Change. Temperance through motion. Strengthens Ardency Overchannel, Tempering Maturity. Failed workings become fuel rather than wounds.
Fractura, the Breaking Point. Temperance through failure. Strengthens Gnosis Analysis for fault-reading, Ardency Penetration, Resilience Integrity. Sees where things break and breaks them precisely.
Petralon, the Foundation Stone. Temperance through endurance. Strengthens Vitality Constitution, Dominion Gravity. Becomes the ground beneath the ground.
Ascensio, the Ladder of Ascent. Temperance through rising. Strengthens Tempering Maturity, Harmonics Attunement. Stage transitions become smoother and less violent.
Sublimatio, the Ascending Breath. Temperance through refinement. Strengthens Ardency Compression, Tempering Clarity. Output cleaner and sharper with less waste.
Sublimare, the Rising Breath. Temperance through ascent. Strengthens Tempering Clarity, Resilience Fortification. The Crystal purifies itself, burning off impurities as silver vapor.
Abython, the Abyssal Pulse. Temperance through void. Strengthens Resilience Persistence, Harmonics Stability, Vitality Tolerance. Operates where other practitioners suffocate.
Anima Spirare, the Soul’s Breath. Temperance through vitality. Strengthens Vitality Hemostasis, Vitality Regeneration, Harmonics Synergy. Wounds close because the body remembers being whole.
Verdantia, the Green Pulse. Temperance through growth. Strengthens Vitality Regeneration, Tempering Yield, Harmonics Synergy. Passive Essence recovery accelerates.
Rebirthine, the Cycle Eternal. Temperance through renewal. Strengthens Resilience Persistence, Tempering Maturity, Vitality Regeneration. The Crystal treats destruction as the first step of reconstruction.
Spirit Wellsprings (15)
At home on the Soul Plane. Each entry says what the Wellspring does to a soul’s stats, and no entry here gives anyone fire to throw.
Catharsis, the Wellspring of Release. Temperance through letting go. Strengthens Harmonics Empathy, Tempering Maturity, Resilience Fortification. Emotional weight converts to structural clarity.
Penanceflare, the Light of Contrition. Temperance through remorse. Strengthens Ardency Compression inversely, raising a working’s visibility rather than lowering it, and Gnosis Vigilance. Workings become more honest and harder to hide.
Thaloré, the Wellspring of Depth. Temperance through immersion. Strengthens Harmonics Projection, Dominion Pressure. Emotional truth acquires metaphysical weight.
Abyntheus, the Outer Pulse. Temperance through vastness. Strengthens Dominion Sovereignty, Dominion Sense, Gnosis Cognition. The conceptual ceiling expands to engage Archon-tier phenomena.
Letheveil, the Waters of Forgetting. Temperance through release of memory. Tests Resilience Anchoring rather than strengthening it, and strengthens Gnosis Cognition. Teaches which memories are load-bearing and which are chains.
Lethegraal, the Cup of Forgetting. Temperance through quiet. Strengthens Tempering Maturity, Harmonics Stability. The Crystal digests old pain into neutral architecture.
Hypnather, the Sleep Crown. Temperance through rest. Strengthens Vitality Regeneration during rest cycles, Tempering Yield, Gnosis Retention. Recovery during sleep becomes dramatically more efficient.
Mirithane, the Wellspring of Reflection. Temperance through stillness. Strengthens Harmonics Attunement, Tempering Coherence. Output becomes a more honest reflection of internal state.
Oneirion, the Wellspring of Dream. Temperance through imagination. Strengthens Gnosis Cognition, Dominion Sovereignty, Ardency Cascade. Workings operate through conceptual space, not just physical space.
Nyxial, the Nocturne Flame. Temperance through night. Strengthens Harmonics Stability, Dominion Gravity, Vitality Constitution. Baseline output does not fluctuate with environmental pressure.
Eclipseron, the Shadowed Star. Temperance through eclipse. Strengthens Gnosis Analysis, Harmonics Suppression, Dominion Sense. Reads reality by what is missing from it.
Absolution, the Cleansing Current. Temperance through forgiveness. Strengthens Tempering Clarity, Harmonics Attunement, Resilience Fortification. Old fractures lose their toxicity.
Penance, the Atoning Path. Temperance through discipline. Strengthens Vitality Threshold, Tempering Coherence, Resilience Integrity. The Crystal aligns more honestly with lived behavior.
Redemption, the Light Reclaimed. Temperance through return. Strengthens Tempering Maturity, Resilience Integrity, Dominion Fate. Past trauma sites become the strongest points in the Crystal.
Contrition, the Broken Flame. Temperance through acceptance. Strengthens Tempering Maturity, Resilience Integrity. Past failures become structural reinforcement.
Wellsprings of Fate (6)
At home on the Plane of Fate, working on bonds, debts, names and odds.
Somnalis, the Dream Veil. Temperance through vision. Strengthens Gnosis Forecast, Dominion Sense. Adjacent possibilities perceived as clearly as present facts.
Oblation, the Offering Flame. Temperance through sacrifice. Strengthens Harmonics Axis, Dominion Command, Tempering Yield. Willingness to pay soul-cost translates directly into Essence generation.
Benediction, the Wellspring of Grace. Temperance through compassion. Strengthens Harmonics Empathy, Harmonics Axis, Resilience Oath. Bonds formed under Benediction carry mechanical weight.
Oblivara, the Dark Mirror. Temperance through erasure. Strengthens Resilience Persistence, Gnosis Cognition. Resistance to conceptual erasure and perceptual manipulation.
Transference, the Living Exchange. Temperance through empathy. Strengthens Harmonics Synergy, Harmonics Projection, Tempering Yield. Essence routes to allies; ambient Wellspring energy absorbs through relational proximity.
Tarturon, the Fire of Reckoning. Temperance through ordeal; correction through consequence. Strengthens Ardency Flux under moral weight, Tempering Overflow, Resilience Fortification. Output spikes when the practitioner believes they deserve to pay.
Medium Wellsprings (6)
At home on all three planes.
Phreatis, the Waters of Memory. Temperance through reflection. Strengthens Gnosis Retention, Harmonics Attunement, Resilience Anchoring. It sits on the boundary between the body’s memory and water’s memory and answers to both.
Aurevane, the Wellspring of Light. Temperance through illumination. Strengthens Gnosis Perception, Gnosis Vigilance, Harmonics Attunement.
Luminalis, the Hidden Light. Temperance through perception. Strengthens Gnosis Perception, Dexterity Feint. Sees what hides; learns to hide what it reveals.
Anamnesis, the Wellspring of Remembrance. Temperance through awareness. Strengthens Gnosis Retention, Gnosis Analysis for reading past trauma, Resilience Anchoring. Reads history through contact with objects, places and beings.
Fixatio, the Binding Flame. Temperance through permanence. The anchoring law. Strengthens Vitality Fortitude, Resilience Anchoring. What is held by Fixatio stays held.
Mortalis, the Black Gate. Temperance through surrender. Strengthens Resilience Persistence, Gnosis Cognition. The soul engages ending as a structural event rather than a catastrophe.
Wellspring Stacking and Interference
Wellsprings whose laws run the same way compound their Sub-Stat modifications. Three Wellsprings of stone (Monolithion, Basilithe and Chthonica, say) produce a Vitality and Resilience profile noticeably denser than a character with identical raw values and no such harmonization. The numbers are identical on paper. The qualitative expression is not.
Mixed harmonization introduces resonance complexity. Neighboring laws, Monolithion and Fractura for instance, matter given form through force, produce complementary effects without interference. Contrary laws, which each entry in The Sixty Wellsprings names, Monolithion and Nihiloth among them, form against the erosion of all shape, produce tension the Crystal must structurally resolve, either through Temperance advancement or through a Compound Trait (a Trait fusing two or more laws into one) that integrates the contradiction.
The safe count of lenses is set by rank, as above, and how well they are held together is governed by Tempering Capacity. Exceeding either produces resonance conflict that degrades all active harmonizations equally.
Part Fourteen — Attraction Force and Obsession Force
“To be seen is sacred. To be held against the law of your own soul is profanation.”
The Plane of Fate
The Plane of Fate is the control of Attraction Force and Obsession Force and the workings of reality itself: manipulating probabilities to work outside what reality already knows, to control the fate or predestiny of something. Fate covers both forces below. It represents the possibility of all things, so it reaches the Spiritual and the Physical World alike, because all spirits and all physical things have fates. It can attach to oaths, and it is more tied to blessings. “Plane” is a courtesy. Physical and Spiritual Reality are the two lower realities, and Fate is no reality at all: it is everything that flows, every possibility, idea and concept, anything that can happen in those two, and it sits above them as the law and construction of the world. Most if not all of the Archons are Sovereign across all three planes, this one included, some more powerful than others, and Uurgath and Urion are unparalleled here because their ideas are inconceivable.
A soul’s own share of this plane is its Attraction Layer, and a soul that leans on that layer is on the Fate Path. The two forces below are what the plane runs on, and they stay forces whoever is spending them. Most of the Path spends them the way they already run, in bonds, oaths, Range, Aura Pressure and Domain authority, and at its far end it changes how they are going to run.
People fight and wage wars with this, and it is the hardest thing they do. Understanding gets no purchase on it, because understanding is made of the thing it would be used against. A real pull of a thread moves what a blow, a wall or a march depends on, so that the result arrives without having been forced. It is rare, ruinously expensive and often fails, it leaves a knot whether it lands or not, a debt on the Layer that the world collects from the puller in its own time, it moves only what already has a way of happening, and it is contested, Dominion’s Fate Sub-Stat against the target’s Resilience Persistence and Continuity. Moving a whole field is a life’s masterwork at high Stage or a bloodline’s art.
Real Fate Arts are rare and mostly by bloodline. Some high-Stage masters reach them late along the Fate Path, and most people touch Fate only from the outside, through a blessing or a Master Work Draft, if at all. They are considered incredibly overpowered, and the people who consider them so are mostly the ones who have met one.
Blessings
A blessing grants a power out of a person’s natural reach: Level, a Catalyst, or both, or a grip on Fate. A Stage a blessing lifts a soul to before its Level can hold it leaves the Crystal Overgrown, like any bought Stage. It need not go through Fate, though most do. Higher spirits, Archons, Epochs and people of higher Temperance give them, because they are spiritually stronger, and a great giver spends almost nothing doing it. Epochs and Archons act rarely, and when they do it shakes the world; lesser spirits and high-Stage people give most blessings.
A blessing shows on the sheet as its own line. Since the giver wrote that line, it can lie. A curse is often a blessing with terms you did not read, or a giver who does not care what you want. Those who hold Hataraki can take a blessing back or remove it, which is one of the reasons Hataraki is so dangerous. It takes two Works or two Moto, because one grip does one job.
[Blessing: Favor of the Tide-Mother]
[You will not drown.]

Every sailor who has had that line will tell you it is true. Read it again.
Attraction Force, the Law of Recognition
Attraction Force is the third fundamental force in the framework, equal in structural importance to Aether and Essence. Where Aether gives a working physical form and Essence gives it identity, Attraction Force gives it endurance. It is the binding principle that allows one presence to acknowledge another and for that acknowledgment to persist as continuity. Through it, vows remain binding, relics remember their bearers, lineages preserve their echo, Domains remain stable, and spiritual relations survive time, death, distance and change. What a Fate Path worker takes hold of and spends is Thread: pulled down through the Attraction Layer for one working, never held, and paid for from the soul’s own share. Thread is Attraction Force pulled down, the same force and nothing separate from it. It is the third thing a soul can work, beside the Charge a Body fighter packs in the Shell and the Essence a Spirit worker holds in the Core, though it is no third thing a soul can store: a Fate soul’s reserve is Essence, refined as a Spirit soul refines it, the soul’s share is a part of that reserve, and a vow drains it and refills like any working.
Harmonics. Attraction Force is the lawful current beneath every Harmonics Sub-Stat. Attunement functions because it lets the soul recognize a Wellspring’s frequency and hold that recognition honestly. Axis functions because it sustains the Spirit Bond between two Crystals. Synergy functions because it lets allied resonances synchronize without overwriting each other. Strong Attraction expression makes every Harmonics Sub-Stat qualitatively richer at every numerical value.
Dominion. Domain formation is, mechanically, an act of Attraction Force. The Attraction Layer claims territory on the Plane of Fate, and that claim reflects downward into physical and spiritual law. Sovereignty, Fate, Command and Throne are all direct expressions of how cleanly that claim translates into environmental authority.
Resilience. Strengthens Oath, so sworn bonds become load-bearing; Anchoring, so identity holds its shape and its continuity because it is witnessed; and Continuity, so the causal timeline resists editing once the Continuum has registered it as recognized.
Tempering. Improves Coherence, since alignment between stated Path and lived behavior is easier to maintain when the soul is honestly witnessed, and Maturity, since bloodline traits and inherited Geasa activate more cleanly when the ancestral recognition chain is intact.
Combat applications. Maintaining coherent technique across long distances from bonded allies. Inheriting and transmitting combat forms through covenant rather than instruction. Recognizing an opponent’s true Essence beneath disguise or glamour. Stabilizing allies whose Essence is fraying by lending them legibility. Composing Domains centered on covenant and sanctuary. Carrying bonds past death in forms that remain clean and reciprocal. Its strength is durable mutuality. Its weakness is the weight of being honestly seen.
Costs. Essence becomes more legible to those who can read it, including those who would harm it. The Crystal carries the imprint of every covenant honored, and grief is the lawful tax on every covenant ended. Memory becomes weighted. Identity becomes accountable, defined in part by who has been allowed to witness it.
Obsession Force, the Law of Possession
The parasitic inversion. Where Attraction recognizes, Obsession imprisons. Where Attraction binds through mutual resonance, Obsession seals through hunger, fixation and refusal to release. It is the Current of Refusal in its personal, soul-to-soul expression: the moment recognition rots into possession and remembrance becomes a cage. In the terms of the Fate Path, Obsession is Thread held by force: pulled down like any other and then kept in the grip past the working it was pulled for. A pull so held leaves a heavier knot than a clean one of the same size.
Harmonics corruption. Collapses Breadth, leaving meaningful synchronization only with the object of obsession. Degrades Stability through emotional volatility around the fixation axis. Inverts Empathy into a one-directional parasitic channel: supernatural clarity on the object, blindness to all other emotional data. Attunement reports a frequency the practitioner has stopped actually holding.
Dominion corruption. Domains formed through Obsession do not feel open or sovereign. They feel airless. Memory repeats, distance shrinks unnaturally, every path bends back toward the fixation object. Sovereignty becomes Possession. Radius contracts rather than extends. The Domain folds inward around one meaning and refuses all exit.
Resilience degradation. Degrades Anchoring, so memory loses proportion and identity narrows to a single defining attachment, and Integrity, so the Crystal develops structural dependency on the fixation and removal of the object produces fracture events.
Tempering degradation. Degrades Coherence catastrophically; stated Path and lived behavior diverge around the axis of fixation. Maturity stalls because the soul is no longer integrating new experience. It is recycling one experience endlessly.
Combat applications. Locking onto one target with impossible persistence. Tethering souls or techniques to a chosen fixation. Ignoring pain through compulsive singularity. Forcing resonance overlap between self and enemy. Domains centered on possession and recursion. Bonds preserved past death in broken, predatory form. Its strength is terrifying focus. Its weakness is total collapse of perspective outside the fixation.
Risks. Essence coherence erodes. The Crystal narrows around one governing hunger. Other bonds weaken. Identity becomes recursive. At worst the user becomes an echo-organism of wanting, a living Essence Shard that never fully separated, still orbiting a source that is already gone. Where a World Spirit expands until others can live inside it, a soul claimed by Obsession Force contracts until nothing else can.
Part Fifteen — Magic System Integration
“Twenty-six categories, one underlying grammar.”
The stat system is the structural skeleton beneath every magic system in the four quarters. When a character casts a Sage Art, activates a Spirit Summon, inscribes a Parunic Draft or expresses a Hataraki Work, the mechanical interaction passes through the stat framework. The stats are the physical, spiritual and metaphysical architecture that determines whether a technique succeeds, fails, or destroys the caster.
Sage Arts
Terrain-anchored Wellspring communion. A Sage does not cast spells in the conventional sense. They synchronize their Crystal with a location’s ambient Wellspring activity and redirect it through their Aetheric architecture, which is to say they pull it in like anyone else, and steer nothing in the open ground. What comes back depends on the kind of ground: Wild ground gives the Sage the transformation itself, Spirit ground gives no fire and any discharge there is the Sage’s own Essence, and Fate ground works on bonds and odds and on nothing anyone can see.
Primary: Harmonics (Attunement, Synergy, Breadth) for synchronization; Gnosis (Perception, Analysis) for terrain reading; Dominion (Radius, Sense) for spatial extension.
Secondary: Ardency Depth governs pull depth. Tempering Capacity governs simultaneous harmonizations. Resilience Integrity governs how much ambient pressure can be absorbed without destabilization.
Corruption vectors. Verdantia Sages risk Endless Spring, inability to let anything end. Anima Spirare Sages risk Radiant Fever, life-force overdriven until the soul burns hollow. Tenebra Sages risk Shadow Saturation, inability to exist comfortably outside shadow. Manganthra Sages risk Eruption Dependence, inability to function without extreme environmental pressure. All manifest as degradation of Harmonics Stability, Tempering Coherence and Resilience Anchoring.
Spirit Summoning Arts
Five-step sequence: Intent, Pattern, Essence Donation, Aether Formation, Attraction Anchoring.
Primary: Ardency (Flux, Density) governs the construct’s output, structural weight and duration. Harmonics (Attunement, Breadth) governs inherited Wellspring alignment. Dominion (Radius, Gravity) governs operational independence and range.
Secondary: Gnosis Retention sets how many summon patterns can be held loaded. Tempering Yield sets how much Essence can be donated without depleting combat reserves. Dexterity Sequence sets command speed during engagement.
Wellspring inheritance. Summons inherit their creator’s alignment. A summoner tempered on Monolithion produces anchored, durable, slow-to-dissolve constructs. A summoner tempered on Nihiloth produces absence-constructs, void-forms and negation agents. The spirit’s behavior is a function of the summoner’s Harmonics profile, not a separate system.
Spirit Rune Arts
Aetheric effects encoded into Parunic inscription structures that persist independently of active concentration.
Primary: Gnosis Fluency governs inscription accuracy and glyph-chain complexity. Ardency (Density, Compression, Depth) governs durability, efficiency and alignment. Resilience (Ward, Hardening) governs protective rune capacity.
Secondary: Dexterity Finesse for physical precision of execution. Tempering Clarity for the cleanliness of Essence routed into the glyph. Dominion Gravity for persistence against environmental erosion.
Runes and tags, like chants, are skills and trades anyone with a woken Crystal can climb, and they show on the sheet on the nine ranks, Initiate to Paragon. Drafts are the one such trade a Crystal that never woke can pour.
Hataraki, the Works of the Plane of Fate
Not spells. The labor reality performs through practitioners who have become structurally aligned with specific principles of cosmic maintenance. Hataraki are Fate Arts, rare and held by bloodline, and their holders can take back or remove a blessing, whoever gave it. Nobody grips Fate bare, which is why there is more than one of them: each Work below is a distinct inherited way of taking hold of one function, and the stats listed are what that grip leans on. A Work lowers the chance of failure and never the price or the knot. It is a grip, and a grip lifts the ceiling on Fate Mastery, which without one stops at II, to the Stage’s own; the blood opens that road early, so a Moto holding a Work reads Fate I from Ascension, Stage III, before anyone else’s Mastery is read at all. Each Work is a legendary art that opens at a Mastery rung on the Fate road, and a holder has the ones they have found; Ruin and Knowledge open at Fate I, Purity at II, Balance and Spirit at III, Temporality at IV, and Totality at V with the other six found, whole only at Ω. A Moto does not get the Fate Path’s Range and Pressure unless that Moto walks it.

Zentai-sei (Totality) Dominion (Sovereignty, Throne), Tempering (Ceiling, Maturity), Resilience (Persistence, Continuity). Wholeness and cosmic maintenance. Doctrine that encompasses rather than excludes.
Hametsu no Gō (Ruins) Ardency (Flux, Overchannel, Cascade), Resilience (Ward, Persistence), Dominion (Pressure, Command). Necessary collapse. Doctrine that dismantles what can no longer sustain itself.
Unmei no Ori (Fate’s Cage) Dominion (Fate, Command, Sovereignty), Harmonics (Attunement, Axis), Resilience (Oath, Continuity). Binding and consequence. Doctrine that enforces the debts reality owes itself.
Shinsei Naru Hikari (Sacred Light) Harmonics (Attunement, Projection, Synergy), Gnosis (Perception, Analysis), Tempering (Clarity, Maturity). Illumination and purification. Doctrine that reveals truth as a structural force.
Eien no Yami (Eternal Dark) Resilience (Persistence, Ward), Harmonics (Stability, Suppression), Dominion (Sovereignty, Sense). Negation and sovereign silence. Doctrine that erases rather than creates.
Saisei no Wa (Cycle of Rebirth) Vitality (Regeneration, Constitution, Hemostasis), Tempering (Maturity, Tempering Yield), Harmonics (Synergy, Stability). Renewal. Doctrine that treats ending as the first motion of beginning.
Chowa no Koe (Voice of Harmony) Harmonics (Breadth, Synergy, Empathy, Attunement), Dominion (Command, Sovereignty, Radius), Gnosis (Fluency, Cognition). Concordance. Doctrine that synchronizes rather than commands.

Attraction and Obsession in Technique
Every technique is sustained at the deepest level by one or the other. Clean techniques are sustained by recognition: the Crystal recognizes the Wellspring’s law, the Continuum recognizes the intent, and the working persists because all parties agree it should. Corrupted techniques are sustained by refusal: the Crystal clutches the Aether rather than harmonizing with it, the Continuum registers the working as unauthorized, and Obsession Force, which is Thread held by force, sustains it through sheer fixation. Such workings are structurally unstable, emotionally recursive, and produce escalating soul-cost with each use, and where a pull is involved the knots they leave are heavier each time.
The system tracks the distinction through Harmonics Attunement against Tempering Coherence. High in both means the character is operating through Attraction Force. Attunement degrading while raw output stays high means Obsession Force, and the system will extract the cost.
Read next: Part Sixteen, and The Sixty Wellsprings for the entries in full.

the-magic-system/fracture-of-worlds-—-th.title: VI. The Sixteen Temperance Stages (Part Sixteen)
the-magic-system/fracture-of-worlds-—-th.content:
“You call Temperance a buff. It is a confession of how much you’ve survived.”
The Ruan Hall keeps its festival gongs for Lantern Night, and they have rung out of season exactly once. Ruan Ziyan, a physician of the hall, fifty-one years old and at Stage IV, known for a foul temper and good stitches, was lighting the third row of lanterns on the quay when a Well-spawn (a creature born where a Wellspring’s Aether pools) the height of the granary came up out of the canal, its mask the green of old bronze, and every outer disciple in sight remembered an errand. She went at it with a lamp pole. She held it for as long as it took the bridge to clear, and then it took her left arm off at the elbow with something like a shrug, and she went down on her knees among the broken paper and the burning oil with nine rows of ancestral tablets watching through the hall doors. Those nearest heard her Crystal go, crack after crack along every grudge she had ever kept. Her aura, a modest apple green all her life, split into three colors at once and roared up past the eaves, and every gong in the hall went off by itself.
She stood up laughing and sobbing, called the thing the son of a dead turnip in full archaic grammar, and broke its mask with the pole. The arm stayed gone, and for most of a year she wept at the sight of soup and could not be trusted with a needle, and the hall entered the night in its book under a title nine words long. A Guild roll writes all of that as Stage V, Splintering, and the quay said she had made Expert. Below are all sixteen under the tidy headings the Guild gives them, and a physician of the Ruan Hall has some notes on the word tidy.
Each Stage is said aloud as its rank, and the heading of each below gives the rank, the look of the Crystal at that Stage and the Level that can hold it; How Power Grows has the short road. Each Stage is a qualitative transformation in the architecture of the Crystal (the Soul Crystal, which is the soul itself). The Stages are structural reorganizations the Crystal undergoes when its Catalyst is met and its Level can hold what comes next: tempering melts it down and rebuilds each layer, refines Essence and makes it stronger, and the body gains Traits. That pressure is brought to the break by three roads, crisis, seclusion before the Threshold, or tribulation, and most practitioners walk some of each; the Catalyst named under each Stage is the moment the break is met, whichever road led there. A lived breakthrough passes through the four stages of the Great Work in its own Path’s terms, nigredo, albedo, citrinitas and rubedo, the soul broken down, purified, woken and fixed through the layer it leans on, which is what Ruan Ziyan was doing on her knees in the burning oil. A Draft or a blessing can supply that Catalyst instead, and then the Stage has simply been bought. A bought Stage opens the door and no more: if Level is short of the hold the Crystal sits Overgrown, power spilling and Mastery reading low, until living catches up, and Level, Mastery and every Release must still be lived, each Release with its own Catalyst. Sects teach the road to what money cannot buy (Part Eight has the terms). Each Stage alters how every stat behaves, not by adding numerical bonuses but by changing what the numbers are structurally permitted to mean.
The first fourteen constitute canonical mortal progression, Murmuring through Zenith. Stages XV and XVI, Revelation and Apex, extend beyond the canonical ceiling into the Apotheosis approach (the climb from mortal soul toward becoming an Archon).
Inner Refinement, Stages I through VII
Stage I — Murmuring (Initiate · Clouded · holds at Level 1)
The Crystal has opened. Essence (the soul’s own substance, spent as power) stirs but cannot be directed. The practitioner feels power as noise, a hum beneath the skin that responds to emotion but not to intent. All Sub-Stats (the sixty-four finer stats beneath the eight Primaries) present but volatile. Output unreliable and heavily mood-dependent. Ceiling 50. (Ceiling: the highest a Sub-Stat may stand at this Stage.) One home lens. The world has noticed you. You have not yet noticed the world noticing.
Stage II — Welling (Apprentice · Clouded · holds at Level 5)
Essence rises and spills before it can be contained. The practitioner feels the direction of their power but cannot control its volume. Techniques misfire regularly. The Aether Shell (the soul’s outer layer, which passes power out into the world) is forming but porous. Ceiling 100. Catalyst (the event that sets off the breakthrough): first genuine contact with the Aether of a Wellspring (one of the sixty governing ideas that transform how a soul uses Aether, each an alchemical and a spiritual transformation with its own type of Aether) under personal pressure.
Stage III — Ascension (Journeyman · Clouded · holds at Level 15)
First true awakening. The Path (the layer of the Crystal a soul has begun to lean on) becomes visible. The Crystal begins expressing a coherent identity rather than reactive noise. Techniques can be constructed deliberately. The practitioner transitions from surviving their power to directing it. Ceiling 175. An Epoch’s blood opens its own road early here: a Moto holding a Work, a Zettari holding Matla, a Yukari holding Null-Light reads rung I of Mastery on that road from this Stage. Catalyst: first technique developed independently from instruction.
Stage IV — Flourishing (Adept · Clouded · holds at Level 30)
Power blooms. Identity stabilizes. The resonance signature becomes recognizable and consistent. Techniques cohere into a personal style rather than isolated expressions. The first genuine Spirit Axis bonds (bonds with another soul that carry real weight) become mechanically possible. The First Release (the one concept taken into a transformed body) opens from this Stage for a soul whose lead Path is Body or Spirit, each with its own Catalyst; the Fate road has no First and waits for the One. Ceiling 275. The last Stage of one lens. Catalyst: formation of the first genuine Spirit Axis bond.
Stage V — Splintering (Expert · Faceted · holds at Level 101)
The soul cracks open to become something larger. The first crisis Stage. The architecture has reached the limit of its initial configuration and must break to grow. Characters who pass through emerge with deeper but less stable power. Characters who fail fracture and may lose Sub-Stat progress. Allocation stops at 275. Ceiling 350, the band from 276 to 350 the instability zone, reachable only under strain. Catalyst: surviving contact with an entity or force more than two full steps above the character’s current ceiling. From Expert a soul may safely harmonize a second lens. The Crystal fractures along emotional lines.
Stage VI — Glory (Expert · Faceted · holds at Level 115)
Peak of the inner phase. The self burns bright and is noticed. The Aura’s weight on a room, felt Stage by Stage all the way up, can no longer be mistaken for anything else. Techniques carry the weight of identity rather than improvisation. The Crystal has processed Splintering’s fractures into features. Mastery (one rung per Path, I to V and Ω, how cleanly a soul works its road’s substance) can first be read, at I, the soul makes its first offer of a named Class, and the Echo field forms. Mastery is never tracked: Glory sets its ceiling at I and Level places the soul under it. The scholars once read three separate class ladders here, the Aether, Essence and Thread Classes. Ceiling 400. Catalyst: willingly accepting genuine soul-cost to preserve something valued above the character’s own structural integrity.
Stage VII — Refraction (Expert · Faceted · holds at Level 130)
Dual sight. The soul sees itself from outside. The practitioner begins perceiving their own Crystal architecture as an object of study rather than an unconscious medium. Domain (a space where a soul’s inner law becomes local reality) seeds can be called and held from here, through the Second Release that opens at this Stage on the Body and Spirit roads, or through the One, the Fate road’s single Release, which opens here, deeper than any First, and counts as its Second. Mastery’s ceiling rises to II. Gnosis (the Primary stat for perception and understanding) Sub-Stats undergo a qualitative jump as self-awareness extends to metaphysical structure. Projected fields are coherent but still depend on sustained presence. Traits (a belief hardened into a personal law of the soul) externalize. Allocation stops at 400, with late push past it. Ceiling 475, the band from 401 reachable only under strain. Catalyst: first Domain seed activation, a one-time flicker of the person’s own Trait at the Threshold, which needs no Release.
Outer Influence, Stages VIII through XIV
Stage VIII — Transcendence (Master · Fire · holds at Level 201)
The world is read as symbol. The practitioner resolves a core internal contradiction documented in the Crystal’s fracture record, a wound carried as structural damage and consciously processed into architecture. A true Domain can form from here, grown by living and called aloud, a piece of the lattice that accepts the soul’s signature. Techniques begin channeling forces larger than the individual. Ardency (the stat for raw power output) and Harmonics (the stat for pulling on outside Aether) undergo a qualitative shift as external power sources become structurally integrated. Mastery’s ceiling rises to III, and a fresh Master at Level 201 reads II until Level 215. A third lens may be held. Ceiling 550.
Stage IX — Invocation (Master · Fire · holds at Level 215)
The practitioner calls on Wellsprings, Titans or Archonic law (the law of the Archons, the world’s fourteen great powers) as co-authors of their expression. Techniques are no longer purely personal. The Third Release, the Body road’s last, opens at this Stage. A Realm, a Domain capable of holding other Domains, is the far end of every road, and each Path reaches it by its own door, late: Body through the Third, Spirit through its Second grown whole, Fate through the One. Each door opens no earlier than Realization: the Body’s asks another’s world carried, and not let fall; the Spirit’s, another’s whole meaning held inside your own, and both left true; Fate’s, a claim others stand on, kept for them (How Power Grows gives the three Realms). Pacts, artifacts and law begin to imprint on terrain. Allocation stops at 550, with late push past it. Ceiling 625, the band from 551 reachable only under strain. Catalyst: a first flicker of a Realm at the Threshold, once, on the same terms as the seed.
Stage X — Realization (Master · Fire · holds at Level 230)
Truth as lived consequence. The world answers back. The Domain becomes a reality the Continuum (the whole fabric of reality) must accommodate rather than merely permit. Emotional and moral stability begins having direct environmental consequences. Mastery’s ceiling rises to IV, and a fresh soul here reads III until Level 260. Ceiling 725. Catalyst: Domain achieving Continuum accommodation, the moment reality stops resisting the character’s inner law and starts adapting to it.
Stage XI — Dissonance (Grandmaster · Flawless · holds at Level 301)
Power and identity clash. The second crisis Stage and the most dangerous. The Crystal has accumulated enough pressure to threaten its own coherence. Characters who pass through emerge with Crystals fractured but denser than clean advancement could produce. Tempering Overflow, Ardency Overchannel and Resilience Persistence can only reach their true ceiling in characters who have passed through Dissonance. The fractures are not damage. They are architectural features. Passive miracles leak. Regions behave differently around the character. Allocation stops at 725, with fracture risk above 700. Ceiling 750, structurally unstable, the band from 726 reachable only under strain. Catalyst: deliberately entering contact with a force capable of ending the character’s existence and remaining coherent long enough to choose how to meet it.
Stage XII — Emanation (Grandmaster · Flawless · holds at Level 320)
Emergence from Dissonance. The Crystal is denser and cleaner than before entry. Fractures have become features. The practitioner radiates outward. Domains form naturally around them. Presence alters ambient metaphysical conditions without deliberate activation. Traits become local law. Dominion (the stat for presence and pressure on others) undergoes its most significant jump. The character transitions from projecting power to embodying it. Mastery’s ceiling rises to V, the last rung below Ω, and a fresh soul here reads IV until Level 340. Ceiling 950. Four lenses.
Stage XIII — Principality (Archmaster · Starred · holds at Level 401)
A local force of nature. First World Spirit threshold. Domain coherence reaches the level where the Continuum formally registers a law the character embodies. Their doctrine becomes a recognized structural feature of local reality. Biomes carry their doctrine. The Crystal self-writes. Dominion Sovereignty and Command undergo their final qualitative transformation. The character is no longer merely powerful. They are legislating. Five lenses. Ceiling 1,200.
Stage XIV — Zenith (Archmaster · Starred · holds at Level 420)
Furthest reach of canonical mortal coherence. Full World Spirit. The accumulated doctrine becomes recognizable to a Hollow Throne, and the Throne resonates with them. Zenith is not a breakthrough. It is recognition, and recognition from a Hollow Throne carries weight no amount of power alone can replicate. A purse can buy the Catalyst here as for any Stage, and the Throne must still recognize the buyer, so money buys the attempt and not the seat. Reality acclimates to the character. Story becomes physics.
Zenith does not end. It is the state of a soul that has reached the upper boundary of mortal architecture and remains there, pressing against what it has not yet become. Speed, attack output and all conventional metrics require metaphysical recalibration to even register. The character does not fight. They exist, and their existence has consequences that other characters survive or fail to survive. Ceiling 1,500.
Beyond Canon, Stages XV and XVI
Stage XV — Revelation (Paragon · Absolute · holds at Level 500)
Genuine exchange with an Archon or Titan at the level of participant rather than witness or casualty. The Crystal has become dense enough to hold Archon-grade pressure without collapsing. All Sub-Stats gain access to the top of the scale, and Mastery may at last read Ω. Six lenses. The first step of the Apotheosis approach, where the distinction between mortal soul and Principle begins to dissolve.
At Revelation, output is no longer measurable against mortal-scale benchmarks. Techniques do not merely carry force. They carry precedent. A Revelation-stage working does not just happen. It becomes something that has always been possible, a retroactive edit to local metaphysical grammar. Ceiling 2,200.
Stage XVI — Apex (Paragon · Absolute · the Apotheosis approach)
Holding a Principle in the Soul Crystal without fracturing. The accumulated doctrine has reached a density where the Crystal can temporarily contain a truth normally reserved for beings that have completed Apotheosis.
Apex is perpetual. It does not end. It is the state of a soul pressing against what it has not yet become, with enough structural coherence to press back. No formal upper ceiling beneath Apotheosis. The character is not waiting to become an Archon. They are demonstrating whether they should. Catalyst: holding a Principle in the Crystal, even momentarily, even imperfectly. Recognition from a Hollow Throne that has not merely resonated but responded.
Read next: Parts Seventeen to Nineteen. The account in words is The Sixteen Stages and The Ladder and the Draft, and Classes and Mastery sets each Stage against Mastery’s ceiling.
