Applied · [Stg] Stagnate · Murmuring and above

























WellspringTenebra (Wild)Second WellspringLetheveilOperationSeparationTemperanceMurmuring (Initiate) and above
Effect. Hides contamination as serene illusion.
How it works.

The idea. The hidden shadow. Going unseen, quieter than the world around you, and the old question of what you are hiding from. Letheveil’s idea rides with it (forgetting on purpose, learning which memories hold up the house and which ones are chains, and cutting the chains. It surfaces when denial has started to cost more than acceptance).
The operation. Separation. The soul is parted from the world’s notice and kept quieter than everything around it.
In the worker. Held to Murmuring or past, the idea is set as law by [Stg] Stagnate, and the world gives way that far: hides contamination as serene illusion.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus revealed by pure sight.
Flaw. Going unseen is always hiding from someone, and a soul can hide only from what it has thought of. Watched from the one direction they did not plan for, a Tenebra practitioner is a very bright thing indeed. Pushed too hard, the hiding fills up: everything swallowed is still in the Shell, and a practitioner kept quieter than the world past their limit lets it all go at once and lights up on every sense in the room.
Counter. [Oc] Oculus refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Penanceflare, Judicium or Aurevane.
The Measurewrights’ line. Signal-to-noise reduction.

Cost and backlash. Revealed by pure sight
Counterplay. [Oc] Oculus
Still Mist
Applied · [Stl] Still · Murmuring and above

























WellspringLetheveil (Spirit)Second WellspringSomnalisOperationSeparationTemperanceMurmuring (Initiate) and above
Effect. One-beat freeze cloaked in damp fog for clean reposition.
How it works.

The idea. Forgetting on purpose. Learning which memories hold up the house and which ones are chains, and cutting the chains. It surfaces when denial has started to cost more than acceptance. Somnalis’s idea rides with it (living among what might be, the near possibilities of the Plane of Fate held in view at once, each with its odds on it, and a soul at ease in the not knowing).
The operation. Separation. The memories that are chains are parted from the ones that hold up the house, and skimmed off.
In the worker. Held to Murmuring or past, the idea is set as law by [Stl] Still, and the world gives way that far: one-beat freeze cloaked in damp fog for clean reposition.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus countered by speed bursts.
Flaw. Forgetting on purpose is only as good as the worker’s guess at which memories are chains, and every guess after the first is made with the memories already cut. Each pass takes off a little more, and a memory skimmed again and again wears down toward a made thing the practitioner still experiences as a memory.
Counter. [Gl] Gale refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Phreatis, Anamnesis or Redemption.
The Measurewrights’ line. Lossy compression.

Cost and backlash. Countered by speed bursts
Counterplay. [Gl] Gale
Still-Sleep Rite
Applied · [StSl] Still-Sleep · Transcendence and above

























WellspringLethegraal (Spirit)Second WellspringSomnalisOperationDissolutionTemperanceTranscendence (Master) and above
Effect. Suspends a target perfectly in Valthrum stasis; time-locked until Temperance-equal release.
How it works.

The idea. The cup. Time’s mercy hurried along: old pain settles on its own schedule, and no hand chooses what falls. Somnalis’s idea rides with it (living among what might be, the near possibilities of the Plane of Fate held in view at once, each with its odds on it, and a soul at ease in the not knowing).
The operation. Dissolution. Old pain is loosened into the soul on its own schedule until nothing of it is left but plain structure that holds weight.
In the worker. Held to Transcendence or past, the idea is set as law by [StSl] Still-Sleep, and the world gives way that far: suspends a target perfectly in Valthrum stasis; time-locked until Temperance-equal release.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus caster partially stills; fingers frost, perception lag for hours.
Flaw. The cup can hurry time’s mercy and cannot choose where the settling stops, because no hand chooses what falls. Hurry it too far and the old pain does not come to rest but swings past it on every cycle, and the practitioner rocks back and forth rather than settling.
Counter. [Wy] Motion refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Cataclysm, Penance or Contrition.
The Measurewrights’ line. Relaxation time.

Cost and backlash. Caster partially stills; fingers frost, perception lag for hours
Counterplay. [Wy] Motion
Thunder Path
Applied · [Thn] Thunder · Flourishing and above

























WellspringCataclysm (Wild)Second WellspringTerranovaOperationCalcinationTemperanceFlourishing (Adept) and above
Effect. Nonlinear lightning run that avoids friendlies.
How it works.

The idea. Upheaval. The moment a fire stops being a fire and becomes a blast, a change in kind as well as size, and the soul that has learned to call that moment. Terranova’s idea rides with it (the living earth, mending by growing, every wound answered with new ground).
The operation. Calcination. The burning is driven past itself until it goes over all at once into something else in kind.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Thn] Thunder, and the world gives way that far: nonlinear lightning run that avoids friendlies.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus charge diffusion.
Flaw. Upheaval needs something to hold it in before it can go over, and once it goes it does not know which side of the wall it was called from. In confinement the blast comes back along its own path, and the practitioner standing where it began takes the blast and its return together.
Counter. [Nl] Null refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Solfatara or Lethegraal.
The Measurewrights’ line. Deflagration-to-detonation transition.

Cost and backlash. Charge diffusion
Counterplay. [Nl] Null
Tide Drain
Applied · [Let] Tide · Flourishing and above

























WellspringAbyntheus (Spirit)Second WellspringDissolutionOperationSublimationTemperanceFlourishing (Adept) and above
Effect. Rhythmic pull siphons overcharged enemy casters, reducing their output to Murmuring-level.
How it works.

The idea. Vastness. The great scale read off the small vessel, a mortal soul stretched to take in things far too large for it. Dissolution’s idea rides with it (unbinding, what no longer serves is allowed to come apart on its own, and keeping anything at all becomes the work).
The operation. Sublimation. The small soul is raised toward the great scale and brought back down still holding it.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Let] Tide, and the world gives way that far: rhythmic pull siphons overcharged enemy casters, reducing their output to Murmuring-level.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus drained Essence must be expelled or caster bloats.
Flaw. The small vessel can hold the great scale only while it still knows it is small. Stretched too long between the near end and the far one, the soul loses its sense of how the two fit together, and what comes back to it is noise the practitioner is nonetheless convinced is a signal.
Counter. [Asa] Creation refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Coagulatio.
The Measurewrights’ line. Very-long-wavelength propagation and interferometry.

Cost and backlash. Drained Essence must be expelled or caster bloats
Counterplay. [Asa] Creation
Topology Lockdown
Applied · [Tp] Topology · Refraction and above

























WellspringFixatio (Medium)Second WellspringMateria PrimordiaOperationCoagulationTemperanceRefraction (Expert) and above
Effect. Freezes local outcome grid for a brief window.
How it works.

The idea. Commitment. What is bound here stays bound, because the way back has stopped existing. Materia Primordia’s idea rides with it (the first substance, one self and many forms, and a soul that finds it can become its own opposite and still be itself).
The operation. Coagulation. What is bound is set past melting, and the way back is gone.
In the worker. Held to Refraction or past, the idea is set as law by [Tp] Topology, and the world gives way that far: freezes local outcome grid for a brief window.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus grid shatters.
Flaw. Commitment cannot tell a true binding from a mistaken one, because the way back is closed for both alike. Wanting it undone does not undo it, and a Fixatio binding placed in error is a permanent feature of whatever it was placed on.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Manganthra, Somnalis or Dissolution.
The Measurewrights’ line. Covalent cross-linking.

Cost and backlash. Grid shatters
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption
Vector Spark
Applied · [Vt] Vector · Murmuring and above

























WellspringIgnivale (Wild)Second WellspringTerranovaOperationCalcinationTemperanceMurmuring (Initiate) and above
Effect. Directs a cone of micro-ignitions along a plotted line.
How it works.

The idea. The spark. The smallest beginning that goes on to pay for itself, so that the gap between wanting a thing and doing it closes to almost nothing. Terranova’s idea rides with it (the living earth, mending by growing, every wound answered with new ground).
The operation. Calcination. One point of fire is set to the work at the first degree, and the burning is left to pay its own way.
In the worker. Held to Murmuring or past, the idea is set as law by [Vt] Vector, and the world gives way that far: directs a cone of micro-ignitions along a plotted line.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus ignition fizzles in null-zones.
Flaw. With the gap between wanting and doing closed, the soul has no moment left in which to decide. Any stray feeling in the room is beginning enough, and the working fires without the practitioner having decided to fire it.
Counter. [Nl] Null refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Pyraeon or Hypnather.
The Measurewrights’ line. Minimum ignition energy and the activation barrier.

Cost and backlash. Ignition fizzles in null-zones
Counterplay. [Nl] Null
Voice of Thread
Applied · [Vo] Voice · Murmuring and above

























WellspringThaloré (Spirit)Second WellspringOblationOperationDissolutionTemperanceMurmuring (Initiate) and above
Effect. Spoken fate-tag binds oath to listener.
How it works.

The idea. Depth of feeling. Emotion given its true weight in the soul, so that a grief can press on every soul in a whole room. A soul under this lens takes the shape of what holds it, and is likelier than most to fall into Synergia (Crystals briefly sharing one working) and Echo Bonds. Oblation’s idea rides with it (the offering, a bargain struck on the Plane of Fate: what you give up comes back as force, and never one grain more than you gave).
The operation. Dissolution. A feeling is let down through the whole soul to its true depth, and the soul takes the shape of what holds it.
In the worker. Held to Murmuring or past, the idea is set as law by [Vo] Voice, and the world gives way that far: spoken fate-tag binds oath to listener.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus knot supersedes thread.
Flaw. A feeling given its true weight weighs on the one who feels it as surely as on the room, and the idea does not choose which way it presses. A Thaloré practitioner whose own inner support fails is crushed under the weight they were laying on everyone else.
Counter. [Knt] Knot refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Nyxial or Abython.
The Measurewrights’ line. Hydrostatic pressure.

Cost and backlash. Knot supersedes thread
Counterplay. [Knt] Knot
Void Expunge
Applied · [Vn] Void · Transcendence and above

























WellspringNihiloth (Wild)Second WellspringOblivaraOperationDissolutionTemperanceTranscendence (Master) and above
Effect. Double-layered null field strips Essence then hollows the remaining structure to dust.
How it works.

The idea. The hollow law. Power by negation: the rule itself unmade, and what stands in the gap. Oblivara’s idea rides with it (keeping your name, a self written down on the Plane of Fate so many times that it cannot be erased, with whatever is done to it sent back where it came from).
The operation. Dissolution. The rule itself is loosed until nothing of it is left, and the gap is left standing where it was.
In the worker. Held to Transcendence or past, the idea is set as law by [Vn] Void, and the world gives way that far: double-layered null field strips Essence then hollows the remaining structure to dust.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus catastrophic self-null if timing off by one beat.
Flaw. A rule unmade is unmade for everyone, and the idea has no way to spare its maker. Everything the practitioner brought inside is subject to the same gap, including the parts of themselves they were relying on.
Counter. [El] Life refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Eidolyn, Oblivara or Monolithion.
The Measurewrights’ line. Destructive interference and the null field.

Cost and backlash. Catastrophic self-null if timing off by one beat
Counterplay. [El] Life
Weave Pact
Applied · [Wvn] Weave · Murmuring and above

























WellspringMirithane (Spirit)Second WellspringFixatioOperationConjunctionTemperanceMurmuring (Initiate) and above
Effect. Foundation pact glyph for conjunction arrays; two weavers lock a third glyph in place.
How it works.

The idea. The honest mirror. The inside and the outside made one surface. Fixatio’s idea rides with it (commitment, what is bound here stays bound, because the way back has stopped existing).
The operation. Conjunction. The inside and the outside are joined into one surface, so what leaves the soul is what is in it.
In the worker. Held to Murmuring or past, the idea is set as law by [Wvn] Weave, and the world gives way that far: foundation pact glyph for conjunction arrays; two weavers lock a third glyph in place.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus Snap-back if one weaver breaks concentration.
Flaw. An honest mirror shows everything or it is not honest, and the idea has no way to keep one thing back. A practitioner in a state they would rather not broadcast broadcasts it perfectly.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Luminalis or Oneirion.
The Measurewrights’ line. Specular reflection.

Cost and backlash. Snap-back if one weaver breaks concentration
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption
Whisper Thread
Applied · [Wh] Whisper · Flourishing and above

























WellspringThaloré (Spirit)Second WellspringAnamnesisOperationDissolutionTemperanceFlourishing (Adept) and above

Anamnesis’s idea rides with it (remembrance, everything keeps its past, and a soul under this lens can touch a thing and read it).
The operation. Dissolution. A feeling is let down through the whole soul to its true depth, and the soul takes the shape of what holds it.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Wh] Whisper, and the world gives way that far: secret carries along a fate-tag to a destined ear.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus Traceable by true-edge.
Flaw. A feeling given its true weight weighs on the one who feels it as surely as on the room, and the idea does not choose which way it presses. A Thaloré practitioner whose own inner support fails is crushed under the weight they were laying on everyone else.

The Measurewrights’ line. Hydrostatic pressure.

Cost and backlash. Traceable by true-edge

Wildlaw Override
Applied · [WL] Wildlaw · Refraction and above

























WellspringVerdantia (Wild)Second WellspringFracturaOperationFermentationTemperanceRefraction (Expert) and above
Effect. Forcibly dissolves constructed wards and geometric enchantments with the wild’s own rot, the made thing given back to growth and decay.
How it works.

The idea. Growth without end. A self with no final size, which feeds on simply being out in the world. It comes through accumulation rather than rupture, one good day on top of another. Fractura’s idea rides with it (the breaking point, everything has a place where it will go, and this lens shows it to you, in bridges, in friends and in your own left wrist).
The operation. Fermentation. The soul is fed a little at a time from the world it stands in, and grows on that feeding without end.
In the worker. Held to Refraction or past, the idea is set as law by [WL] Wildlaw, and the world gives way that far: Forcibly dissolves constructed wards and geometric enchantments with the wild’s own rot, the made thing given back to growth and decay.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus uncontrolled growth bleeds outward; friendlies caught in radius.
Flaw. A self with no final size cannot stop growing, even when the world has stopped feeding it. Shut away from the open air it grows on anyway, all length and no substance, until it cannot hold itself up.
Counter. [Th] Structure refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Monolithion or Mortalis.

Cost and backlash. Uncontrolled growth bleeds outward; friendlies caught in radius
Counterplay. [Th] Structure

Applied workings that echo a root invocation, the root’s shape carried down into common use.

Effect. Freezes one outcome branch while verdict is cast.

The idea. Commitment. What is bound here stays bound, because the way back has stopped existing. Judicium’s idea rides with it (truth told apart, discernment that knows what a thing is made of, and whether it is lying, from the mark it cannot help leaving).

The idea. Commitment. What is bound here stays bound, because the way back has stopped existing. Coagula’s idea rides with it (gathering the broken, scattered pieces come back into one body without ever melting, keeping the shape they had while broken, the flesh first and then the soul that wears it).
The operation. Coagulation. What is bound is set past melting, and the way back is gone.
In the worker. Held to Dissonance or past, the idea is set as law by [Krn] Crown, and the world gives way that far: lock a command structure into causal priority within a Domain.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus rigidity; brittleness to sudden change.

Root echo · [Ma] Memory · Flourishing and above

























WellspringAnamnesis (Medium)Second WellspringJudiciumOperationSeparationTemperanceFlourishing and above
Effect. Recall a memory as it truly was while auto-leveling emotional bias; ideal for testimony.
How it works.

The idea. Remembrance. Everything keeps its past, and a soul under this lens can touch a thing and read it. Judicium’s idea rides with it (truth told apart, discernment that knows what a thing is made of, and whether it is lying, from the mark it cannot help leaving).
The operation. Separation. The past a thing has kept is parted from it and read, as the residue is parted from the vessel that held it.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Ma] Memory, and the world gives way that far: recall a memory as it truly was while auto-leveling emotional bias; ideal for testimony.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus phase Lag if overused.
Flaw. Everything keeps its past, and the reading becomes part of that past the moment it is made. A careless hand laid on the record writes itself over what it came to read, so a careless practitioner erases the record in the act of taking it.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Letheveil or Sublimatio.

Equilibrium Command
Root echo · [Ur] Balance · Flourishing and above

























WellspringMirithane (Spirit)Second WellspringJudiciumOperationConjunctionTemperanceFlourishing and above
Effect. Stabilize a field while issuing a binding command respected by Essence.
How it works.

The idea. The honest mirror. The inside and the outside made one surface. Judicium’s idea rides with it (truth told apart, discernment that knows what a thing is made of, and whether it is lying, from the mark it cannot help leaving).
The operation. Conjunction. The inside and the outside are joined into one surface, so what leaves the soul is what is in it.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Ur] Balance, and the world gives way that far: stabilize a field while issuing a binding command respected by Essence.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus authority feedback if will falters.
Flaw. An honest mirror shows everything or it is not honest, and the idea has no way to keep one thing back. A practitioner in a state they would rather not broadcast broadcasts it perfectly.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Luminalis or Oneirion.
The Measurewrights’ line. Specular reflection.

Cost and backlash. Authority feedback if will falters
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption
Flux Severance
Root echo · [Wy] Motion · Transcendence and above

























WellspringCataclysm (Wild)Second WellspringLethegraalOperationCalcinationTemperanceTranscendence and above
Effect. Explosive burst of speed inside a slowed-time bubble for surgical strikes.
How it works.

The idea. Upheaval. The moment a fire stops being a fire and becomes a blast, a change in kind as well as size, and the soul that has learned to call that moment. Lethegraal’s idea rides with it (the cup, time’s mercy hurried along: old pain settles on its own schedule, and no hand chooses what falls).
The operation. Calcination. The burning is driven past itself until it goes over all at once into something else in kind.
In the worker. Held to Transcendence or past, the idea is set as law by [Wy] Motion, and the world gives way that far: explosive burst of speed inside a slowed-time bubble for surgical strikes.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus temporal lag; rebound fatigue.
Flaw. Upheaval needs something to hold it in before it can go over, and once it goes it does not know which side of the wall it was called from. In confinement the blast comes back along its own path, and the practitioner standing where it began takes the blast and its return together.
Counter. [Ho] Order refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Solfatara or Lethegraal.
The Measurewrights’ line. Deflagration-to-detonation transition.

Cost and backlash. Temporal lag; rebound fatigue
Counterplay. [Ho] Order
Heartflare Accord
Root echo · [Ve] Desire · Welling and above

























WellspringMirithane (Spirit)Second WellspringExurothOperationConjunctionTemperanceWelling and above
Effect. Unite a group under shared longing, boosting morale and Essence sync.
How it works.

The idea. The honest mirror. The inside and the outside made one surface. Exuroth’s idea rides with it (the trial by fire, power comes only through ordeal, plunged and reheated and plunged again, until the soul holds a hardness no gentle road could have given it).
The operation. Conjunction. The inside and the outside are joined into one surface, so what leaves the soul is what is in it.
In the worker. Held to Welling or past, the idea is set as law by [Ve] Desire, and the world gives way that far: Unite a group under shared longing, boosting morale and Essence sync.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus group obsession if goal fails.
Flaw. An honest mirror shows everything or it is not honest, and the idea has no way to keep one thing back. A practitioner in a state they would rather not broadcast broadcasts it perfectly.
Counter. [Sil] Silence refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Luminalis or Oneirion.
The Measurewrights’ line. Specular reflection.

Cost and backlash. Group obsession if goal fails
Counterplay. [Sil] Silence
Hollow End
Root echo · [Thru] Hollow · Dissonance and above

























WellspringNihiloth (Wild)Second WellspringDissolutionOperationDissolutionTemperanceDissonance and above
Effect. Erase the purpose of a construct and collapse it to termination state.
How it works.

The idea. The hollow law. Power by negation: the rule itself unmade, and what stands in the gap. Dissolution’s idea rides with it (unbinding, what no longer serves is allowed to come apart on its own, and keeping anything at all becomes the work).
The operation. Dissolution. The rule itself is loosed until nothing of it is left, and the gap is left standing where it was.
In the worker. Held to Dissonance or past, the idea is set as law by [Thru] Hollow, and the world gives way that far: erase the purpose of a construct and collapse it to termination state.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus backlash emptiness; despair.
Flaw. A rule unmade is unmade for everyone, and the idea has no way to spare its maker. Everything the practitioner brought inside is subject to the same gap, including the parts of themselves they were relying on.
Counter. [Vael] Renewal refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Eidolyn, Oblivara or Monolithion.
The Measurewrights’ line. Destructive interference and the null field.

Cost and backlash. Backlash emptiness; despair
Counterplay. [Vael] Renewal
Judged Path
Root echo · [Ur] Balance · Flourishing and above

























WellspringJudicium (Wild)Second WellspringThaloréOperationSeparationTemperanceFlourishing and above
Effect. Creates a route that equalizes threat on both sides, averting ambush bias.
How it works.

The idea. Truth told apart. Discernment that knows what a thing is made of, and whether it is lying, from the mark it cannot help leaving. Thaloré’s idea rides with it (depth of feeling, emotion given its true weight in the soul, so that a grief can press on every soul in a whole room. A soul under this lens takes the shape of what holds it, and is likelier than most to fall into Synergia (Crystals briefly sharing one working) and Echo Bonds).
The operation. Separation. A thing is parted from what it claims to be, the true told apart from the false by the mark it cannot help leaving.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Ur] Balance, and the world gives way that far: creates a route that equalizes threat on both sides, averting ambush bias.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus Rigid routing under chaos.
Flaw. Discernment tells everything apart and cannot choose to leave anything untold. Off guard, every object in view reports what it is made of at once, and the reader loses the power to put any of it first. Pushed past the point where a reading only reads, telling a thing apart becomes taking it apart: the read starts to pass judgment, which can turn away force or at the very top end a life, and since it has no way to look at one thing only, it takes the reader’s own memory in the same stroke.
Counter. [Rk] Rupture refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Tenebra or Eidolyn.
The Measurewrights’ line. Emission and absorption spectroscopy.

Cost and backlash. Rigid routing under chaos
Counterplay. [Rk] Rupture
Lightward Path
Root echo · [Lum] Light + [Oth] Path · Welling and above

























WellspringLuminalis (Medium)Second WellspringEclipseronOperationSeparationTemperanceWelling and above
Effect. Lights a safe route through darkness or illusion, visible only to the caster and those they choose to share it with.
How it works.

The idea. The hidden light. Seeing what hides and hiding what shows, one act run in two directions. Eclipseron’s idea rides with it (reading what is missing, the shape of an absence taken as knowledge of the thing that cast it. This lens has the truest claim of the Sixty to reading what fails to be there. People call that darkness and are being romantic: it is a system described by its absences, which is a harder and less romantic thing than its practitioners generally admit).
The operation. Separation. What is seen is parted from what is there, so the hidden can be drawn into view and the shown put out of it.
In the worker. Held to Welling or past, the idea is set as law by [Lum] Light + [Oth] Path, and the world gives way that far: lights a safe route through darkness or illusion, visible only to the caster and those they choose to share it with.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the light attracts anything that hunts by sight as readily as it guides.
Flaw. Seeing and hiding are one act run two ways, and a soul that keeps both running at once begins to run two ways itself. Its own output splits along the seam between what it shows and what it hides, the two halves going out at different paces, and complex workings arrive out of step with themselves.
Counter. [Vl] Veil refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Penanceflare or Mirithane.
The Measurewrights’ line. The non-visible spectrum and polarization.

Cost and backlash. The light attracts anything that hunts by sight as readily as it guides.
Counterplay. [Vl] Veil
Mirror Bloom
Root echo · [Sar] Reflection + [Yn] Bloom · Refraction and above

























WellspringLuminalis (Medium)Second WellspringVerdantiaOperationSeparationTemperanceRefraction and above
Effect. Reflects a wound’s healing progress back at accelerated rate, showing the caster exactly how much regrowth remains before it completes.
How it works.

The idea. The hidden light. Seeing what hides and hiding what shows, one act run in two directions. Verdantia’s idea rides with it (growth without end, a self with no final size, which feeds on simply being out in the world. It comes through accumulation rather than rupture, one good day on top of another).
The operation. Separation. What is seen is parted from what is there, so the hidden can be drawn into view and the shown put out of it.
In the worker. Held to Refraction or past, the idea is set as law by [Sar] Reflection + [Yn] Bloom, and the world gives way that far: reflects a wound’s healing progress back at accelerated rate, showing the caster exactly how much regrowth remains before it completes.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus reflected wounds sting sharper than the original as they close.
Flaw. Seeing and hiding are one act run two ways, and a soul that keeps both running at once begins to run two ways itself. Its own output splits along the seam between what it shows and what it hides, the two halves going out at different paces, and complex workings arrive out of step with themselves.
Counter. [Vl] Veil refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Penanceflare or Mirithane.
The Measurewrights’ line. The non-visible spectrum and polarization.

Cost and backlash. Reflected wounds sting sharper than the original as they close.
Counterplay. [Vl] Veil
Mirror of True Sight
Root echo · [Ie] Sight · Welling and above

























WellspringOneirion (Spirit)Second WellspringLuminalisOperationSublimationTemperanceWelling and above
Effect. Reveal the truth behind illusions without dispelling their form.
How it works.

The idea. Dream as a place. Work done in the space of what can be thought, reaching a soul where no line of sight runs, because no soul was ever in the room. Luminalis’s idea rides with it (the hidden light, seeing what hides and hiding what shows, one act run in two directions).
The operation. Sublimation. The working is lifted off every bench into the space of what can be thought, and comes down again in a soul.
In the worker. Held to Welling or past, the idea is set as law by [Ie] Sight, and the world gives way that far: reveal the truth behind illusions without dispelling their form.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus cognitive dissonance; headache.
Flaw. A dream is a place with no ground under it, and nothing done there knows where it is in a room. A working that was true in the space of what can be thought lands nowhere in particular when it has to come down into a real one.
Counter. [Et] Mirage refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Mirithane or Chthonica.
The Measurewrights’ line. Configuration space.

Cost and backlash. Cognitive dissonance; headache
Counterplay. [Et] Mirage
Pathfold Gate
Root echo · [Zh] Space · Dissonance and above

























WellspringTransmutatio (Wild)Second WellspringMateria PrimordiaOperationFermentationTemperanceDissonance and above
Effect. Create a short-range fold linking two points across fortified space.
How it works.

The idea. Change without loss. The same thing said another way, so that what looked like a failure turns out to be fuel in an inconvenient form. Materia Primordia’s idea rides with it (the first substance, one self and many forms, and a soul that finds it can become its own opposite and still be itself).
The operation. Fermentation. What was spent is worked over into another form of itself, with nothing added and nothing lost.
In the worker. Held to Dissonance or past, the idea is set as law by [Zh] Space, and the world gives way that far: create a short-range fold linking two points across fortified space.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus spatial nausea; corridor drift under dissonance.
Flaw. Change without loss holds only while someone remembers what the thing was first. Let the practitioner forget which terms they started in, and a change with nothing to return to does not bring back anything recognizable.
Counter. [RenB] Boundary refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Oblation or Basilithe.
The Measurewrights’ line. Change of basis.

Cost and backlash. Spatial nausea; corridor drift under dissonance
Counterplay. [RenB] Boundary
Prismatic Recall
Root echo · [Ma] Memory · Murmuring and above

























WellspringAnamnesis (Medium)Second WellspringLuminalisOperationSeparationTemperanceMurmuring and above
Effect. Replay an event from multiple angles, separating lie/noise spectrums.
How it works.

The idea. Remembrance. Everything keeps its past, and a soul under this lens can touch a thing and read it. Luminalis’s idea rides with it (the hidden light, seeing what hides and hiding what shows, one act run in two directions).
The operation. Separation. The past a thing has kept is parted from it and read, as the residue is parted from the vessel that held it.
In the worker. Held to Murmuring or past, the idea is set as law by [Ma] Memory, and the world gives way that far: replay an event from multiple angles, separating lie/noise spectrums.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus cognitive fatigue.
Flaw. Everything keeps its past, and the reading becomes part of that past the moment it is made. A careless hand laid on the record writes itself over what it came to read, so a careless practitioner erases the record in the act of taking it.
Counter. [Sil] Silence refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Letheveil or Sublimatio.
The Measurewrights’ line. Remanent magnetization and thermoluminescent dosimetry.

Cost and backlash. Cognitive fatigue
Counterplay. [Sil] Silence
Song of Renewal
Root echo · [Se] Song · Flourishing and above

























WellspringVerdantia (Wild)Second WellspringMirithaneOperationFermentationTemperanceFlourishing and above
Effect. Choral song that speeds tissue repair and mends a body worn by long strain.
How it works.

The idea. Growth without end. A self with no final size, which feeds on simply being out in the world. It comes through accumulation rather than rupture, one good day on top of another. Mirithane’s idea rides with it (the honest mirror, the inside and the outside made one surface).
The operation. Fermentation. The soul is fed a little at a time from the world it stands in, and grows on that feeding without end.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Se] Song, and the world gives way that far: choral song that speeds tissue repair and mends a body worn by long strain.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus echo overgrowth if sung off-key.
Flaw. A self with no final size cannot stop growing, even when the world has stopped feeding it. Shut away from the open air it grows on anyway, all length and no substance, until it cannot hold itself up.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Monolithion or Mortalis.
The Measurewrights’ line. Carbon fixation and indeterminate meristematic growth.

Cost and backlash. Echo overgrowth if sung off-key
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption
Veiled Rhythm
Root echo · [Vl] Veil · Murmuring and above

























WellspringHypnather (Spirit)Second WellspringMirithaneOperationDistillationTemperanceMurmuring and above
Effect. Illusion synced to heartbeat tempo; resists abrupt reveals.
How it works.

The idea. The sleep crown. Change that comes only at rest, the soul setting itself in order in the dark while nothing is asked of it. Mirithane’s idea rides with it (the honest mirror, the inside and the outside made one surface).
The operation. Distillation. The soul is passed through the dark again and again while it rests, each pass leaving its order a little purer than the last.
In the worker. Held to Murmuring or past, the idea is set as law by [Vl] Veil, and the world gives way that far: illusion synced to heartbeat tempo; resists abrupt reveals.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus fails under pure clarion.
Flaw. Change that comes only at rest belongs to the rest, and the soul has no say in when it is finished. Break it off partway, by waking or by force, and the order it was setting stops where it stood, worse ordered than before it began.
Counter. [Ora] Truth refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Ignivale or Tarturon.
The Measurewrights’ line. Structural relaxation.

Cost and backlash. Fails under pure clarion
Counterplay. [Ora] Truth
Verdant Passage
Root echo · [El] Life · Transcendence and above

























WellspringVerdantia (Wild)Second WellspringSomnalisOperationFermentationTemperanceTranscendence and above
Effect. Guide living Essence through Auren’s gate for healing without death.
How it works.

The idea. Growth without end. A self with no final size, which feeds on simply being out in the world. It comes through accumulation rather than rupture, one good day on top of another. Somnalis’s idea rides with it (living among what might be, the near possibilities of the Plane of Fate held in view at once, each with its odds on it, and a soul at ease in the not knowing).
The operation. Fermentation. The soul is fed a little at a time from the world it stands in, and grows on that feeding without end.
In the worker. Held to Transcendence or past, the idea is set as law by [El] Life, and the world gives way that far: guide living Essence through Auren’s gate for healing without death.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus soul-ache; grief echoes if misaligned.
Flaw. A self with no final size cannot stop growing, even when the world has stopped feeding it. Shut away from the open air it grows on anyway, all length and no substance, until it cannot hold itself up.
Counter. [Sil] Silence refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Monolithion or Mortalis.
The Measurewrights’ line. Carbon fixation and indeterminate meristematic growth.

Cost and backlash. Soul-ache; grief echoes if misaligned
Counterplay. [Sil] Silence
Vitality’s Tithe
Root echo · [Dr] Vitality + [Leth] Blood · Glory and above

























WellspringAnima Spirare (Wild)Second WellspringVerdantiaOperationFermentationTemperanceGlory and above
Effect. Redistributes stamina from the strongest member of a group to the weakest, keeping a party moving past the point any one of them could reach alone.
How it works.

The idea. The breath of the whole. A body that remembers being whole and answers a small hurt with everything it has. Verdantia’s idea rides with it (growth without end, a self with no final size, which feeds on simply being out in the world. It comes through accumulation rather than rupture, one good day on top of another).
The operation. Fermentation. The whole body is quickened round a small hurt, and the wound is answered with all of its own life.
In the worker. Held to Glory or past, the idea is set as law by [Dr] Vitality + [Leth] Blood, and the world gives way that far: redistributes stamina from the strongest member of a group to the weakest, keeping a party moving past the point any one of them could reach alone.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the tithe doesn’t ask permission — a caster can drain an ally past their own limit without meaning to.
Flaw. The whole body answers a small hurt with everything it has, and it has no way to answer with less. Lose the sense of where the hurt is and the whole answers everywhere at once, spending its own blood and breath on every vein until nothing is left to close the wound that started it.
Counter. [Au] Death refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Mortalis.
The Measurewrights’ line. The coagulation cascade and cooperative oxygen binding.

Cost and backlash. The tithe doesn’t ask permission — a caster can drain an ally past their own limit without meaning to.
Counterplay. [Au] Death
Windrider’s Chorus
Root echo · [Noq] Wind + [Chw] Choir · Flourishing and above

























WellspringOrrenthal (Wild)Second WellspringThaloréOperationConjunctionTemperanceFlourishing and above
Effect. Carries a sung signal across a storm-front, letting a scattered group hold formation by sound alone.
How it works.

The idea. The heart held in common. A soul whose goods belong to the whole of it, which bends under load and keeps its word. Thaloré’s idea rides with it (depth of feeling, emotion given its true weight in the soul, so that a grief can press on every soul in a whole room. A soul under this lens takes the shape of what holds it, and is likelier than most to fall into Synergia (Crystals briefly sharing one working) and Echo Bonds).
The operation. Conjunction. The parts of the soul are joined so that everything in it is held in common by the whole.
In the worker. Held to Flourishing or past, the idea is set as law by [Noq] Wind + [Chw] Choir, and the world gives way that far: carries a sung signal across a storm-front, letting a scattered group hold formation by sound alone.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the same wind carries the signal to anyone else listening for it.
Flaw. A soul held in common is only as sound as the trust between its parts, and the idea keeps no guard on that. Attack goes in along the seams between them rather than at the whole, and the soul fails at its seams while the bulk of it remains sound.
Counter. [Bd] Bedrock refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Fractura.
The Measurewrights’ line. Metallic bonding.

Cost and backlash. The same wind carries the signal to anyone else listening for it.
Counterplay. [Bd] Bedrock

the-magic-system/the-spell-index/root-in.title: Root Invocations
the-magic-system/the-spell-index/root-in.content:
The fourteen root invocations, one to each Archon: the working an Archon’s own law makes when it is called by its glyphs.
Part of The Spell Index. 14 entries. Each gives the working’s glyphs and least Temperance, its Wellspring and operation, what sets it off and what it does, how it works by its idea, and what it costs and what answers it.
Each Archon’s law and court are on The Fourteen Archons pages and in the Archon Register.
Covenant of the Instant
Root Invocation · [VaM] Moment + [Cro] Cycle · Refraction and above

























WellspringAnamnesis (Medium)Second WellspringLethegraalOperationSeparationTemperanceRefraction and above
Trigger. Requires a genuinely singular moment — a decision point, an impact, a single spoken word — not a duration.
Effect. Isolates a single instant from causal drift, letting the caster act inside a held moment while the surrounding world continues at its normal pace.
How it works.

The idea. Remembrance. Everything keeps its past, and a soul under this lens can touch a thing and read it. Lethegraal’s idea rides with it (the cup, time’s mercy hurried along: old pain settles on its own schedule, and no hand chooses what falls).
The operation. Separation. The past a thing has kept is parted from it and read, as the residue is parted from the vessel that held it.
In the worker. Held to Refraction or past, the idea is set as law by [VaM] Moment + [Cro] Cycle, and the world gives way that far: isolates a single instant from causal drift, letting the caster act inside a held moment while the surrounding world continues at its normal pace.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the caster’s own metabolism and Aether Shell still run at pocket-time, meaning three seconds outside can cost 24-36 seconds of internal fatigue.
Flaw. Everything keeps its past, and the reading becomes part of that past the moment it is made. A careless hand laid on the record writes itself over what it came to read, so a careless practitioner erases the record in the act of taking it.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Letheveil or Sublimatio.
The Measurewrights’ line. Remanent magnetization and thermoluminescent dosimetry.

In numbers. Subjective time inside the pocket runs roughly 8-12x normal; duration caps at three real-time seconds regardless of Temperance.
The target. Everything outside the pocket sees no time pass at all: to anyone watching, the caster simply didn’t move.
Cost and backlash. The caster’s own metabolism and Aether Shell still run at pocket-time, meaning three seconds outside can cost 24-36 seconds of internal fatigue.
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption refuses the held moment its claim from outside, snapping the caster back to normal time mid-action, often mid-motion, which is dangerous.
Last Rites of Uurgath
Root Invocation · [Uur] Disruption + [Vorn] End · Dissonance and above

























WellspringNihiloth (Wild)Second WellspringDissolutionOperationDissolutionTemperanceDissonance and above
Trigger. Target structure/curse/ward must already be past its functional lifespan — the glyph will not act on something still load-bearing.
Effect. Grants a structure, ward, or curse lawful permission to complete its own decay in a single stroke rather than lingering; the target’s Essence is left raw and ready for creation anew.
How it works.

The idea. The hollow law. Power by negation: the rule itself unmade, and what stands in the gap. Dissolution’s idea rides with it (unbinding, what no longer serves is allowed to come apart on its own, and keeping anything at all becomes the work).
The operation. Dissolution. The rule itself is loosed until nothing of it is left, and the gap is left standing where it was.
In the worker. Held to Dissonance or past, the idea is set as law by [Uur] Disruption + [Vorn] End, and the world gives way that far: grants a structure, ward, or curse lawful permission to complete its own decay in a single stroke rather than lingering; the target’s Essence is left raw and ready for creation anew.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus if no clean target remains when the barrier drops, the unmaking still has to finish on something, and it finishes on the caster’s own Aether Shell.
Flaw. A rule unmade is unmade for everyone, and the idea has no way to spare its maker. Everything the practitioner brought inside is subject to the same gap, including the parts of themselves they were relying on.
Counter. [El] Life refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Eidolyn, Oblivara or Monolithion.
The Measurewrights’ line. Destructive interference and the null field.

In numbers. Collapse completes in under two seconds regardless of the structure’s original size, since the barrier removal is binary, not gradual.
The target. The target doesn’t fight the collapse; per Uurgath’s law it recognizes its own decay as true and stops resisting it structurally.
Cost and backlash. If no clean target remains when the barrier drops, the unmaking still has to finish on something, and it finishes on the caster’s own Aether Shell.
Counterplay. Restoring the missing activation barrier (a Thalen-glyph reinforcement, or simply propping the structure with fresh materials) before the glyph completes stops the cascade.
The Chord That Remembers Its Shape
Root Invocation · [Se] Song + [Ar] Accord · Invocation and above

























WellspringJudicium (Wild)Second WellspringMirithaneOperationSeparationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Requires at least three other souls already producing audible or Essence-resonant output in the same field.
Effect. Synchronizes the Essence frequencies of every soul in a region into a single unified chord, stabilizing a Domain’s tone directly through Selhar’s own law.
How it works.

The idea. Truth told apart. Discernment that knows what a thing is made of, and whether it is lying, from the mark it cannot help leaving. Mirithane’s idea rides with it (the honest mirror, the inside and the outside made one surface).
The operation. Separation. A thing is parted from what it claims to be, the true told apart from the false by the mark it cannot help leaving.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Se] Song + [Ar] Accord, and the world gives way that far: Synchronizes the Essence frequencies of every soul in a region into a single unified chord, stabilizing a Domain’s tone directly through Selhar’s own law.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus forcing synchronization on unwilling participants produces measurable resistance-feedback into the caster, proportional to how many refuse.
Flaw. Discernment tells everything apart and cannot choose to leave anything untold. Off guard, every object in view reports what it is made of at once, and the reader loses the power to put any of it first. Pushed past the point where a reading only reads, telling a thing apart becomes taking it apart: the read starts to pass judgment, which can turn away force or at the very top end a life, and since it has no way to look at one thing only, it takes the reader’s own memory in the same stroke.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Tenebra or Eidolyn.
The Measurewrights’ line. Emission and absorption spectroscopy.

In numbers. Full lock achieves within roughly ten seconds for a small group, longer for larger fields; Selhar’s own Rite of Choral Concord reportedly took hours across three full Domains.
The target. Synchronized participants report a felt sense of unified purpose and reduced internal conflict for the working’s duration.
Cost and backlash. Forcing synchronization on unwilling participants produces measurable resistance-feedback into the caster, proportional to how many refuse.
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption introduces a deliberately unmatched frequency into the field, and because the lock is only as strong as its weakest coupling, one true dissonance can decouple the whole chord.
The Heartflare Given Shape
Root Invocation · [Ve] Desire + [Asa] Creation · Invocation and above

























WellspringIgnivale (Wild)Second WellspringExurothOperationCalcinationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Requires an unfulfilled want the caster has carried long enough to have a stable emotional ‘shape’ — a fresh whim won’t work.
Effect. Brings into brief physical existence something that has never been, shaped entirely by the intensity of the caster’s longing.
How it works.

The idea. The spark. The smallest beginning that goes on to pay for itself, so that the gap between wanting a thing and doing it closes to almost nothing. Exuroth’s idea rides with it (the trial by fire, power comes only through ordeal, plunged and reheated and plunged again, until the soul holds a hardness no gentle road could have given it).
The operation. Calcination. One point of fire is set to the work at the first degree, and the burning is left to pay its own way.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Ve] Desire + [Asa] Creation, and the world gives way that far: brings into brief physical existence something that has never been, shaped entirely by the intensity of the caster’s longing.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the created thing remains emotionally ‘hooked’ to the caster; distance or neglect causes visible caster distress, like a phantom-limb sensation.
Flaw. With the gap between wanting and doing closed, the soul has no moment left in which to decide. Any stray feeling in the room is beginning enough, and the working fires without the practitioner having decided to fire it.
Counter. [Ur] Balance refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Pyraeon or Hypnather.
The Measurewrights’ line. Minimum ignition energy and the activation barrier.

In numbers. Object stability lasts roughly one hour per point of sustained emotional intensity.
The target. The created object/effect behaves exactly as the caster envisioned it, down to fine detail the caster didn’t consciously specify but unconsciously wanted.
Cost and backlash. The created thing remains emotionally ‘hooked’ to the caster; distance or neglect causes visible caster distress, like a phantom-limb sensation.
Counterplay. [Ur] Balance sets an equal and opposite want beside it, and two wants cannot both take shape in one place, so one usually unmakes the other or both fail.
The Hexagonal Oath
Root Invocation · [Th] Foundation + [En] Lattice · Invocation and above

























WellspringPetralon (Wild)Second WellspringMateria PrimordiaOperationCoagulationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Caster must trace the full six-sided boundary of the intended Domain by hand or by marked stake before invoking.
Effect. Declares the fundamental geometry of a Domain — fixing which angles, proportions, and forms may take root within it for the duration of the working.
How it works.

The idea. The foundation. To become what other things stand on: load taken, carried and sent down, at the price of slowly settling. Breaking, holding and rising are one law seen from three positions, and this lens treats a soul as a loaded structure, asking the only question a master mason ever asks: where the load goes, and what happens at the place it concentrates. Materia Primordia’s idea rides with it (the first substance, one self and many forms, and a soul that finds it can become its own opposite and still be itself).
The operation. Coagulation. The soul is fixed as the foundation, set to bear and never to rise.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Th] Foundation + [En] Lattice, and the world gives way that far: declares the fundamental geometry of a Domain — fixing which angles, proportions, and forms may take root within it for the duration of the working.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the caster’s own body must hold the geometric template in mind continuously during the initial trace; a lapse mid-trace corrupts the whole boundary.
Flaw. A foundation bears whatever presses down on it, and nothing ever asked it to hold on. Pull on it, the one load it does not answer, and it does not give gracefully. It parts.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Cymorath or Abython.
The Measurewrights’ line. Compressive load path and creep.

In numbers. Holds indefinitely once set, but only within the traced boundary — extending the boundary later requires re-tracing and re-casting.
The target. Anything built or altered inside the Domain that violates the fixed geometry meets immediate, hard mechanical resistance, as if pushing against solid stone.
Cost and backlash. The caster’s own body must hold the geometric template in mind continuously during the initial trace; a lapse mid-trace corrupts the whole boundary.
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption introduced at a boundary seam (a corner, a gap in the original trace) unravels the constraint from that single weak point outward.
The Mask That Loves You Back
Root Invocation · [Ka] Dream + [Vl] Veil · Invocation and above

























WellspringOneirion (Spirit)Second WellspringSomnalisOperationSublimationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Requires physical proximity to a sleeping or meditating subject, or the caster’s own trance state for a solo dreamscape.
Effect. Constructs a habitable dreamscape following the grammar of the subconscious rather than waking law — convincing enough that an observer’s own heart confirms it as real.
How it works.

The idea. Dream as a place. Work done in the space of what can be thought, reaching a soul where no line of sight runs, because no soul was ever in the room. Somnalis’s idea rides with it (living among what might be, the near possibilities of the Plane of Fate held in view at once, each with its odds on it, and a soul at ease in the not knowing).
The operation. Sublimation. The working is lifted off every bench into the space of what can be thought, and comes down again in a soul.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Ka] Dream + [Vl] Veil, and the world gives way that far: constructs a habitable dreamscape following the grammar of the subconscious rather than waking law — convincing enough that an observer’s own heart confirms it as real.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the dreamscape draws its ‘realism’ partly from the caster’s own subconscious material, meaning the caster’s private fears/desires can leak into scenes they didn’t intend to build.
Flaw. A dream is a place with no ground under it, and nothing done there knows where it is in a room. A working that was true in the space of what can be thought lands nowhere in particular when it has to come down into a real one.
Counter. [Ie] Perception refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Mirithane or Chthonica.
The Measurewrights’ line. Configuration space.

In numbers. Dreamscape stability holds as long as the caster maintains active attention; unattended sections begin degrading into incoherence within minutes.
The target. Occupants perceive the dreamscape as fully real, including pain, temperature, and consequence, until and unless something breaks the illusion’s internal consistency.
Cost and backlash. The dreamscape draws its ‘realism’ partly from the caster’s own subconscious material, meaning the caster’s private fears/desires can leak into scenes they didn’t intend to build.
Counterplay. [Ie] Perception lets an occupant compare the dreamscape against a remembered true sensation, and that single inconsistency unravels the whole construct outward from the point of doubt.
The Prism That Does Not Blink
Root Invocation · [Ie] Perception + [Vei] Depth · Invocation and above

























WellspringLuminalis (Medium)Second WellspringOneirionOperationSeparationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Caster must already know the immediate act whose consequences they want traced — the glyph traces forward and backward from a known point, it can’t search blindly.
Effect. Reveals the full causal chain connecting an act to its ultimate consequence, read directly rather than inferred.
How it works.

The idea. The hidden light. Seeing what hides and hiding what shows, one act run in two directions. Oneirion’s idea rides with it (dream as a place, work done in the space of what can be thought, reaching a soul where no line of sight runs, because no soul was ever in the room).
The operation. Separation. What is seen is parted from what is there, so the hidden can be drawn into view and the shown put out of it.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Ie] Perception + [Vei] Depth, and the world gives way that far: reveals the full causal chain connecting an act to its ultimate consequence, read directly rather than inferred.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus perceiving a full causal chain costs proportional cognitive load; casters routinely report the revealed information as unshakeable once seen, a genuine memory burden going forward.
Flaw. Seeing and hiding are one act run two ways, and a soul that keeps both running at once begins to run two ways itself. Its own output splits along the seam between what it shows and what it hides, the two halves going out at different paces, and complex workings arrive out of step with themselves.
Counter. [Vl] Veil refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Penanceflare or Mirithane.
The Measurewrights’ line. The non-visible spectrum and polarization.

In numbers. Chain length revealed scales with Stage; Invocation-tier casters see roughly a season’s worth of downstream consequence, higher Stages see years.
The target. The revealed chain appears as an overlaid, navigable structure in the caster’s perception — not a vision, a legible diagram.
Cost and backlash. Perceiving a full causal chain costs proportional cognitive load; casters routinely report the revealed information as unshakeable once seen, a genuine memory burden going forward.
Counterplay. [Vl] Veil doesn’t block the trace, it multiplies false junctions into the diagram, making the true chain indistinguishable from decoys.
The Silver Archive Opened
Root Invocation · [Ma] Recall + [Lei] Binding · Invocation and above

























WellspringAnamnesis (Medium)Second WellspringMirithaneOperationSeparationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Caster must physically touch an object, place, or bloodline-relic tied to the memory sought.
Effect. Opens direct communion with the Echo Vaults, retrieving a soul-true memory exactly as it occurred, unfiltered by grief, pride, or time.
How it works.

The idea. Remembrance. Everything keeps its past, and a soul under this lens can touch a thing and read it. Mirithane’s idea rides with it (the honest mirror, the inside and the outside made one surface).
The operation. Separation. The past a thing has kept is parted from it and read, as the residue is parted from the vessel that held it.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Ma] Recall + [Lei] Binding, and the world gives way that far: opens direct communion with the Echo Vaults, retrieving a soul-true memory exactly as it occurred, unfiltered by grief, pride, or time.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus retrieval draws directly on the caster’s own memory-Essence reserve; heavy or repeated use leaves the caster’s own recent memories thinner and harder to access.
Flaw. Everything keeps its past, and the reading becomes part of that past the moment it is made. A careless hand laid on the record writes itself over what it came to read, so a careless practitioner erases the record in the act of taking it.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Letheveil or Sublimatio.
The Measurewrights’ line. Remanent magnetization and thermoluminescent dosimetry.

In numbers. Full sensory-fidelity playback; no degradation regardless of the memory’s age, because everything keeps its past and a record read under Anamnesis does not wear the way a page or a picture does.
The target. The retrieved memory plays as a full immersive replay for the caster (and anyone else the caster chooses to link in via [Lei] Binding).
Cost and backlash. Retrieval draws directly on the caster’s own memory-Essence reserve; heavy or repeated use leaves the caster’s own recent memories thinner and harder to access.
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption corrupts the read, either producing static/gaps in the replay or, at high intensity, damaging the underlying imprint permanently.
The Still Gate’s Mercy
Root Invocation · [Au] Death + [Vor] Return · Transcendence and above

























WellspringMortalis (Medium)Second WellspringSomnalisOperationDissolutionTemperanceTranscendence and above
Trigger. Subject must be actively dying, with the passage already beginning; the glyph opens a threshold, it can’t create death.
Effect. Opens a lawful, brief threshold at the Still Gate, letting a dying soul pass without becoming a wandering Echo.
How it works.

The idea. The black gate. Ending looked at squarely and understood as a passage with its own law, by a soul that has stopped fearing it and has started, a little, to cool. Somnalis’s idea rides with it (living among what might be, the near possibilities of the Plane of Fate held in view at once, each with its odds on it, and a soul at ease in the not knowing).
The operation. Dissolution. A thing’s hold on what it is gets loosed, lawfully and in order, until it comes apart at its proper end.
In the worker. Held to Transcendence or past, the idea is set as law by [Au] Death + [Vor] Return, and the world gives way that far: opens a lawful, brief threshold at the Still Gate, letting a dying soul pass without becoming a wandering Echo.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the caster absorbs a fraction of the passage’s grief-charge directly into their own Attraction Layer, a real emotional cost that compounds with repeated use.
Flaw. A soul that has stopped fearing the gate has also stopped holding out against it, and the fear was part of what kept it on this side. Stay near the ending long enough and the worker drifts toward it, cooling a little at a time without noticing.
Counter. [Wy] Motion refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Terranova, Anima Spirare or Verdantia.
The Measurewrights’ line. The non-equilibrium steady state, and the thermodynamic boundary of its collapse.

In numbers. Threshold stays open for roughly ninety seconds — enough for a natural death’s actual biological passage window.
The target. The passing soul experiences the transition as gentle and complete rather than abrupt or contested.
Cost and backlash. The caster absorbs a fraction of the passage’s grief-charge directly into their own Attraction Layer, a real emotional cost that compounds with repeated use.
Counterplay. [Wy] Motion agitates the threshold before it seals, risking an incomplete passage that leaves a partial Echo behind.
The Storm That Remembers Not
Root Invocation · [Wy] Motion + [Eith] Flux · Invocation and above

























WellspringCataclysm (Wild)Second WellspringTerranovaOperationCalcinationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Must be cast directly against an identifiably stagnant current — a dead Wellspring flow, a stalled front, a frozen conflict; it has nothing to act on otherwise.
Effect. Shatters a stagnation ward or dead current wholesale, setting flow, motion or growth going again on a civilizational scale.
How it works.

The idea. Upheaval. The moment a fire stops being a fire and becomes a blast, a change in kind as well as size, and the soul that has learned to call that moment. Terranova’s idea rides with it (the living earth, mending by growing, every wound answered with new ground).
The operation. Calcination. The burning is driven past itself until it goes over all at once into something else in kind.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Wy] Motion + [Eith] Flux, and the world gives way that far: shatters a stagnation ward or dead current wholesale, setting flow, motion or growth going again on a civilizational scale.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the first push comes from the caster’s own reserve, a stagnant current made to remember it can run; casters report acute exhaustion equivalent to running a literal marathon.
Flaw. Upheaval needs something to hold it in before it can go over, and once it goes it does not know which side of the wall it was called from. In confinement the blast comes back along its own path, and the practitioner standing where it began takes the blast and its return together.
Counter. [Au] Death refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Solfatara or Lethegraal.
The Measurewrights’ line. Deflagration-to-detonation transition.

In numbers. Restarted flow reaches roughly 60-80% of the current’s original pre-stagnation throughput within the first hour.
The target. Everything downstream of the restarted current feels the surge as sudden, disorienting abundance or force after prolonged absence.
Cost and backlash. The first push comes from the caster’s own reserve, a stagnant current made to remember it can run; casters report acute exhaustion equivalent to running a literal marathon.
Counterplay. [Au] Death lays stillness back on the current’s source, and if it lands before the flow has taken hold again the current settles back into stagnation.
The Unbending Scale
Root Invocation · [Ur] Balance + [Sel] Measure · Invocation and above

























WellspringJudicium (Wild)Second WellspringFixatioOperationSeparationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Caster names an active imbalance aloud while holding [Ur]+[Sel] steady for a full breath.
Effect. Calls Urion’s own Law of Equivalence to arbitrate a conflict directly — every force in the field must generate its measured counterweight, freezing escalation until the true weight of the dispute is spoken aloud.
How it works.

The idea. Truth told apart. Discernment that knows what a thing is made of, and whether it is lying, from the mark it cannot help leaving. Fixatio’s idea rides with it (commitment, what is bound here stays bound, because the way back has stopped existing).
The operation. Separation. A thing is parted from what it claims to be, the true told apart from the false by the mark it cannot help leaving.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Ur] Balance + [Sel] Measure, and the world gives way that far: calls Urion’s own Law of Equivalence to arbitrate a conflict directly — every force in the field must generate its measured counterweight, freezing escalation until the true weight of the dispute is spoken aloud.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus the imbalance the working erased has to be carried somewhere, and the caster’s own Aether Shell carries it; a large imbalance can knock the caster prone or unconscious.
Flaw. Discernment tells everything apart and cannot choose to leave anything untold. Off guard, every object in view reports what it is made of at once, and the reader loses the power to put any of it first. Pushed past the point where a reading only reads, telling a thing apart becomes taking it apart: the read starts to pass judgment, which can turn away force or at the very top end a life, and since it has no way to look at one thing only, it takes the reader’s own memory in the same stroke.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Tenebra or Eidolyn.
The Measurewrights’ line. Emission and absorption spectroscopy.

In numbers. Escalation halts within roughly one second per Temperance Stage above Invocation (IX); a Stage IX caster holds it for ~1s, a Stage XII caster for ~4s.
The target. Every combatant and object in the field is brought suddenly and involuntarily into balance: weapons lose the advantage of their swing, raised voices flatten to the same volume.
Cost and backlash. The imbalance the working erased has to be carried somewhere, and the caster’s own Aether Shell carries it; a large imbalance can knock the caster prone or unconscious.
Counterplay. A second imbalance introduced faster than the field can re-equalize (a rapid follow-up strike, a shouted lie) breaks the lock before it stabilizes.
The Unbowed Crown
Root Invocation · [IrW] Will + [Krn] Crown · Invocation and above

























WellspringJudicium (Wild)Second WellspringIgnivaleOperationSeparationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Caster must state a genuine conviction aloud — a real commitment, not a tactical bluff; the glyph reads sincerity via Harmonics Fidelity.
Effect. Declares the caster’s will sovereign within a bounded field; Essence reorganizes to obey conviction, compelling elemental obedience and shielding the caster from external domination.
How it works.

The idea. Truth told apart. Discernment that knows what a thing is made of, and whether it is lying, from the mark it cannot help leaving. Ignivale’s idea rides with it (the spark, the smallest beginning that goes on to pay for itself, so that the gap between wanting a thing and doing it closes to almost nothing).
The operation. Separation. A thing is parted from what it claims to be, the true told apart from the false by the mark it cannot help leaving.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [IrW] Will + [Krn] Crown, and the world gives way that far: declares the caster’s will sovereign within a bounded field; Essence reorganizes to obey conviction, compelling elemental obedience and shielding the caster from external domination.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus A field this strong self-audits: if the caster’s own subsequent actions contradict the stated conviction, the field collapses and inflicts the accumulated feedback on the caster instead.
Flaw. Discernment tells everything apart and cannot choose to leave anything untold. Off guard, every object in view reports what it is made of at once, and the reader loses the power to put any of it first. Pushed past the point where a reading only reads, telling a thing apart becomes taking it apart: the read starts to pass judgment, which can turn away force or at the very top end a life, and since it has no way to look at one thing only, it takes the reader’s own memory in the same stroke.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Tenebra or Eidolyn.
The Measurewrights’ line. Emission and absorption spectroscopy.

In numbers. Compulsion strength scales directly with measured Fidelity — a half-hearted declaration produces a correspondingly weak, easily-broken field.
The target. Lesser wills in the field either fall in line with the caster’s stated intent or, if they resist, take direct Essence feedback proportional to their resistance.
Cost and backlash. A field this strong self-audits: if the caster’s own subsequent actions contradict the stated conviction, the field collapses and inflicts the accumulated feedback on the caster instead.
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption doesn’t need to overpower the field — it only needs to introduce genuine doubt into the caster’s own conviction, which collapses the field from the source outward.
The Unreachable Made Near
Root Invocation · [Zh] Space + [Oth] Path · Invocation and above

























WellspringEclipseron (Spirit)Second WellspringTransmutatioOperationDistillationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Both endpoints must be points the caster has physically stood at some point in their life.
Effect. Folds two points once separated by a cosmic gulf into true adjacency for the duration of the working.
How it works.

The idea. Reading what is missing. The shape of an absence taken as knowledge of the thing that cast it. This lens has the truest claim of the Sixty to reading what fails to be there. People call that darkness and are being romantic: it is a system described by its absences, which is a harder and less romantic thing than its practitioners generally admit. Transmutatio’s idea rides with it (change without loss, the same thing said another way, so that what looked like a failure turns out to be fuel in an inconvenient form).
The operation. Distillation. What was driven off is read from the dead head left behind in the retort, the absence drawn down into knowledge of the thing that cast it.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [Zh] Space + [Oth] Path, and the world gives way that far: folds two points once separated by a cosmic gulf into true adjacency for the duration of the working.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus folding space this way strains the caster’s own spatial sense afterward — mild disorientation and misjudged distances for hours following.
Flaw. An absence is knowledge only if something cast it, and the idea cannot tell a gap left by a thing from a gap that was always empty. A practitioner committed to reading what is missing will eventually construct an object out of a gap that had nothing behind it.
Counter. [Ma] Recall refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Aurevane.
The Measurewrights’ line. Occultation and transit photometry.

In numbers. Fold radius scales with caster Temperance; Stage IX manages roughly city-block distances, Stage XII+ manages cross-Realm distances.
The target. Anything crossing the fold experiences a seamless single step; anything watching from outside sees the two locations’ edges visibly overlap for the fold’s duration.
Cost and backlash. Folding space this way strains the caster’s own spatial sense afterward — mild disorientation and misjudged distances for hours following.
Counterplay. [Ma] Recall interrupts by reminding the fold which distances are ‘true,’ collapsing it back to the correct, unfolded separation — sometimes stranding anything mid-crossing.
The Wheel That Turns Again
Root Invocation · [El] Life + [Vael] Renewal · Invocation and above

























WellspringVerdantia (Wild)Second WellspringRebirthineOperationFermentationTemperanceInvocation and above
Trigger. Requires soil, tissue, or Essence-substrate that is dead but not erased — Uurgath’s true erasure leaves nothing for this glyph to act on.
Effect. Reconstitutes an entire dead or sterilized ecosystem from barren earth, turning what died there straight into fresh growth.
How it works.

The idea. Growth without end. A self with no final size, which feeds on simply being out in the world. It comes through accumulation rather than rupture, one good day on top of another. Rebirthine’s idea rides with it (the cycle, loss taken as the first step of the next building, what is broken down paying for what comes up).
The operation. Fermentation. The soul is fed a little at a time from the world it stands in, and grows on that feeding without end.
In the worker. Held to Invocation or past, the idea is set as law by [El] Life + [Vael] Renewal, and the world gives way that far: reconstitutes an entire dead or sterilized ecosystem from barren earth, turning what died there straight into fresh growth.
Price in the self. Reserve, plus sustained casting draws directly on the caster’s own vitality; overdrawn casters show symptoms identical to severe malnutrition afterward.
Flaw. A self with no final size cannot stop growing, even when the world has stopped feeding it. Shut away from the open air it grows on anyway, all length and no substance, until it cannot hold itself up.
Counter. [Uur] Disruption refuses its claim before it settles; the contrary idea is Monolithion or Mortalis.
The Measurewrights’ line. Carbon fixation and indeterminate meristematic growth.

In numbers. Visible regrowth begins within minutes; full ecosystem reconstitution over the following season, per Elyndra’s own Verdant Exhalation precedent.
The target. Regrowth spreads outward from the cast point at a rate the caster can consciously throttle, at least initially.
Cost and backlash. Sustained casting draws directly on the caster’s own vitality; overdrawn casters show symptoms identical to severe malnutrition afterward.
Counterplay. [Uur] Disruption reintroduces the original sterilizing condition at the growth’s leading edge, and uncapped growth left unchecked can outrun the caster’s ability to throttle it at all.
